entry.title: Real-time Secondary Crash Likelihood Prediction Excluding Post Primary Crash Features

author.name: Lei Han, Mohamed Abdel-Aty, Zubayer Islam, Chenzhu Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for real-time secondary crash prediction that doesn't rely on post-crash features, using dynamic spatiotemporal windows and a hybrid model combining primary crash estimation with traffic flow analysis.

entry.title: Claim Automation using Large Language Model

author.name: Zhengda Mo, Zhiyu Quan, Eli O'Donohue, Kaiwen Zhong

entry.summary: Proposes using fine-tuned LLMs with LoRA for generating structured corrective-action recommendations from unstructured warranty claim narratives, with a governance-aware local deployment approach for the insurance domain.

entry.title: Evaluating Extremely Low-Resource Machine Translation: A Comparative Study of ChrF++ and BLEU Metrics

author.name: Sanjeev Kumar, Preethi Jyothi, Pushpak Bhattacharyya

entry.summary: Compares BLEU and ChrF++ metrics for machine translation evaluation in extremely low-resource languages (Magahi, Bhojpuri, Chhattisgarhi), showing how each metric responds differently to translation artifacts like hallucinations and source copying.

entry.title: Bridging the Domain Divide: Supervised vs. Zero-Shot Clinical Section Segmentation from MIMIC-III to Obstetrics

author.name: Baris Karacan, Barbara Di Eugenio, Patrick Thornton

entry.summary: Evaluates clinical section segmentation approaches on MIMIC-III and a new obstetrics dataset, comparing supervised transformer models with zero-shot methods for domain transfer.

entry.title: "Hello, I'm Delivering. Let Me Pass By": Navigating Public Pathways with Walk-along with Robots in Crowded City Streets

author.name: EunJeong Cheon, Do Yeon Shin

entry.summary: Studies autonomous delivery robots navigating crowded city streets using ethnographic methods from urban studies. Proposes 'walk-along with robots' methodology to study robots operating beyond researcher control in dynamic environments.

entry.title: Bluetooth Phased-array Aided Inertial Navigation Using Factor Graphs: Experimental Verification

author.name: Glen Hjelmerud M{\o}rkbak S{\o}rensen, Torleiv H. Bryne, Kristoffer Gryte, Tor Arne Johansen

entry.summary: Experimentally verifies Bluetooth phased-array aided inertial navigation using factor graphs for GNSS-denied scenarios like warehouse logistics and drone landings, testing on multirotor drone flight data.

entry.title: Agentic Wireless Communication for 6G: Intent-Aware and Continuously Evolving Physical-Layer Intelligence

author.name: Zhaoyang Li, Xingzhi Jin, Junyu Pan, Qianqian Yang, Zhiguo Shi

entry.summary: Proposes an agentic wireless communication framework for 6G using LLMs for intent-aware, continuously evolving physical-layer intelligence that adapts to multi-dimensional user objectives.

entry.summary: Proposes a human-AI collaborative framework (STRIDE + AI-GENTS) for constructing benchmark datasets to evaluate sustainability/ESG rating methodologies, aiming to harmonize divergent ratings across agencies.

author.name: Joseph Bingham, Sam Helmich

entry.summary: Introduces Bonsai (Combine), a criterion-based pruning framework for CNNs that provides a standard language for comparing pruning criteria and proposes several novel criterion functions.

entry.title: Pareto Optimal Benchmarking of AI Models on ARM Cortex Processors for Sustainable Embedded Systems

author.name: Pranay Jain, Maximilian Kasper, G\"oran K\"ober, Axel Plinge, Dominik Seu{\ss}

entry.summary: Presents a benchmarking framework for optimizing AI models on ARM Cortex processors (M0+, M4, M7), demonstrating Pareto analysis of energy-accuracy trade-offs for embedded AI deployment.

entry.title: Attending to Routers Aids Indoor Wireless Localization

author.name: Ayush Roy, Tahsin Fuad Hassan, Roshan Ayyalasomayajula, Vishnu Suresh Lokhande

entry.summary: Proposes using attention mechanisms to weight router contributions in Wi-Fi-based indoor localization, inspired by weighted triangulation. Shows improvements over standard aggregation in machine learning localization architectures.

entry.title: Exploring LLMs for User Story Extraction from Mockups

author.name: Diego Firmenich, Leandro Antonelli, Bruno Pazos, Fabricio Lozada, Leonardo Morales

entry.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Optimal Portfolio Allocation: A Comparative Study with Mean-Variance Optimization

author.name: Srijan Sood, Kassiani Papasotiriou, Marius Vaiciulis, Tucker Balch

entry.summary: Compares deep reinforcement learning approaches for portfolio optimization against mean-variance optimization, training model-free agents on historical market data.

entry.title: A High-Level Survey of Optical Remote Sensing

author.name: Panagiotis Koletsis, Vasilis Efthymiou, Maria Vakalopoulou, Nikos Komodakis, Anastasios Doulamis, Georgios Th. Papadopoulos

entry.title: Construction of a classification model for dementia among Brazilian adults aged 50 and over

entry.title: Research Summary: February 19, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research centers on agent reliability, ecosystem-level AI risks, and mechanistic understanding of emergence, with notable advances in robotics and safety evaluation.

  • Arvind Narayanan's group proposes twelve concrete metrics for AI agent reliability across consistency, robustness, predictability, and safety—a foundational framework as agentic systems proliferate
  • Retrieval Collapse formalizes how AI-generated web pollution erodes search diversity and enables adversarial manipulation of retrieval pipelines
  • A pre-registered RCT (n=153) finds no significant LLM uplift for novice biology lab performance, a critical biosecurity policy result
  • Mechanistic tracking of five geometric measures across model scales reveals universal representation collapse followed by top-down reorganization during capability emergence

In robotics, DreamZero achieves 2× improvement over SOTA vision-language-action models via joint video-action diffusion modeling, while EgoScale discovers scaling laws for dexterous manipulation from 20,854 hours of egocentric human video. On the safety front, optimization instability in clinical agentic workflows shows self-improvement paradoxically degrades performance, and STING introduces automated red-teaming for multi-turn illicit assistance. Doc-to-LoRA offers a practical alternative to long-context inference by meta-learning single-pass context distillation into LoRA adapters.
