entry.title: Building Technology to Drive AI Governance

author.name: jsteinhardt

entry.summary: Jacob Steinhardt argues for a 'third path' between pure technical alignment research and direct policy work: building technology that shifts governance dynamics by changing available information, incentives, and options. Draws analogy from environmental monitoring technology.

entry.title: Egocentric Bias in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Maijunxian Wang, Yijiang Li, Bingyang Wang, Tianwei Zhao, Ran Ji, Qingying Gao, Emmy Liu, Hokin Deng, Dezhi Luo

entry.summary: Introduces FlipSet, a benchmark for Level-2 visual perspective taking in VLMs, revealing systematic egocentric bias where ~75% of errors reproduce the camera viewpoint rather than adopting another agent's perspective.

entry.title: RoboGene: Boosting VLA Pre-training via Diversity-Driven Agentic Framework for Real-World Task Generation

author.name: Yixue Zhang (Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics, The School of Advanced Manufacturing and Robotics, Peking University), Kun Wu (Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics), Zhi Gao (Beijing Institute of Technology), Zhen Zhao (Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics), Pei Ren (Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics), Zhiyuan Xu (Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics), Fei Liao (Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics), Xinhua Wang (Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics), Shichao Fan (Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics, The School of Mechanical Engineering and Automation, Beihang University), Di Wu (Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics, State Key Laboratory of Multimedia Information Processing, School of Computer Science, Peking University), Qiuxuan Feng (Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics, State Key Laboratory of Multimedia Information Processing, School of Computer Science, Peking University), Meng Li (Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics), Zhengping Che (Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics), Chang Liu (The School of Advanced Manufacturing and Robotics, Peking University), Jian Tang (Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics)

entry.summary: Introduces RoboGene, an agentic framework that uses foundation models to automatically generate diverse, physically plausible manipulation tasks for robot training data, covering single-arm, dual-arm, and mobile robots.

entry.title: Align Once, Benefit Multilingually: Enforcing Multilingual Consistency for LLM Safety Alignment

author.name: Yuyan Bu, Xiaohao Liu, ZhaoXing Ren, Yaodong Yang, Juntao Dai

entry.summary: Proposes a Multi-Lingual Consistency (MLC) loss that improves multilingual safety alignment of LLMs in a resource-efficient way by encouraging collinearity between multilingual representation vectors.

entry.title: Verifier-Constrained Flow Expansion for Discovery Beyond the Data

author.name: Riccardo De Santi, Kimon Protopapas, Ya-Ping Hsieh, Andreas Krause

entry.summary: Introduces Verifier-Constrained Flow Expansion for adapting pre-trained flow models to generate valid samples beyond the training distribution, using a verifier to ensure feasibility during expansion.

entry.title: Steering diffusion models with quadratic rewards: a fine-grained analysis

author.name: Ankur Moitra, Andrej Risteski, Dhruv Rohatgi

entry.summary: Provides a fine-grained analysis of sampling from reward-tilted diffusion models with quadratic rewards, establishing computational tractability results and understanding when inference-time heuristics can be efficiently improved.

entry.title: MemoryArena: Benchmarking Agent Memory in Interdependent Multi-Session Agentic Tasks

author.name: Zexue He, Yu Wang, Churan Zhi, Yuanzhe Hu, Tzu-Ping Chen, Lang Yin, Ze Chen, Tong Arthur Wu, Siru Ouyang, Zihan Wang, Jiaxin Pei, Julian McAuley, Yejin Choi, Alex Pentland

entry.summary: Introduces MemoryArena, a benchmark for evaluating agent memory in interdependent multi-session tasks where agents must acquire memory during interaction and rely on it for future tasks.

entry.title: Learning Personalized Agents from Human Feedback

author.name: Kaiqu Liang, Julia Kruk, Shengyi Qian, Xianjun Yang, Shengjie Bi, Yuanshun Yao, Shaoliang Nie, Mingyang Zhang, Lijuan Liu, Jaime Fern\'andez Fisac, Shuyan Zhou, Saghar Hosseini

entry.summary: Introduces Personalized Agents from Human Feedback (PAHF), a framework for continual agent personalization through online learning from live interactions with explicit per-user memory. Uses a three-step loop of clarification, memory-grounded action, and post-action feedback integration.

entry.title: A Lightweight Explainable Guardrail for Prompt Safety

author.name: Md Asiful Islam, Mihai Surdeanu

entry.summary: Proposes LEG, a lightweight explainable guardrail for unsafe prompt classification using multi-task learning that jointly classifies prompts and identifies which words explain the safety decision, trained with synthetic data and novel loss functions.

entry.title: Not the Example, but the Process: How Self-Generated Examples Enhance LLM Reasoning

author.name: Daehoon Gwak, Minseo Jung, Junwoo Park, Minho Park, ChaeHun Park, Junha Hyung, Jaegul Choo

entry.summary: Argues that the benefit of self-generated few-shot examples in LLM reasoning comes from the act of creating them rather than the examples themselves, validated across diverse LLM architectures on reasoning-intensive tasks.

entry.title: From Tool Orchestration to Code Execution: A Study of MCP Design Choices

author.name: Yuval Felendler, Parth A. Gandhi, Idan Habler, Yuval Elovici, Asaf Shabtai

entry.summary: Studies design choices in Model Context Protocols (MCPs), particularly the shift from tool-by-tool invocation to Code Execution MCP (CE-MCP) that consolidates complex workflows into single programs for better scalability.

entry.title: ReLoop: Structured Modeling and Behavioral Verification for Reliable LLM-Based Optimization

author.name: Junbo Jacob Lian, Yujun Sun, Huiling Chen, Chaoyu Zhang, Chung-Piaw Teo

entry.summary: Introduces ReLoop for reliable LLM-based optimization, addressing 'silent failures' where code executes correctly but encodes semantically wrong formulations, with a feasibility-correctness gap up to 90 percentage points.

entry.title: Updating Parametric Knowledge with Context Distillation Retains Post-Training Capabilities

author.name: Shankar Padmanabhan, Mustafa Omer Gul, Tanya Goyal

entry.summary: Introduces DiSC, a context-distillation approach for continually updating LLM knowledge that simultaneously learns new information and preserves post-training capabilities like instruction-following and reasoning.

entry.title: Conjugate Learning Theory: Uncovering the Mechanisms of Trainability and Generalization in Deep Neural Networks

author.name: Binchuan Qi

entry.summary: Develops conjugate learning theory based on convex conjugate duality to characterize DNN trainability and generalization, providing convergence theorems for mini-batch SGD and analyzing the impact of architecture choices on optimization.

entry.title: Learning to Learn from Language Feedback with Social Meta-Learning

author.name: Jonathan Cook, Diego Antognini, Martin Klissarov, Claudiu Musat, Edward Grefenstette

entry.summary: Draws on social meta-learning theory to train LLMs to proactively solicit and learn from conversational feedback, converting static tasks into interactive social learning problems.

entry.title: MerLean: An Agentic Framework for Autoformalization in Quantum Computation

author.name: Yuanjie Ren, Jinzheng Li, Yidi Qi

entry.summary: Introduces MerLean, an automated framework that extracts math from LaTeX, formalizes it into verified Lean 4 code, and translates back to LaTeX, achieving end-to-end formalization on quantum computing papers.

entry.title: Calibrate-Then-Act: Cost-Aware Exploration in LLM Agents

author.name: Wenxuan Ding, Nicholas Tomlin, Greg Durrett

entry.summary: Proposes Calibrate-Then-Act, inducing LLMs to explicitly reason about cost-uncertainty tradeoffs in agentic settings to optimize when to stop exploring and commit to answers.

entry.title: MoE-Spec: Expert Budgeting for Efficient Speculative Decoding

author.name: Bradley McDanel, Steven Li, Sruthikesh Surineni, Harshit Khaitan

entry.summary: Proposes MoE-Spec, a training-free expert budgeting method for speculative decoding of MoE models that enforces fixed expert capacity limits during verification, reducing memory pressure without sacrificing depth.

entry.title: Training-Free Adaptation of Diffusion Models via Doob's $h$-Transform

author.name: Qijie Zhu, Zeqi Ye, Han Liu, Zhaoran Wang, Minshuo Chen

entry.summary: Proposes DOIT, a training-free diffusion model adaptation method based on Doob's h-transform that works with non-differentiable rewards. Provides theoretical guarantees for reward-guided generation without additional training.

entry.title: The Implicit Bias of Adam and Muon on Smooth Homogeneous Neural Networks

author.name: Eitan Gronich, Gal Vardi

entry.summary: Studies the implicit bias of momentum-based optimizers (Adam, Muon, Signum) on homogeneous neural networks, proving they converge to KKT points of corresponding margin maximization problems. Shows Adam maximizes ℓ∞ margin.

entry.title: Learning to Drive in New Cities Without Human Demonstrations

author.name: Zilin Wang, Saeed Rahmani, Daphne Cornelisse, Bidipta Sarkar, Alexander David Goldie, Jakob Nicolaus Foerster, Shimon Whiteson

entry.summary: Introduces NOMAD, showing that self-play multi-agent RL can adapt driving policies to new cities using only maps and meta-information, without human demonstrations. Achieves competitive performance in novel urban environments.

entry.title: Optimal training-conditional regret for online conformal prediction

author.name: Jiadong Liang, Zhimei Ren, Yuxin Chen

entry.summary: Studies online conformal prediction for non-stationary data with unknown distribution drift, achieving minimax-optimal regret for training-conditional cumulative regret under both abrupt change points and smooth drift.

entry.title: VDLM: Variable Diffusion LMs via Robust Latent-to-Text Rendering

author.name: Shuhui Qu

entry.summary: Proposes VDLM, a modular variable diffusion language model that separates semantic planning (via masked diffusion) from text rendering (via Vec2Text), enabling iterative refinement in latent space with RL optimization.

entry.title: ColBERT-Zero: To Pre-train Or Not To Pre-train ColBERT models

author.name: Antoine Chaffin, Luca Arnaboldi, Am\'elie Chatelain, Florent Krzakala

entry.summary: Studies large-scale ColBERT pre-training and shows it yields much stronger multi-vector models. ColBERT-Zero, trained only on public data, sets new SOTA for its model size, outperforming models trained on proprietary data.

entry.title: IRIS: Intent Resolution via Inference-time Saccades for Open-Ended VQA in Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Parsa Madinei, Srijita Karmakar, Russell Cohen Hoffing, Felix Gervitz, Miguel P. Eckstein

entry.summary: Introduces IRIS, using eye-tracking data at inference time to resolve ambiguity in open-ended VQA, more than doubling accuracy on ambiguous questions (35.2% to 77.2%) while maintaining performance on unambiguous ones.

entry.title: How much superposition is there?

author.name: chanind

entry.summary: Analyzes how much superposition (overlapping feature representations) occurs in neural networks, showing that even 16k features in 768-dim space creates more superposition than trillions of features in larger spaces, with geometric analysis of high-dimensional interference.

entry.title: Verifiable Semantics for Agent-to-Agent Communication

author.name: Philipp Schoenegger, Matt Carlson, Chris Schneider, Chris Daly

entry.summary: Proposes a certification protocol for verifiable agent-to-agent communication based on stimulus-meaning testing, where terms are certified if empirical disagreement falls below statistical thresholds. Agents using 'core-guarded reasoning' achieve provably bounded disagreement.

entry.title: Reinforced Fast Weights with Next-Sequence Prediction

author.name: Hee Seung Hwang, Xindi Wu, Sanghyuk Chun, Olga Russakovsky

entry.summary: Introduces REFINE, a reinforcement learning framework for training fast weight models under next-sequence prediction rather than next-token prediction, improving long-range dependency capture while maintaining constant memory.

entry.title: Evidence-Grounded Subspecialty Reasoning: Evaluating a Curated Clinical Intelligence Layer on the 2025 Endocrinology Board-Style Examination

author.name: Amir Hosseinian, MohammadReza Zare Shahneh, Umer Mansoor, Gilbert Szeto, Kirill Karlin, Nima Aghaeepour

entry.summary: Evaluates 'January Mirror,' an evidence-grounded clinical reasoning system, against frontier LLMs (GPT-5, GPT-5.2, Gemini-3-Pro) on endocrinology board exams. Mirror outperformed general-purpose LLMs despite operating without web access, demonstrating value of curated evidence corpora for subspecialty reasoning.

entry.title: The Perplexity Paradox: Why Code Compresses Better Than Math in LLM Prompts

author.name: Warren Johnson

entry.summary: Validates the 'perplexity paradox' showing code tolerates aggressive prompt compression while math reasoning degrades, through per-token perplexity analysis across 10 benchmarks. Proposes an adaptive compression algorithm based on this finding.

entry.title: Building Safe and Deployable Clinical Natural Language Processing under Temporal Leakage Constraints

author.name: Ha Na Cho, Sairam Sutari, Alexander Lopez, Hansen Bow, Kai Zheng

entry.summary: Addresses temporal leakage in clinical NLP models for discharge planning, presenting a lightweight auditing pipeline that identifies when documentation artifacts encode future clinical decisions and inflate predictive performance.

entry.title: FUTURE-VLA: Forecasting Unified Trajectories Under Real-time Execution

author.name: Jingjing Fan, Yushan Liu, Shoujie Li, Botao Ren, Siyuan Li, Xiao-Ping Zhang, Wenbo Ding, Zhidong Deng

entry.summary: Presents FUTURE-VLA, a unified architecture for long-horizon robot control that reformulates control and future forecasting as a single sequence-generation task with temporally adaptive compression for constant inference latency.

entry.title: MAEB: Massive Audio Embedding Benchmark

author.name: Adnan El Assadi, Isaac Chung, Chenghao Xiao, Roman Solomatin, Animesh Jha, Rahul Chand, Silky Singh, Kaitlyn Wang, Ali Sartaz Khan, Marc Moussa Nasser, Sufen Fong, Pengfei He, Alan Xiao, Ayush Sunil Munot, Aditya Shrivastava, Artem Gazizov, Niklas Muennighoff, Kenneth Enevoldsen

entry.summary: Introduces MAEB, a large-scale audio embedding benchmark covering 30 tasks across speech, music, and environmental sounds in 100+ languages, evaluating 50+ models and finding no single model dominates across all tasks.

entry.title: Beyond Learning: A Training-Free Alternative to Model Adaptation

author.name: Namkyung Yoon, Kyeonghyun Yoo, Wooyong Jung, Sanghong Kim, Hwangnam Kim

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free model adaptation approach that identifies and transplants internal modules between language models based on activation patterns, enabling immediate functional changes without fine-tuning.

entry.title: Graphon Mean-Field Subsampling for Cooperative Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Emile Anand, Richard Hoffmann, Sarah Liaw, Adam Wierman

entry.summary: Introduces GMFS, a graphon mean-field subsampling framework for scalable cooperative multi-agent RL with heterogeneous interactions, achieving provable approximation guarantees while subsampling agents by interaction strength.

entry.title: Team of Thoughts: Efficient Test-time Scaling of Agentic Systems through Orchestrated Tool Calling

author.name: Jeffrey T. H. Wong, Zixi Zhang, Junyi Liu, Yiren Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes Team-of-Thoughts, a multi-agent system using heterogeneous models with an orchestrator-tool paradigm, where an orchestrator dynamically activates specialized tool agents based on self-assessed domain expertise.

entry.title: Recursive language models for jailbreak detection: a procedural defense for tool-augmented agents

author.name: Doron Shavit

entry.summary: Presents RLM-JB, a recursive language model framework for jailbreak detection that treats detection as a multi-step procedure rather than one-shot classification, normalizing and chunking inputs for analysis.

entry.title: Causal and Compositional Abstraction

author.name: Robin Lorenz, Sean Tull

entry.summary: Presents a category-theoretic account of causal abstraction that unifies several existing notions including constructive causal abstraction, Q-τ consistency, and interchange interventions.

entry.title: MolCrystalFlow: Molecular Crystal Structure Prediction via Flow Matching

author.name: Cheng Zeng, Harry W. Sullivan, Thomas Egg, Maya M. Martirossyan, Philipp H\"ollmer, Jirui Jin, Richard G. Hennig, Adrian Roitberg, Stefano Martiniani, Ellad B. Tadmor, Mingjie Liu

entry.summary: Presents MolCrystalFlow, a flow-based generative model for molecular crystal structure prediction that disentangles intramolecular and intermolecular complexity using rigid body representations.

entry.title: Why Any-Order Autoregressive Models Need Two-Stream Attention: A Structural-Semantic Tradeoff

author.name: Patrick Pynadath, Ruqi Zhang

entry.summary: Argues that two-stream attention in any-order autoregressive models serves a structural-semantic tradeoff: content-based prediction and position-based summarization compete for attention capacity in a single stream.

entry.title: Discrete Stochastic Localization for Non-autoregressive Generation

author.name: Yunshu Wu, Jiayi Cheng, Partha Thakuria, Rob Brekelmans, Evangelos E. Papalexakis, Greg Ver Steeg

entry.summary: Proposes Discrete Stochastic Localization (DSL) for non-autoregressive text generation, showing that training improvements alone can substantially boost step-efficiency of masked diffusion language model sampling. Achieves competitive results with fewer refinement steps.

entry.title: Factored Latent Action World Models

author.name: Zizhao Wang, Chang Shi, Jiaheng Hu, Kevin Rohling, Roberto Mart\'in-Mart\'in, Amy Zhang, Peter Stone

entry.summary: Introduces FLAM, a factored dynamics framework for latent action world models that decomposes scenes into independent factors, each with its own latent action and prediction. Enables better video generation control in multi-entity environments.

entry.title: Regret and Sample Complexity of Online Q-Learning via Concentration of Stochastic Approximation with Time-Inhomogeneous Markov Chains

author.name: Rahul Singh, Siddharth Chandak, Eric Moulines, Vivek S. Borkar, Nicholas Bambos

entry.summary: Presents the first high-probability regret bound for classical online Q-learning without optimism or bonus terms. Develops a Smoothed ε-Greedy exploration scheme with near-O(N^{9/10}) gap-robust regret, and new concentration results for stochastic approximation with time-inhomogeneous Markov chains.

entry.title: Causality is Key for Interpretability Claims to Generalise

author.name: Shruti Joshi, Aaron Mueller, David Klindt, Wieland Brendel, Patrik Reizinger, Dhanya Sridhar

entry.summary: Argues that causal inference frameworks (Pearl's causal hierarchy) should guide interpretability research on LLMs to avoid common pitfalls of non-generalizing findings and overclaimed causal interpretations.

entry.title: Steering Dynamical Regimes of Diffusion Models by Breaking Detailed Balance

author.name: Haiqi Lu, Ying Tang

entry.summary: Shows that breaking detailed balance in diffusion processes can accelerate reverse sampling without changing the stationary distribution. Constructs exponentially optimal non-reversible perturbations and analyzes effects on phase transitions in generative diffusion.

entry.title: Visual Memory Injection Attacks for Multi-Turn Conversations

author.name: Christian Schlarmann, Matthias Hein

entry.summary: Introduces Visual Memory Injection (VMI), a stealthy attack on multi-turn LVLMs where manipulated images cause nominal behavior on normal prompts but output prescribed target messages on trigger prompts.

entry.title: The Limits of Long-Context Reasoning in Automated Bug Fixing

author.name: Ravi Raju, Mengmeng Ji, Shubhangi Upasani, Bo Li, Urmish Thakker

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates whether current LLMs can perform long-context code debugging, finding that performance degrades significantly when required to reason over full repository context vs. agentic approaches. Tests GPT-5-nano and Deepseek-R1.

entry.title: CHAI: CacHe Attention Inference for text2video

author.name: Joel Mathew Cherian, Ashutosh Muralidhara Bharadwaj, Vima Gupta, Anand Padmanabha Iyer

entry.summary: CHAI introduces cross-inference caching for text-to-video diffusion models to reduce latency while maintaining quality. Uses Cache Attention to attend to shared objects/scenes across semantically related prompts, enabling high cache hit rates.

entry.title: Separating Oblivious and Adaptive Models of Variable Selection

author.name: Ziyun Chen, Jerry Li, Kevin Tian, Yusong Zhu

entry.summary: Proves a separation between oblivious and adaptive models of ℓ∞ sparse recovery: oblivious requires ~k log d samples while adaptive requires ~k² samples, settling an open question about variable selection.

entry.title: Synthetic-Powered Multiple Testing with FDR Control

author.name: Yonghoon Lee, Meshi Bashari, Edgar Dobriban, Yaniv Romano

entry.summary: Introduces SynthBH, a multiple hypothesis testing procedure that leverages synthetic/auxiliary data while maintaining finite-sample, distribution-free FDR control under mild dependence conditions.

entry.title: TabAgent: A Framework for Replacing Agentic Generative Components with Tabular-Textual Classifiers

author.name: Ido Levy, Eilam Shapira, Yinon Goldshtein, Avi Yaeli, Nir Mashkif, Segev Shlomov

entry.summary: Proposes TabAgent, a framework for replacing LLM-based decision components in agentic systems with compact tabular-textual classifiers trained on execution traces, reducing latency and cost.

entry.title: Evaluating Demographic Misrepresentation in Image-to-Image Portrait Editing

author.name: Huichan Seo, Minki Hong, Sieun Choi, Jihie Kim, Jean Oh

entry.summary: Examines demographic bias in instruction-guided image-to-image editing, formalizing two failure modes: Soft Erasure (edits silently weakened) and Stereotype Replacement (unrequested stereotype-consistent attributes added).

entry.title: MMA: Multimodal Memory Agent

author.name: Yihao Lu, Wanru Cheng, Zeyu Zhang, Hao Tang

entry.summary: Introduces MMA (Multimodal Memory Agent) with dynamic reliability scoring for retrieved memory items, and MMA-Bench benchmark. Discovers the 'Visual Placebo Effect' where RAG-based agents inherit latent biases from retrieved content.

entry.title: Learning Humanoid End-Effector Control for Open-Vocabulary Visual Loco-Manipulation

author.name: Runpei Dong, Ziyan Li, Xialin He, Saurabh Gupta

entry.summary: Presents HERO, a framework for humanoid robot loco-manipulation that combines large vision models for scene understanding with simulated training for end-effector tracking control, enabling open-vocabulary object manipulation.

entry.title: One Hand to Rule Them All: Canonical Representations for Unified Dexterous Manipulation

author.name: Zhenyu Wei, Yunchao Yao, Mingyu Ding

entry.summary: Introduces a canonical representation that unifies diverse dexterous hand architectures through a parameterized space and canonical URDF format, enabling policies that generalize across different hand morphologies.

entry.title: Why we should expect ruthless sociopath ASI

author.name: Steven Byrnes

entry.summary: Steven Byrnes argues that default ASI should be expected to be a 'ruthless sociopath' based on training dynamics and optimization pressure, using a Socratic dialogue format to address common counterarguments from human and LLM behavior.

entry.title: On the Hardness of Approximation of the Fair k-Center Problem

author.name: Suhas Thejaswi

entry.summary: Proves that the fair k-center problem cannot be approximated within factor (3-ε) in polynomial time assuming P≠NP, resolving an open question about the tightness of the known 3-approximation.

entry.title: Toward Scalable Verifiable Reward: Proxy State-Based Evaluation for Multi-turn Tool-Calling LLM Agents

author.name: Yun-Shiuan Chuang, Chaitanya Kulkarni, Alec Chiu, Avinash Thangali, Zijie Pan, Shivani Shekhar, Yirou Ge, Yixi Li, Uma Kona, Linsey Pang, Prakhar Mehrotra

entry.summary: Proposes Proxy State-Based Evaluation, an LLM-driven simulation framework for evaluating multi-turn tool-calling agents that uses LLM state trackers instead of deterministic backends, reducing the cost of building evaluation environments.

entry.title: Do Personality Traits Interfere? Geometric Limitations of Steering in Large Language Models

author.name: Pranav Bhandari, Usman Naseem, Mehwish Nasim

entry.summary: Analyzes geometric relationships between Big Five personality steering vectors in LLMs, finding substantial dependence where steering one trait consistently changes others even when linear overlap is removed, challenging the assumption of independent trait control.

entry.title: State Design Matters: How Representations Shape Dynamic Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Annie Wong, Aske Plaat, Thomas B\"ack, Niki van Stein, Anna V. Kononova

entry.summary: Systematically studies how state representation design (granularity, structure, spatial grounding) affects LLM performance in dynamic environments, finding that trajectory summarization and natural language representations improve sequential decision-making.

entry.title: Language Statistics and False Belief Reasoning: Evidence from 41 Open-Weight LMs

author.name: Sean Trott, Samuel Taylor, Cameron Jones, James A. Michaelov, Pamela D. Rivi\`ere

entry.summary: Tests false belief reasoning across 41 open-weight LMs, finding sensitivity to implied knowledge states in only 34% of models, with none fully explaining away false-belief behavior through surface-level statistical patterns.

entry.title: Long-Tail Knowledge in Large Language Models: Taxonomy, Mechanisms, Interventions and Implications

author.name: Sanket Badhe, Deep Shah, Nehal Kathrotia

entry.summary: Provides a structured taxonomy of long-tail knowledge in LLMs across four axes: definition, mechanisms of loss, intervention strategies, and sociotechnical implications. Surveys how infrequent knowledge is lost or distorted during training.

entry.title: A Graph Meta-Network for Learning on Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks

author.name: Guy Bar-Shalom, Ami Tavory, Itay Evron, Maya Bechler-Speicher, Ido Guy, Haggai Maron

entry.summary: Develops WS-KAN, the first weight-space architecture for learning on Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks by analyzing their permutation symmetries and proposing a graph representation of KAN computation.

entry.title: Articulated 3D Scene Graphs for Open-World Mobile Manipulation

author.name: Martin B\"uchner, Adrian R\"ofer, Tim Engelbracht, Tim Welschehold, Zuria Bauer, Hermann Blum, Marc Pollefeys, Abhinav Valada

entry.summary: Introduces MoMa-SG, a framework for building semantic-kinematic 3D scene graphs of articulated scenes from RGB-D sequences, enabling robots to understand how objects move for mobile manipulation.

entry.title: FlowPrefill: Decoupling Preemption from Prefill Scheduling Granularity to Mitigate Head-of-Line Blocking in LLM Serving

author.name: Chia-chi Hsieh, Zan Zong, Xinyang Chen, Jianjiang Li, Jidong Zhai, Lijie Wen

entry.summary: Proposes FlowPrefill, an adaptive preemption mechanism for LLM serving that decouples preemption from prefill scheduling granularity to mitigate head-of-line blocking while maintaining throughput.

entry.title: Multi-Objective Alignment of Language Models for Personalized Psychotherapy

author.name: Mehrab Beikzadeh, Yasaman Asadollah Salmanpour, Ashima Suvarna, Sriram Sankararaman, Matteo Malgaroli, Majid Sarrafzadeh, Saadia Gabriel

entry.summary: Develops a multi-objective alignment framework for therapeutic LLMs, training reward models across six criteria (empathy, safety, etc.) based on a survey of 335 individuals with mental health experience.

entry.title: Beyond SGD, Without SVD: Proximal Subspace Iteration LoRA with Diagonal Fractional K-FAC

author.name: Abdulla Jasem Almansoori, Maria Ivanova, Andrey Veprikov, Aleksandr Beznosikov, Samuel Horv\'ath, Martin Tak\'a\v{c}

entry.summary: Proposes LoRSum, a memory-efficient approach that closes the gap between SVDLoRA and standard LoRA fine-tuning using proximal subspace iteration with diagonal fractional K-FAC preconditioning. Shows connection to implicit block power method.

entry.title: Synthesis and Verification of Transformer Programs

author.name: Hongjian Jiang, Matthew Hague, Philipp R\"ummer, Anthony Widjaja Lin

entry.summary: Develops techniques for automatically verifying C-RASP programs (capturing transformer-expressible concepts) by connecting to synchronous dataflow program verification in Lustre. Also provides a new learning algorithm for C-RASPs from examples.

entry.title: Sequential Membership Inference Attacks

author.name: Thomas Michel, Debabrota Basu, Emilie Kaufmann

entry.summary: Develops SeMI*, an optimal membership inference attack that exploits sequences of model updates to identify training data presence. Derives optimal power bounds for finite samples with and without privacy.

entry.title: Can Vision-Language Models See Squares? Text-Recognition Mediates Spatial Reasoning Across Three Model Families

author.name: Yuval Levental

entry.summary: Demonstrates that frontier VLMs (Claude Opus, ChatGPT 5.2, Gemini 3) can transcribe text-symbol grids well but collapse on filled-square grids without text, revealing that spatial reasoning is mediated by text recognition.

entry.title: Surgical Activation Steering via Generative Causal Mediation

author.name: Aruna Sankaranarayanan, Amir Zur, Atticus Geiger, Dylan Hadfield-Menell

entry.summary: Introduces Generative Causal Mediation (GCM) for selecting model components to steer binary concepts in LLMs from contrastive long-form responses, evaluated on refusal, sycophancy, and style transfer.

entry.title: Ratio Covers of Convex Sets and Optimal Mixture Density Estimation

author.name: Spencer Compton, G\'abor Lugosi, Jaouad Mourtada, Jian Qian, Nikita Zhivotovskiy

entry.summary: Studies density estimation in KL divergence for mixture models with finite dictionaries, identifying optimal high-probability guarantees for both model and convex aggregation settings. Makes no assumptions on base density ratios or support overlap.

entry.title: Functional Decomposition and Shapley Interactions for Interpreting Survival Models

author.name: Sophie Hanna Langbein, Hubert Baniecki, Fabian Fumagalli, Niklas Koenen, Marvin N. Wright, Julia Herbinger

entry.summary: Introduces SurvFD for analyzing feature interactions in survival models by decomposing higher-order effects into time-dependent and time-independent components, and proposes SurvSHAP-IQ extending Shapley interactions to survival analysis.

entry.title: Are Object-Centric Representations Better At Compositional Generalization?

author.name: Ferdinand Kapl, Amir Mohammad Karimi Mamaghan, Maximilian Seitzer, Karl Henrik Johansson, Carsten Marr, Stefan Bauer, Andrea Dittadi

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates whether object-centric representations improve compositional generalization in visual question answering across three controlled visual worlds, providing rigorous comparisons against standard vision encoders.

entry.title: Reranker Optimization via Geodesic Distances on k-NN Manifolds

author.name: Wen G. Gong

entry.summary: Proposes Maniscope, a geometric reranking method using geodesic distances on k-NN manifolds for RAG, outperforming HNSW baselines on hard datasets while being orders of magnitude faster than cross-encoder rerankers.

entry.title: Visual Self-Refine: A Pixel-Guided Paradigm for Accurate Chart Parsing

author.name: Jinsong Li, Xiaoyi Dong, Yuhang Zang, Yuhang Cao, Jiaqi Wang, Dahua Lin

entry.summary: Proposes Visual Self-Refine (VSR), a paradigm for chart parsing where a vision-language model generates pixel-level localizations, visualizes them, and feeds visualizations back to itself for self-correction - inspired by humans using a finger as a visual anchor when reading charts.

entry.title: Creating a digital poet

author.name: Vered Tohar, Tsahi Hayat, Amir Leshem

entry.summary: Reports a seven-month poetry workshop shaping an LLM into a digital poet through iterative expert feedback without retraining. In blinded tests with 50 humanities students, judgments between AI and human poems were at chance level (~50%).

entry.title: Rethinking Soft Compression in Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Query-Conditioned Selector Perspective

author.name: Yunhao Liu, Zian Jia, Xinyu Gao, Kanjun Xu, Yun Xiong

entry.summary: Rethinks soft context compression in RAG, revealing two fundamental limitations of full-compression approaches and proposing a query-conditioned selector that only compresses relevant information.

entry.title: Transforming GenAI Policy to Prompting Instruction: An RCT of Scalable Prompting Interventions in a CS1 Course

author.name: Ruiwei Xiao, Runlong Ye, Xinying Hou, Jessica Wen, Harsh Kumar, Michael Liut, John Stamper

entry.summary: Conducts a semester-long RCT (N=979) testing ICAP framework-based interventions for teaching CS1 students to prompt AI as a tutor rather than solution provider, finding progressive engagement improves prompting skills.

entry.title: Geometric Neural Operators via Lie Group-Constrained Latent Dynamics

author.name: Jiaquan Zhang, Fachrina Dewi Puspitasari, Songbo Zhang, Yibei Liu, Kuien Liu, Caiyan Qin, Fan Mo, Peng Wang, Yang Yang, Chaoning Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MCL, a plug-and-play module that constrains neural operator latent spaces using Lie group parameterization, enforcing geometric and conservation laws to improve stability in multi-layer iteration and long-horizon rollouts.

entry.title: Interpretability-by-Design with Accurate Locally Additive Models and Conditional Feature Effects

author.name: Vasilis Gkolemis, Loukas Kavouras, Dimitrios Kyriakopoulos, Konstantinos Tsopelas, Dimitrios Rontogiannis, Giuseppe Casalicchio, Theodore Dalamagas, Christos Diou

entry.summary: Proposes CALMs (Conditionally Additive Local Models), which allow multiple shape functions per feature activated in different input regions, balancing GAM interpretability with GA²M accuracy.

entry.title: Who can we trust? LLM-as-a-jury for Comparative Assessment

author.name: Mengjie Qian, Guangzhi Sun, Mark J. F. Gales, Kate M. Knill

entry.summary: Proposes BT-sigma, an LLM-as-a-jury framework for comparative assessment that addresses inconsistencies in LLM comparison probabilities through a Bradley-Terry model without requiring human supervision.

entry.title: Almost Sure Convergence of Differential Temporal Difference Learning for Average Reward Markov Decision Processes

author.name: Ethan Blaser, Jiuqi Wang, Shangtong Zhang

entry.summary: Proves almost sure convergence of on-policy n-step differential TD learning for average reward MDPs using standard diminishing learning rates, removing the restrictive local clock requirement.

entry.title: Bayesian Quadrature: Gaussian Processes for Integration

author.name: Maren Mahsereci, Toni Karvonen

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of Bayesian quadrature (probabilistic numerical integration using Gaussian processes), providing systematic taxonomy, theoretical guarantees, and controlled numerical study. Fills a gap as no prior comprehensive treatment exists.

entry.title: Optimizer choice matters for the emergence of Neural Collapse

author.name: Jim Zhao, Tin Sum Cheng, Wojciech Masarczyk, Aurelien Lucchi

entry.summary: Demonstrates that optimizer choice critically affects the emergence of Neural Collapse in deep networks, challenging the assumption that NC is universal across optimization methods. Introduces NC0 diagnostic metric.

entry.title: Quality-constrained Entropy Maximization Policy Optimization for LLM Diversity

author.name: Haihui Pan, Yuzhong Hong, Shaoke Lv, Junwei Bao, Hongfei Jiang, Yang Song

entry.summary: Proposes QEMPO for maximizing LLM output diversity while maintaining quality, decomposing alignment into quality and diversity distributions and using constrained entropy maximization.

entry.title: CLAA: Cross-Layer Attention Aggregation for Accelerating LLM Prefill

author.name: Bradley McDanel, Steven Li, Harshit Khaitan

entry.summary: Introduces CLAA for accelerating LLM prefill by aggregating cross-layer attention information for stable token importance estimation, plus an Answer-Informed Oracle for ground-truth evaluation of token-ranking quality.

entry.title: BAT: Better Audio Transformer Guided by Convex Gated Probing

author.name: Houtan Ghaffari, Lukas Rauch, Christoph Scholz, Paul Devos

entry.summary: Introduces Convex Gated Probing (CGP) for evaluating audio self-supervised learning embeddings, closing the gap between fine-tuning and probing in audio. Also presents BAT, a Better Audio Transformer guided by CGP.

entry.title: Gated Tree Cross-attention for Checkpoint-Compatible Syntax Injection in Decoder-Only LLMs

author.name: Xinyu Gao, Shaonan Wang, Nai Ding

entry.summary: Introduces Gated Tree Cross-Attention (GTCA), a checkpoint-compatible branch for injecting explicit syntactic structure into decoder-only LLMs without modifying the backbone, using precomputed constituency chunk memory.

entry.title: Mitigating Gradient Inversion Risks in Language Models via Token Obfuscation

author.name: Xinguo Feng, Zhongkui Ma, Zihan Wang, Alsharif Abuadbba, Guangdong Bai

entry.summary: Introduces GHOST, a token-level obfuscation defense against gradient inversion attacks that decouples the mapping between gradient, embedding, and token spaces to protect privacy in collaborative learning.

entry.title: MultiCW: A Large-Scale Balanced Benchmark Dataset for Training Robust Check-Worthiness Detection Models

author.name: Martin Hyben, Sebastian Kula, Jan Cegin, Jakub Simko, Ivan Srba, Robert Moro

entry.summary: Introduces MultiCW, a balanced multilingual benchmark for check-worthy claim detection spanning 16 languages, 7 domains, and 2 writing styles with 123K samples plus an out-of-distribution evaluation set.

entry.title: AREG: Adversarial Resource Extraction Game for Evaluating Persuasion and Resistance in Large Language Models

author.name: Adib Sakhawat, Fardeen Sadab

entry.summary: Introduces AREG, an adversarial negotiation game benchmark for evaluating persuasion and resistance capabilities of LLMs, finding these capabilities are weakly correlated (ρ=0.33).

entry.title: Learning Situated Awareness in the Real World

author.name: Chuhan Li, Ruilin Han, Joy Hsu, Yongyuan Liang, Rajiv Dhawan, Jiajun Wu, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Xin Eric Wang

entry.summary: Introduces SAW-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating egocentric situated awareness using real-world videos captured with Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses. It evaluates observer-centric spatial reasoning rather than just environment-centric object relations.

entry.title: Saliency-Aware Multi-Route Thinking: Revisiting Vision-Language Reasoning

author.name: Mingjia Shi, Yinhan He, Yaochen Zhu, Jundong Li

entry.summary: Proposes Saliency-Aware Multi-Route Thinking for VLMs that addresses the problem of reasoning becoming text-dominated as visual inputs fade during autoregressive generation. Uses saliency to guide visual grounding throughout long reasoning chains.

entry.title: Leveraging Large Language Models for Causal Discovery: a Constraint-based, Argumentation-driven Approach

author.name: Zihao Li, Fabrizio Russo

entry.summary: Explores using LLMs as imperfect experts for causal discovery through Assumption-based Argumentation (ABA), combining LLM-elicited semantic structural priors with statistical methods for principled causal graph construction.

entry.title: Preference Optimization for Review Question Generation Improves Writing Quality

author.name: Karun Sharma, Vidushee Vats, Shengzhi Li, Yuxiang Wang, Zhongtian Sun, Prayag Tiwari

entry.summary: Develops IntelliReward, a reward model for peer review question generation, and IntelliAsk, a question-generation model trained with DAPO that produces deeper, evidence-based review questions rather than surface-level queries.

entry.title: OmniCT: Towards a Unified Slice-Volume LVLM for Comprehensive CT Analysis

author.name: Tianwei Lin, Zhongwei Qiu, Wenqiao Zhang, Jiang Liu, Yihan Xie, Mingjian Gao, Zhenxuan Fan, Zhaocheng Li, Sijing Li, Zhongle Xie, Peng LU, Yueting Zhuang, Yingda Xia, Ling Zhang, Beng Chin Ooi

entry.summary: Proposes OmniCT, a unified slice-volume large vision-language model for comprehensive CT analysis that bridges the gap between slice-driven local features and volume-driven spatial representations.

entry.title: The Diversity Paradox revisited: Systemic Effects of Feedback Loops in Recommender Systems

author.name: Gabriele Barlacchi, Margherita Lalli, Emanuele Ferragina, Fosca Giannotti, Dino Pedreschi, Luca Pappalardo

entry.summary: Proposes an improved feedback-loop simulation model for recommender systems that captures implicit feedback, periodic retraining, and heterogeneous recommenders. Finds increased recommender adoption can diversify individual consumption while redistributing collective demand.

entry.title: GICDM: Mitigating Hubness for Reliable Distance-Based Generative Model Evaluation

author.name: Nicolas Salvy, Hugues Talbot, Bertrand Thirion

entry.summary: Introduces GICDM, a method to correct hubness-induced distortions in distance-based generative model evaluation metrics, improving alignment with human judgment.

entry.title: SPARC: Scenario Planning and Reasoning for Automated C Unit Test Generation

author.name: Jaid Monwar Chowdhury, Chi-An Fu, Reyhaneh Jabbarvand

entry.summary: Introduces SPARC, a neuro-symbolic framework for automated C unit test generation that bridges the gap between high-level program intent and low-level C constraints through scenario-based reasoning.

entry.title: Geometry-Aware Uncertainty Quantification via Conformal Prediction on Manifolds

author.name: Marzieh Amiri Shahbazi, Ali Baheri

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive geodesic conformal prediction for Riemannian manifold-valued outputs, replacing Euclidean residuals with geodesic nonconformity scores for geometry-aware uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: Improved Bounds for Reward-Agnostic and Reward-Free Exploration

author.name: Oran Ridel, Alon Cohen

entry.summary: Proposes improved algorithms for reward-free and reward-agnostic exploration in episodic MDPs, significantly relaxing requirements on the accuracy parameter ε compared to prior work. Uses a novel online learning approach.

entry.title: MARVL: Multi-Stage Guidance for Robotic Manipulation via Vision-Language Models

author.name: Xunlan Zhou, Xuanlin Chen, Shaowei Zhang, Xiangkun Li, ShengHua Wan, Xiaohai Hu, Yuan Lei, Le Gan, De-chuan Zhan

entry.summary: Introduces MARVL, which fine-tunes VLMs for spatial and semantic consistency to design dense reward functions for robotic RL, decomposing tasks into multi-stage subtasks with task direction projection.

entry.title: Partial Identification under Missing Data Using Weak Shadow Variables from Pretrained Models

author.name: Hongyu Chen, David Simchi-Levi, Ruoxuan Xiong

entry.summary: Develops a partial identification framework using predictions from pretrained models as 'weak shadow variables' to obtain sharp bounds when feedback is missing not at random, solving linear programs constrained by observed data.

entry.title: LGQ: Learning Discretization Geometry for Scalable and Stable Image Tokenization

author.name: Idil Bilge Altun, Mert Onur Cakiroglu, Elham Buxton, Mehmet Dalkilic, Hasan Kurban

entry.summary: Introduces Learnable Geometric Quantization (LGQ) for discrete image tokenization that learns flexible discretization geometry while maintaining stable codebook utilization, bridging VQ and scalar quantization approaches.

entry.title: Missing-by-Design: Certifiable Modality Deletion for Revocable Multimodal Sentiment Analysis

author.name: Rong Fu, Wenxin Zhang, Ziming Wang, Chunlei Meng, Jiaxuan Lu, Jiekai Wu, Kangan Qian, Hao Zhang, Simon Fong

entry.summary: Presents Missing-by-Design (MBD), a framework for revocable multimodal sentiment analysis that allows selective deletion of specific data modalities for privacy compliance. Combines structured representation learning with certifiable parameter modification.

entry.title: Variable-Length Semantic IDs for Recommender Systems

author.name: Kirill Khrylchenko

entry.summary: Proposes variable-length semantic IDs for recommender systems, where items are represented as variable-length token sequences rather than fixed-length, improving efficiency and alignment with natural language.

entry.title: Understanding LLM Failures: A Multi-Tape Turing Machine Analysis of Systematic Errors in Language Model Reasoning

author.name: Magnus Boman

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-tape Turing machine formalization of LLM interaction to precisely localize failure modes to specific pipeline stages, explaining why certain tasks fail and why chain-of-thought helps.

entry.title: Every Little Helps: Building Knowledge Graph Foundation Model with Fine-grained Transferable Multi-modal Tokens

author.name: Yichi Zhang, Zhuo Chen, Lingbing Guo, Wen Zhang, Huajun Chen

entry.summary: Proposes TOFU, a token-based foundation model for multimodal knowledge graph reasoning that discretizes structural, visual, and textual information into modality-specific tokens with hierarchical fusion for cross-KG transfer.

entry.title: Supercharging Agenda Setting Research: The ParlaCAP Dataset of 28 European Parliaments and a Scalable Multilingual LLM-Based Classification

author.name: Taja Kuzman Punger\v{s}ek, Peter Rupnik, Daniela \v{S}irini\'c, Nikola Ljube\v{s}i\'c

entry.summary: Introduces ParlaCAP, a large-scale dataset of 8M parliamentary speeches from 28 European parliaments classified by policy topics using an LLM teacher-student framework.

entry.title: Lyapunov Spectral Analysis of Speech Embedding Trajectories in Psychosis

author.name: Jelena Vasic, Branislav Andjelic, Ana Mancic, Dusica Filipovic Djurdjevic, Ljiljana Mihic, Aleksandar Kovacevic, Nadja P. Maric, Aleksandra Maluckov

entry.summary: Analyzes speech embeddings from clinical interviews of psychotic patients using Lyapunov exponent spectra, treating language production as a dynamical process. Successfully separates psychotic from healthy speech.

entry.title: Non-Contact Physiological Monitoring in Pediatric Intensive Care Units via Adaptive Masking and Self-Supervised Learning

author.name: Mohamed Khalil Ben Salah, Philippe Jouvet, Rita Noumeir

entry.summary: Introduces a self-supervised pretraining framework for remote photoplethysmography in pediatric ICUs using progressive curriculum learning with VisionMamba architecture and adaptive masking for occlusions.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Guided Inference-Time Depth Adaptation for Transformer-Based Visual Tracking

author.name: Patrick Poggi, Divake Kumar, Theja Tulabandhula, Amit Ranjan Trivedi

entry.summary: Proposes UncL-STARK, enabling dynamic uncertainty-aware depth adaptation in transformer-based visual trackers at inference time without modifying the architecture, using random-depth training with knowledge distillation.

entry.title: ReMoRa: Multimodal Large Language Model based on Refined Motion Representation for Long-Video Understanding

author.name: Daichi Yashima, Shuhei Kurita, Yusuke Oda, Komei Sugiura

entry.summary: Proposes ReMoRa, a video MLLM that processes videos using compressed representations - sparse RGB keyframes for appearance plus motion representations for temporal dynamics, avoiding the need to process full frame sequences.

entry.title: The near-term potential of AI forecasting for public epistemics

author.name: Lawrence Phillips

entry.summary: Argues that AI forecasting capabilities are approaching a point where they could revolutionize public epistemics, but warns against simply automating existing prediction market designs. Advocates for AI-native forecasting platforms optimized for coordinated knowledge production.

entry.title: Kalman-Inspired Runtime Stability and Recovery in Hybrid Reasoning Systems

author.name: Barak Or

entry.summary: Models hybrid reasoning system stability from a Kalman filter perspective, introducing 'cognitive drift' as a measurable runtime phenomenon and defining stability in terms of detectability, bounded divergence, and recoverability.

entry.title: How to Label Resynthesized Audio: The Dual Role of Neural Audio Codecs in Audio Deepfake Detection

author.name: Yixuan Xiao, Florian Lux, Alejandro P\'erez-Gonz\'alez-de-Martos, Ngoc Thang Vu

entry.summary: Examines the dual role of neural audio codecs in deepfake detection: whether codec-resynthesized audio should be labeled bonafide or spoof. Presents a challenging extension of the ASVspoof 5 dataset.

entry.title: Learning Distributed Equilibria in Linear-Quadratic Stochastic Differential Games: An $\alpha$-Potential Approach

author.name: Philipp Plank, Yufei Zhang

entry.summary: Analyzes independent policy-gradient learning in N-player linear-quadratic stochastic differential games, establishing global linear convergence via an α-potential structure with complexity scaling linearly in population size.

entry.title: ReasonNavi: Human-Inspired Global Map Reasoning for Zero-Shot Embodied Navigation

author.name: Yuzhuo Ao, Anbang Wang, Yu-Wing Tai, Chi-Keung Tang

entry.summary: Introduces ReasonNavi, a framework for embodied navigation that mirrors human map-based planning by coupling MLLMs with deterministic planners. Converts top-down maps into discrete reasoning spaces where MLLMs identify target locations before local planning.

entry.title: GPSBench: Do Large Language Models Understand GPS Coordinates?

author.name: Thinh Hung Truong, Jey Han Lau, Jianzhong Qi

entry.summary: Introduces GPSBench, a 57,800-sample benchmark evaluating LLM geospatial reasoning across 17 tasks including geometric coordinate operations and world knowledge integration. Tests 14 SOTA LLMs and finds GPS reasoning remains challenging with substantial performance variation.

entry.title: Framework of Thoughts: A Foundation Framework for Dynamic and Optimized Reasoning based on Chains, Trees, and Graphs

author.name: Felix Fricke, Simon Malberg, Georg Groh

entry.summary: Introduces Framework of Thoughts (FoT), a general-purpose foundation framework for building and optimizing dynamic reasoning schemes that unifies Chain of Thought, Tree of Thoughts, and Graph of Thoughts with built-in hyperparameter tuning and prompt optimization.

entry.title: Understand Then Memory: A Cognitive Gist-Driven RAG Framework with Global Semantic Diffusion

author.name: Pengcheng Zhou, Haochen Li, Zhiqiang Nie, JiaLe Chen, Qing Gong, Weizhen Zhang, Chun Yu

entry.summary: Proposes CogitoRAG, a cognitively-inspired RAG framework that simulates human episodic memory through Semantic Gist extraction and a multi-dimensional knowledge graph integrating entities, relational facts, and memory nodes.

entry.title: EarthSpatialBench: Benchmarking Spatial Reasoning Capabilities of Multimodal LLMs on Earth Imagery

author.name: Zelin Xu, Yupu Zhang, Saugat Adhikari, Saiful Islam, Tingsong Xiao, Zibo Liu, Shigang Chen, Da Yan, Zhe Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces EarthSpatialBench for benchmarking spatial reasoning in multimodal LLMs on Earth imagery, covering quantitative distance/direction/topology reasoning with georeferenced grounding.

entry.title: B-DENSE: Branching For Dense Ensemble Network Learning

author.name: Cherish Puniani, Tushar Kumar, Arnav Bendre, Gaurav Kumar, Shree Singhi

entry.summary: Proposes B-DENSE, a multi-branch trajectory alignment framework for accelerating diffusion model sampling by leveraging intermediate teacher trajectory steps during student distillation.

entry.title: MedProbCLIP: Probabilistic Adaptation of Vision-Language Foundation Model for Reliable Radiograph-Report Retrieval

author.name: Ahmad Elallaf, Yu Zhang, Yuktha Priya Masupalli, Jeong Yang, Young Lee, Zechun Cao, Gongbo Liang

entry.summary: Introduces MedProbCLIP, a probabilistic vision-language framework for chest X-ray and radiology report retrieval that models representations as Gaussian embeddings to capture uncertainty and many-to-many correspondences.

entry.title: Omni-iEEG: A Large-Scale, Comprehensive iEEG Dataset and Benchmark for Epilepsy Research

author.name: Chenda Duan, Yipeng Zhang, Sotaro Kanai, Yuanyi Ding, Atsuro Daida, Pengyue Yu, Tiancheng Zheng, Naoto Kuroda, Shaun A. Hussain, Eishi Asano, Hiroki Nariai, Vwani Roychowdhury

entry.summary: Introduces Omni-iEEG, a large-scale standardized intracranial EEG dataset with pathological event annotations across multiple centers, providing benchmarks for epilepsy research including seizure detection and localization.

entry.title: Rethinking ANN-based Retrieval: Multifaceted Learnable Index for Large-scale Recommendation System

author.name: Jiang Zhang, Yubo Wang, Wei Chang, Lu Han, Xingying Cheng, Feng Zhang, Min Li, Songhao Jiang, Wei Zheng, Harry Tran, Zhen Wang, Lei Chen, Yueming Wang, Benyu Zhang, Xiangjun Fan, Bi Xue, Qifan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a multifaceted learnable index that jointly learns item embeddings and indices for recommendation system retrieval, addressing limitations of separate ANN indexing stages and per-request computation costs.

entry.title: Are LLMs Ready to Replace Bangla Annotators?

author.name: Md. Najib Hasan, Touseef Hasan, Souvika Sarkar

entry.summary: Benchmarks 17 LLMs as zero-shot annotators for Bangla hate speech detection, finding substantial bias and instability, with smaller task-aligned models often outperforming larger ones.

entry.title: R$^2$Energy: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Robust Renewable Energy Forecasting under Diverse and Extreme Conditions

author.name: Zhi Sheng, Yuan Yuan, Guozhen Zhang, Yong Li

entry.summary: Presents R²Energy, a large-scale benchmark with 10.7M hourly records from 902 stations for robust renewable energy forecasting under diverse and extreme weather conditions.

entry.title: Differentially Private Non-convex Distributionally Robust Optimization

author.name: Difei Xu, Meng Ding, Zebin Ma, Huanyi Xie, Youming Tao, Aicha Slaitane, Di Wang

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive study of differentially private distributionally robust optimization (DP-DRO) for non-convex settings, bridging the gap between DP-ERM and the more challenging minimax DRO structure.

entry.title: Deep TPC: Temporal-Prior Conditioning for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Filippos Bellos, NaveenJohn Premkumar, Yannis Avrithis, Nam H. Nguyen, Jason J. Corso

entry.summary: Introduces Temporal-Prior Conditioning (TPC) that treats time as a first-class modality in LLM-based time series forecasting, using cross-attention at multiple depths to inject temporal information from human-readable descriptors.

entry.title: Learning with Locally Private Examples by Inverse Weierstrass Private Stochastic Gradient Descent

author.name: Jean Dufraiche, Paul Mangold, Micha\"el Perrot, Marc Tommasi

entry.summary: Leverages the Weierstrass transform to characterize and correct bias in binary classification under local differential privacy, building a novel SGD algorithm (IWP-SGD) that converges to the true population risk minimizer at O(1/n) rate.

entry.title: Vulnerability Analysis of Safe Reinforcement Learning via Inverse Constrained Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jialiang Fan, Shixiong Jiang, Mengyu Liu, Fanxin Kong

entry.summary: Proposes an adversarial attack framework for safe RL policies using inverse constrained RL, enabling gradient-based attacks through learned constraint models and surrogate policies without requiring access to the target policy's gradients.

entry.title: RIDER: 3D RNA Inverse Design with Reinforcement Learning-Guided Diffusion

author.name: Tianmeng Hu, Yongzheng Cui, Biao Luo, Ke Li

entry.summary: Proposes RIDER, an RNA inverse design framework combining GNN-based diffusion models with reinforcement learning to directly optimize for 3D structural similarity rather than sequence recovery, achieving 9% improvement in pre-training.

entry.title: MadEvolve: Evolutionary Optimization of Cosmological Algorithms with Large Language Models

author.name: Tianyi Li, Shihui Zang, Moritz M\"unchmeyer

entry.summary: Develops MadEvolve, an AlphaEvolve-like framework for discovering scientific algorithms in computational cosmology, with emphasis on free parameter optimization and automatic report generation.

entry.title: Examining Fast Radiative Feedbacks Using Machine-Learning Weather Emulators

author.name: Ankur Mahesh, William D. Collins, Travis A. O'Brien, Paul B. Goddard, Sinclaire Zebaze, Shashank Subramanian, James P. C. Duncan, Oliver Watt-Meyer, Boris Bonev, Thorsten Kurth, Karthik Kashinath, Michael S. Pritchard, Da Yang

entry.summary: Uses ML weather emulators to examine fast radiative feedbacks in climate, showing these feedbacks are already present in historical reanalyses used for training. Tests multiple emulators on feedback physics.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Combinatorial-Multi-Armed-Bandit framework for the Submodular Welfare Problem under Bandit Feedback

author.name: Subham Pokhriyal, Shweta Jain, Vaneet Aggarwal

entry.summary: Studies the Submodular Welfare Problem under bandit feedback with non-communicating agents sharing allocation constraints. Proposes an explore-then-commit strategy achieving O(T^{2/3}) regret against a (1-1/e) approximation benchmark.

entry.title: Subtractive Modulative Network with Learnable Periodic Activations

author.name: Tiou Wang, Zhuoqian Yang, Markus Flierl, Mathieu Salzmann, Sabine S\"usstrunk

entry.summary: Proposes Subtractive Modulative Network (SMN), a parameter-efficient implicit neural representation architecture inspired by subtractive synthesis, using learnable periodic activations and modulative masks.

entry.title: Let's Split Up: Zero-Shot Classifier Edits for Fine-Grained Video Understanding

author.name: Kaiting Liu, Hazel Doughty

entry.summary: Introduces category splitting for video recognition: editing an existing classifier to refine coarse categories into finer subcategories without additional data, using zero-shot methods leveraging compositional structure.

entry.title: KD4MT: A Survey of Knowledge Distillation for Machine Translation

author.name: Ona de Gibert, Joseph Attieh, Timothee Mickus, Yves Scherrer, J\"org Tiedemann

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of knowledge distillation for machine translation across 105 papers, covering KD as both compression tool and general-purpose knowledge transfer mechanism in MT.

entry.title: Towards Fair and Efficient De-identification: Quantifying the Efficiency and Generalizability of De-identification Approaches

author.name: Noopur Zambare, Kiana Aghakasiri, Carissa Lin, Carrie Ye, J. Ross Mitchell, Mohamed Abdalla

entry.summary: Evaluates de-identification approaches across formats, cultures, and genders, showing smaller fine-tuned models achieve comparable performance to large LLMs at much lower cost, with important findings about cross-cultural generalization gaps.

entry.title: Training Models on Dialects of Translationese Shows How Lexical Diversity and Source-Target Syntactic Similarity Shape Learning

author.name: Jenny Kunz

entry.summary: Studies how training on machine-translated data from 24 source languages affects English language models, analyzing how translationese properties (lexical diversity, syntactic similarity) shape learning outcomes.

entry.title: AFFMAE: Scalable and Efficient Vision Pretraining for Desktop Graphics Cards

author.name: David Smerkous, Zian Wang, Behzad Najafian

entry.summary: Introduces AFFMAE, a masked autoencoder pretraining framework that works on desktop GPUs by using adaptive off-grid token merging instead of dense grid assumptions. This enables hierarchical self-supervised pretraining without server-scale infrastructure.

entry.title: Unpaired Image-to-Image Translation via a Self-Supervised Semantic Bridge

author.name: Jiaming Liu, Felix Petersen, Yunhe Gao, Yabin Zhang, Hyojin Kim, Akshay S. Chaudhari, Yu Sun, Stefano Ermon, Sergios Gatidis

entry.summary: Proposes Self-Supervised Semantic Bridge (SSB) for unpaired image-to-image translation that integrates self-supervised visual encoders into diffusion bridge models for spatially faithful translation without cross-domain supervision.

entry.title: VIGOR: Visual Goal-In-Context Inference for Unified Humanoid Fall Safety

author.name: Osher Azulay, Zhengjie Xu, Andrew Scheffer, Stella X. Yu

entry.summary: Presents VIGOR, a unified framework for humanoid fall safety that handles fall avoidance, impact mitigation, and recovery through visual goal-in-context inference, decomposing the problem to improve scalability.

entry.title: VETime: Vision Enhanced Zero-Shot Time Series Anomaly Detection

author.name: Yingyuan Yang, Tian Lan, Yifei Gao, Yimeng Lu, Wenjun He, Meng Wang, Chenghao Liu, Chen Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes VETime, the first time-series anomaly detection framework that unifies temporal and visual modalities through fine-grained visual-temporal alignment, addressing the trade-off between point-level and context-level anomaly detection.

entry.title: Towards Efficient Constraint Handling in Neural Solvers for Routing Problems

author.name: Jieyi Bi, Zhiguang Cao, Jianan Zhou, Wen Song, Yaoxin Wu, Jie Zhang, Yining Ma, Cathy Wu

entry.summary: Introduces Construct-and-Refine (CaR), a general constraint-handling framework for neural routing solvers that uses learning-based feasibility refinement. This addresses the gap where neural solvers struggle with hard constraints in complex routing problems.

entry.title: Agent Skill Framework: Perspectives on the Potential of Small Language Models in Industrial Environments

author.name: Yangjie Xu, Lujun Li, Lama Sleem, Niccolo Gentile, Yewei Song, Yiqun Wang, Siming Ji, Wenbo Wu, Radu State

entry.summary: Investigates whether the Agent Skill framework, which works well with large proprietary models, provides similar benefits to small language models (SLMs) in industrial settings where API reliance is infeasible due to security and budget constraints.

entry.title: Decoupling Strategy and Execution in Task-Focused Dialogue via Goal-Oriented Preference Optimization

author.name: Jingyi Xu, Xingyu Ren, Zhiqiang You, Yumeng Zhang, Zhoupeng Shou

entry.summary: Proposes GOPO, a hierarchical RL framework for task-oriented dialogue that decouples strategy planning from response generation via separate Expert and Customer Service agents, optimizing at the dialogue-trajectory level.

entry.title: Test-Time Adaptation for Tactile-Vision-Language Models

author.name: Chuyang Ye, Haoxian Jing, Qinting Jiang, Yixi Lin, Qiang Li, Xing Tang, Jingyan Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes a reliability-aware test-time adaptation framework for tactile-vision-language models that estimates per-modality reliability under distribution shifts and adaptively fuses modalities.

entry.title: Fly0: Decoupling Semantic Grounding from Geometric Planning for Zero-Shot Aerial Navigation

author.name: Zhenxing Xu, Brikit Lu, Weidong Bao, Zhengqiu Zhu, Junsong Zhang, Hui Yan, Wenhao Lu, Ji Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Fly0, a framework for zero-shot aerial navigation that decouples semantic reasoning (via MLLMs) from geometric planning, using a three-stage pipeline from language grounding to 3D localization to geometric planning.

entry.title: Foundation Models for Medical Imaging: Status, Challenges, and Directions

author.name: Chuang Niu, Pengwei Wu, Bruno De Man, Ge Wang

entry.summary: Reviews foundation models for medical imaging along three axes: FM design principles, applications, and future challenges, providing a roadmap for trustworthy clinical translation.

entry.title: DocSplit: A Comprehensive Benchmark Dataset and Evaluation Approach for Document Packet Recognition and Splitting

author.name: Md Mofijul Islam, Md Sirajus Salekin, Nivedha Balakrishnan, Vincil C. Bishop III, Niharika Jain, Spencer Romo, Bob Strahan, Boyi Xie, Diego A. Socolinsky

entry.summary: Presents DocSplit, the first comprehensive benchmark for document packet splitting (separating multi-page document packets into individual documents) with novel evaluation metrics for LLMs.

entry.title: ScenicRules: An Autonomous Driving Benchmark with Multi-Objective Specifications and Abstract Scenarios

author.name: Kevin Kai-Chun Chang, Ekin Beyazit, Alberto Sangiovanni-Vincentelli, Tichakorn Wongpiromsarn, Sanjit A. Seshia

entry.summary: Introduces ScenicRules, a benchmark for evaluating autonomous driving systems under prioritized multi-objective specifications with formal environment models in stochastic settings.

entry.title: Surrogate-Based Prevalence Measurement for Large-Scale A/B Testing

author.name: Zehao Xu, Tony Paek, Kevin O'Sullivan, Attila Dobi

entry.summary: Presents a scalable surrogate-based framework for measuring content prevalence in A/B experiments at online platforms. It decouples expensive LLM-based labeling from per-experiment evaluation by calibrating a surrogate signal offline, enabling cost-effective measurement at scale.

entry.title: Rethinking Input Domains in Physics-Informed Neural Networks via Geometric Compactification Mappings

author.name: Zhenzhen Huang, Haoyu Bian, Jiaquan Zhang, Yibei Liu, Kuien Liu, Caiyan Qin, Guoqing Wang, Yang Yang, Chaoning Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces GC-PINN, a physics-informed neural network framework that uses geometric compactification mappings to reshape input coordinates, addressing gradient stiffness in multi-scale PDEs.

entry.title: Spatial Audio Question Answering and Reasoning on Dynamic Source Movements

author.name: Arvind Krishna Sridhar, Yinyi Guo, Erik Visser

entry.summary: Studies spatial audio question answering focused on movement reasoning, introducing a movement-centric data augmentation framework and an end-to-end multimodal approach with explicit reasoning steps.

entry.title: Explainable AI: Context-Aware Layer-Wise Integrated Gradients for Explaining Transformer Models

author.name: Melkamu Abay Mersha, Jugal Kalita

entry.summary: Proposes CA-LIG, a context-aware layer-wise integrated gradients framework for explaining transformer models that computes attributions across layers while accounting for inter-token dependencies.

entry.title: A Systematic Evaluation of Sample-Level Tokenization Strategies for MEG Foundation Models

author.name: SungJun Cho, Chetan Gohil, Rukuang Huang, Oiwi Parker Jones, Mark W. Woolrich

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates sample-level tokenization strategies for MEG foundation models, comparing learnable and non-learnable tokenizers on reconstruction fidelity and downstream task performance.

entry.title: Easy Data Unlearning Bench

author.name: Roy Rinberg, Pol Puigdemont, Martin Pawelczyk, Volkan Cevher

entry.summary: Introduces a unified benchmarking suite for evaluating machine unlearning algorithms using the KLoM metric, with precomputed model ensembles and standardized infrastructure for reproducible evaluation.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Foundation Models for Matched Molecular Pair Transformations to Recapitulate Medicinal Chemistry Intuition

author.name: Bo Pan, Peter Zhiping Zhang, Hao-Wei Pang, Alex Zhu, Xiang Yu, Liying Zhang, Liang Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes a retrieval-augmented foundation model for matched molecular pair transformations in medicinal chemistry, with prompting mechanisms for transformation control and MMPT-RAG for contextual retrieval.

entry.title: Heuristic Search as Language-Guided Program Optimization

author.name: Mingxin Yu, Ruixiao Yang, Chuchu Fan

entry.summary: Proposes a structured framework for LLM-driven Automated Heuristic Design that decomposes the process into forward evaluation, backward analytical feedback, and update steps for combinatorial optimization.

entry.title: On sparsity, extremal structure, and monotonicity properties of Wasserstein and Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport plans

author.name: Titouan Vayer (COMPACT)

entry.summary: Provides a self-contained overview of sparsity, extremal structure, and monotonicity properties of Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport plans compared to standard optimal transport.

entry.title: Learning Preference from Observed Rankings

author.name: Yu-Chang Chen, Chen Chian Fuh, Shang En Tsai

entry.summary: Develops a framework for learning consumer preferences from partial rankings using pairwise comparisons with logistic choice probabilities, modeling latent utility as sum of attributes, fixed effects, and low-rank factors while correcting for selection bias.

entry.title: CheckIfExist: Detecting Citation Hallucinations in the Era of AI-Generated Content

author.name: Diletta Abbonato

entry.summary: Presents CheckIfExist, an open-source tool for detecting citation hallucinations in academic papers by cross-referencing against CrossRef, Semantic Scholar, and OpenAlex databases.

entry.title: MultiCube-RAG for Multi-hop Question Answering

author.name: Jimeng Shi, Wei Hu, Runchu Tian, Bowen Jin, Wonbin Kweon, SeongKu Kang, Yunfan Kang, Dingqi Ye, Sizhe Zhou, Shaowen Wang, Jiawei Han

entry.summary: Proposes MultiCube-RAG for multi-hop question answering, using structured data cubes to capture subject-attribute-relation semantics for iterative retrieval and reasoning.

entry.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Deep Learning-Based LiDAR Super-Resolution for Autonomous Driving

author.name: June Moh Goo, Zichao Zeng, Jan Boehm

entry.summary: First comprehensive survey of deep learning-based LiDAR super-resolution for autonomous driving, organizing methods into CNN-based, model-based unrolling, implicit representations, and other categories.

entry.title: BTReport: A Framework for Brain Tumor Radiology Report Generation with Clinically Relevant Features

author.name: Juampablo E. Heras Rivera, Dickson T. Chen, Tianyi Ren, Daniel K. Low, Asma Ben Abacha, Alberto Santamaria-Pang, Mehmet Kurt

entry.summary: Introduces BTReport, an open-source framework for brain tumor radiology report generation that separates deterministic feature extraction from LLM-based narrative formatting.

entry.title: Benchmarking Adversarial Robustness and Adversarial Training Strategies for Object Detection

author.name: Alexis Winter, Jean-Vincent Martini, Romaric Audigier, Angelique Loesch, Bertrand Luvison

entry.summary: Provides a standardized benchmark for adversarial robustness of object detection models, investigating attack transferability across architectures and the effectiveness of adversarial training strategies including recent diffusion-based purification.

entry.title: Nonparametric Identification and Inference for Counterfactual Distributions with Confounding

author.name: Jianle Sun, Kun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes nonparametric identification and estimation of joint potential outcome distributions under confounding, using conditional copulas for tighter bounds and a causal representation learning framework for unmeasured confounding.

entry.title: AXRP Episode 49 - Caspar Oesterheld on Program Equilibrium

author.name: DanielFilan

entry.summary: A podcast episode featuring Caspar Oesterheld (Carnegie Mellon) discussing program equilibrium — game-theoretic analysis of agents that can read each other's source code and simulate each other. Topics include robust program equilibria, proof-based vs simulation-based approaches, and implications for cooperative AI.

entry.title: Causally-Guided Automated Feature Engineering with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Arun Vignesh Malarkkan, Wangyang Ying, Yanjie Fu

entry.summary: Introduces CAFE, a framework combining causal discovery with multi-agent reinforcement learning for automated feature engineering on tabular data. Groups features by causal influence and uses cascading multi-agent deep Q-learning for feature construction.

entry.title: What Persona Are We Missing? Identifying Unknown Relevant Personas for Faithful User Simulation

author.name: Weiwen Su, Yuhan Zhou, Zihan Wang, Naoki Yoshinaga, Masashi Toyoda

entry.summary: Introduces PICQ, a dataset for identifying unknown but relevant personas in user simulation, revealing a 'Fidelity vs. Insight' dilemma where larger models are more faithful but less insightful about missing personas.

entry.title: CAST: Achieving Stable LLM-based Text Analysis for Data Analytics

author.name: Jinxiang Xie, Zihao Li, Wei He, Rui Ding, Shi Han, Dongmei Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces CAST, a framework enhancing LLM output stability for text analytics through Algorithmic Prompting and Thinking-before-Speaking, constraining the model's reasoning path for consistent summarization and tagging.

entry.title: NLP Privacy Risk Identification in Social Media (NLP-PRISM): A Survey

author.name: Dhiman Goswami, Jai Kruthunz Naveen Kumar, Sanchari Das

entry.summary: Surveys NLP privacy risks in social media across 203 papers and proposes the NLP-PRISM framework evaluating vulnerabilities across six dimensions including data collection, fairness, and regulatory compliance.

entry.title: A fully differentiable framework for training proxy Exchange Correlation Functionals for periodic systems

author.name: Rakshit Kumar Singh, Aryan Amit Barsainyan, Bharath Ramsundar

entry.summary: Introduces a fully differentiable framework integrating neural network exchange-correlation functionals into DFT for periodic systems, enabling end-to-end gradient flow through self-consistent DFT workflows in PyTorch.

entry.title: ASPEN: Spectral-Temporal Fusion for Cross-Subject Brain Decoding

author.name: Megan Lee, Seung Ha Hwang, Inhyeok Choi, Shreyas Darade, Mengchun Zhang, Kateryna Shapovalenko

entry.summary: Introduces ASPEN, a hybrid architecture combining spectral and temporal EEG features via multiplicative fusion for cross-subject brain-computer interfaces. Demonstrates that spectral features provide more stable cross-subject transfer.

entry.title: The Weight of a Bit: EMFI Sensitivity Analysis of Embedded Deep Learning Models

author.name: Jakub Breier, \v{S}tefan Ku\v{c}er\'ak, Xiaolu Hou

entry.summary: Analyzes vulnerability of embedded neural network models to electromagnetic fault injection attacks across different number representations (32-bit float to 4-bit integer), testing on common image classifiers.

entry.title: AI-Driven Structure Refinement of X-ray Diffraction

author.name: Bin Cao, Qian Zhang, Zhenjie Feng, Taolue Zhang, Jiaqiang Huang, Lu-Tao Weng, Tong-Yi Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces WPEM, a physics-constrained whole-pattern decomposition workflow for X-ray diffraction refinement that embeds Bragg's law as an explicit constraint within a batch EM framework.

entry.title: Automated Histopathology Report Generation via Pyramidal Feature Extraction and the UNI Foundation Model

author.name: Ahmet Halici, Ece Tugba Cebeci, Musa Balci, Mustafa Cini, Serkan Sokmen

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical vision-language framework for automated histopathology report generation using the UNI foundation model with multi-resolution pyramidal patch selection from whole slide images.

entry.title: Hardware-accelerated graph neural networks: an alternative approach for neuromorphic event-based audio classification and keyword spotting on SoC FPGA

author.name: Kamil Jeziorek, Piotr Wzorek, Krzysztof Blachut, Hiroshi Nakano, Manon Dampfhoffer, Thomas Mesquida, Hiroaki Nishi, Thomas Dalgaty, Tomasz Kryjak

entry.summary: Presents an FPGA implementation of event-graph neural networks for neuromorphic audio processing, achieving competitive accuracy with 10x fewer parameters than state-of-the-art.

entry.title: Memes-as-Replies: Can Models Select Humorous Manga Panel Responses?

author.name: Ryosuke Kohita, Seiichiro Yoshioka

entry.summary: Introduces the Meme Reply Selection task with MaMe-Re, a benchmark of 100K human-annotated manga panel-social media post pairs, testing whether LLMs can select humorous meme responses.

entry.title: Muon with Spectral Guidance: Efficient Optimization for Scientific Machine Learning

author.name: Binghang Lu, Jiahao Zhang, Guang Lin

entry.summary: Proposes SpecMuon, a spectral-aware optimizer that combines the Muon optimizer's orthogonalized geometry with a mode-wise relaxed scalar auxiliary variable mechanism for physics-informed neural networks and neural operators.

entry.title: ModalImmune: Immunity Driven Unlearning via Self Destructive Training

author.name: Rong Fu, Jia Yee Tan, Wenxin Zhang, Zijian Zhang, Ziming Wang, Zhaolu Kang, Muge Qi, Shuning Zhang, Simon Fong

entry.summary: Presents ModalImmune, a training framework that enforces modality immunity by intentionally collapsing selected modality information during training, making multimodal models robust to missing input channels at deployment.

entry.title: Online Prediction of Stochastic Sequences with High Probability Regret Bounds

author.name: Matthias Frey, Jonathan H. Manton, Jingge Zhu

entry.summary: Presents high-probability regret bounds for universal prediction of stochastic sequences, complementing existing bounds that hold only in expectation. Shows O(T^{-1/2} δ^{-1/2}) convergence rate.

entry.title: Robust Stochastic Gradient Posterior Sampling with Lattice Based Discretisation

author.name: Zier Mensch, Lars Holdijk, Samuel Duffield, Maxwell Aifer, Patrick J. Coles, Max Welling, Miranda C. N. Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes Stochastic Gradient Lattice Random Walk (SGLRW), an SGLD variant that introduces noise only through off-diagonal covariance elements, yielding greater robustness to minibatch size while maintaining asymptotic correctness.

entry.title: Exploring New Frontiers in Vertical Federated Learning: the Role of Saddle Point Reformulation

author.name: Aleksandr Beznosikov, Georgiy Kormakov, Alexander Grigorievskiy, Mikhail Rudakov, Ruslan Nazykov, Alexander Rogozin, Anton Vakhrushev, Andrey Savchenko, Martin Tak\'a\v{c}, Alexander Gasnikov

entry.title: Local adapt-then-combine algorithms for distributed nonsmooth optimization: Achieving provable communication acceleration

author.name: Luyao Guo, Xinli Shi, Wenying Xu, Jinde Cao

entry.title: Multi-Channel Replay Speech Detection using Acoustic Maps

author.name: Michael Neri, Tuomas Virtanen

entry.summary: Proposes acoustic maps as spatial features for multi-channel replay speech detection, using beamforming-derived directional energy distributions. Achieves competitive performance with only ~6k parameters.

entry.title: Utility-Preserving De-Identification for Math Tutoring: Investigating Numeric Ambiguity in the MathEd-PII Benchmark Dataset

author.name: Zhuqian Zhou, Kirk Vanacore, Bakhtawar Ahtisham, Jinsook Lee, Doug Pietrzak, Daryl Hedley, Jorge Dias, Chris Shaw, Ruth Sch\"afer, Ren\'e F. Kizilcec
