entry.summary: Investigates whether structured prompting alone can make LLMs converse in Tulu, an extremely low-resource Dravidian language with minimal digital presence. Combines grammar documentation, negative constraints, romanization, and self-play without fine-tuning.

entry.title: DependencyAI: Detecting AI Generated Text through Dependency Parsing

author.name: Sara Ahmed, Tracy Hammond

entry.summary: Introduces DependencyAI, a simple method for detecting AI-generated text using only dependency parse relation labels. Achieves competitive performance across monolingual, multi-generator, and multilingual settings with high interpretability.

entry.title: FrameRef: A Framing Dataset and Simulation Testbed for Modeling Bounded Rational Information Health

author.name: Victor De Lima, Jiqun Liu, Grace Hui Yang

entry.summary: Presents FrameRef, a large-scale dataset of 1M+ systematically reframed claims across five framing dimensions, with a simulation framework for modeling how sequential information exposure in search/recommendation systems affects users' information health.

entry.title: Training-Free Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection in 3D Brain MRI with 2D Foundation Models

author.name: Tai Le-Gia, Jaehyun Ahn

entry.summary: Introduces a training-free framework for zero-shot anomaly detection in 3D brain MRI that constructs volumetric tokens by aggregating multi-axis slices processed by 2D foundation models, addressing the gap between 2D ZSAD advances and 3D medical imaging needs.

entry.title: ToaSt: Token Channel Selection and Structured Pruning for Efficient ViT

author.name: Hyunchan Moon, Cheonjun Park, Steven L. Waslander

entry.summary: Proposes ToaSt, a decoupled framework for Vision Transformer pruning that applies head-wise structured pruning to attention modules and a novel Token Channel Selection method for Feed-Forward Networks, which constitute over 60% of FLOPs.

entry.title: RUVA: Personalized Transparent On-Device Graph Reasoning

author.name: Gabriele Conte, Alessio Mattiace, Gianni Carmosino, Potito Aghilar, Giovanni Servedio, Francesco Musicco, Vito Walter Anelli, Tommaso Di Noia, Francesco Maria Donini

entry.summary: Proposes RUVA, a 'Glass Box' personal AI architecture using a Personal Knowledge Graph for transparent, user-inspectable AI memory with precise fact redaction, contrasting with black-box RAG approaches.

entry.title: Transforming Computational Lithography with AC and AI -- Faster, More Accurate, and Energy-efficient

author.name: Saumyadip Mukhopadhyay, Kiho Yang, Kasyap Thottasserymana Vasudevan, Mounica Jyothi Divvela, Selim Dogru, Dilip Krishnamurthy, Fergo Treska, Werner Gillijns, Ryan Ryoung han Kim, Kumara Sastry, Vivek Singh

entry.summary: Reports on using accelerated computing and AI to transform computational lithography in semiconductor manufacturing, addressing the surging compute demands of angstrom-era chip fabrication.

entry.title: TokaMind: A Multi-Modal Transformer Foundation Model for Tokamak Plasma Dynamics

author.name: Tobia Boschi, Andrea Loreti, Nicola C. Amorisco, Rodrigo H. Ordonez-Hurtado, C\'ecile Rousseau, George K. Holt, Eszter Sz\'ekely, Alexander Whittle, Samuel Jackson, Adriano Agnello, Stanislas Pamela, Alessandra Pascale, Robert Akers, Juan Bernabe Moreno, Vassil Alexandrov, Mykhaylo Zayats

entry.summary: Presents TokaMind, an open-source multi-modal transformer foundation model for fusion plasma modeling, trained on heterogeneous tokamak diagnostics supporting time-series, 2D profiles, and videos.

entry.title: Knowing Isn't Understanding: Re-grounding Generative Proactivity with Epistemic and Behavioral Insight

author.name: Kirandeep Kaur, Xingda Lyu, Chirag Shah

entry.summary: Introduces the concept of 'epistemic incompleteness' in AI interactions where users lack awareness of what's missing, arguing that proactivity must go beyond anticipatory behavior to surface unknown unknowns.

entry.title: Fine-Tuning LLMs to Generate Economical and Reliable Actions for the Power Grid

author.name: Mohamad Chehade, Hao Zhu

entry.summary: Fine-tunes an LLM to generate corrective transmission switching plans for power grid emergencies (Public Safety Power Shutoffs). Uses a multi-stage pipeline with supervised fine-tuning from a DC-OPF oracle followed by direct preference optimization with AC-evaluated feedback.

entry.title: The Equalizer: Introducing Shape-Gain Decomposition in Neural Audio Codecs

author.name: Samir Sadok, Laurent Girin, Xavier Alameda-Pineda

entry.summary: Introduces shape-gain decomposition into neural audio codecs, separating signal energy from normalized structure before encoding. This classical signal processing principle improves robustness to input level variations and reduces codebook redundancy.

entry.title: Dynamic Training-Free Fusion of Subject and Style LoRAs

author.name: Qinglong Cao, Yuntian Chen, Chao Ma, Xiaokang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes dynamic training-free LoRA fusion for combining subject and style adaptations, using KL divergence-based adaptive weight selection at each layer during generation. Addresses limitations of static heuristic fusion methods.

entry.title: Lifelong Scalable Multi-Agent Realistic Testbed and A Comprehensive Study on Design Choices in Lifelong AGV Fleet Management Systems

author.name: Jingtian Yan, Yulun Zhang, Zhenting Liu, Han Zhang, He Jiang, Jingkai Chen, Stephen F. Smith, Jiaoyang Li

entry.summary: Presents LSMART, an open-source simulator for evaluating multi-agent path finding algorithms in fleet management with realistic AGV kinodynamic models. Provides comprehensive benchmarking of design choices for lifelong AGV fleet management.

entry.title: Fairness over Equality: Correcting Social Incentives in Asymmetric Sequential Social Dilemmas

author.name: Alper Demir, H\"useyin Ayd{\i}n, Kale-ab Abebe Tessera, David Abel, Stefano V. Albrecht

entry.summary: Introduces asymmetric variants of sequential social dilemma environments and proposes methods for correcting social incentives when agents face different natural incentive structures. Shows existing fairness methods struggle under asymmetry.

entry.title: Accelerated Predictive Coding Networks via Direct Kolen-Pollack Feedback Alignment

author.name: Davide Casnici, Martin Lefebvre, Justin Dauwels, Charlotte Frenkel

entry.summary: Proposes DKP-PC, combining direct feedback alignment with Kolen-Pollack algorithms to address both feedback delay and exponential decay in predictive coding networks. This makes biologically-inspired predictive coding more efficient and scalable while preserving local update properties.

entry.title: Multi-Objective Coverage via Constraint Active Search

author.name: Zakaria Shams Siam, Xuefeng Liu, Chong Liu

entry.summary: Formulates the multi-objective coverage (MOC) problem for identifying representative samples broadly covering a multi-objective space, applicable to drug discovery and materials design. Proposes a constraint-based active search approach distinct from Pareto optimization.

entry.title: Continuous-Time Piecewise-Linear Recurrent Neural Networks

author.name: Alena Br\"andle, Lukas Eisenmann, Florian G\"otz, Daniel Durstewitz

entry.summary: Extends piecewise-linear RNNs (PLRNNs) from discrete-time to continuous-time formulations for dynamical systems reconstruction. Aims to preserve the mathematical tractability of piecewise-linear design while enabling continuous-time modeling for scientific applications.

entry.title: Sparse Additive Model Pruning for Order-Based Causal Structure Learning

author.name: Kentaro Kanamori, Hirofumi Suzuki, Takuya Takagi

entry.summary: Proposes a sparse additive model-based pruning technique for order-based causal structure learning that avoids reliance on hyperparameter-sensitive hypothesis testing. Improves both computational efficiency and estimation accuracy in causal DAG discovery.

entry.title: Enabling Low-Latency Machine learning on Radiation-Hard FPGAs with hls4ml

author.name: Katya Govorkova, Julian Garcia Pardinas, Vladimir Loncar, Victoria Nguyen, Sebastian Schmitt, Marco Pizzichemi, Loris Martinazzoli, Eluned Anne Smith

entry.summary: Demonstrates first ultra-fast, radiation-hard ML application on FPGAs for high-energy physics, using hls4ml with a lightweight autoencoder for the LHCb PicoCal calorimeter. Introduces hardware-aware quantization to 10-bit weights with minimal performance loss.

entry.title: Neural Scaling Laws for Boosted Jet Tagging

author.name: Matthias Vigl, Nicole Hartman, Michael Kagan, Lukas Heinrich

entry.summary: Investigates neural scaling laws for boosted jet classification in high-energy physics using the JetClass dataset. Derives compute-optimal scaling laws and identifies effective performance limits achievable through increased compute.

entry.title: Zero-shot HOI Detection with MLLM-based Detector-agnostic Interaction Recognition

author.name: Shiyu Xuan, Dongkai Wang, Zechao Li, Jinhui Tang

entry.summary: Proposes a decoupled framework for zero-shot human-object interaction detection that separates object detection from interaction recognition, leveraging MLLMs for zero-shot interaction recognition with a deterministic generation method.

entry.title: Emergent Morphing Attack Detection in Open Multi-modal Large Language Models

author.name: Marija Ivanovska, Vitomir \v{S}truc

entry.summary: Presents the first systematic zero-shot evaluation of open-source MLLMs for face morphing attack detection, finding that LLaVA1.6-Mistral-7B achieves state-of-the-art performance without any fine-tuning, surpassing specialized MAD systems.

entry.title: RaCo: Ranking and Covariance for Practical Learned Keypoints

author.name: Abhiram Shenoi, Philipp Lindenberger, Paul-Edouard Sarlin, Marc Pollefeys

entry.summary: Introduces RaCo, a lightweight neural keypoint detector with a differentiable ranker and covariance estimator for spatial uncertainty quantification. Achieves strong rotational robustness through data augmentation alone, without expensive equivariant architectures.

entry.title: Reverse Delegated Training and Private Inference via Perfectly-Secure Quantum Homomorphic Encryption

author.name: Sergio A. Ortega, Miguel A. Martin-Delgado

entry.summary: Demonstrates first realistic implementations of perfectly-secure quantum homomorphic encryption applied to quantum neural networks, enabling both reverse delegated training (federated) and private inference scenarios for quantum machine learning in the cloud.

entry.title: FAST-EQA: Efficient Embodied Question Answering with Global and Local Region Relevancy

author.name: Haochen Zhang, Nirav Savaliya, Faizan Siddiqui, Enna Sachdeva

entry.summary: Introduces FAST-EQA, a question-conditioned framework for embodied question answering that identifies visual targets, scores global regions of interest for navigation, and uses Chain-of-Thought reasoning over bounded visual memory for fast inference.

entry.title: Fixed-Horizon Self-Normalized Inference for Adaptive Experiments via Martingale AIPW/DML with Logged Propensities

author.name: Gabriel Saco

entry.summary: Addresses confidence interval construction for average treatment effects in adaptive experiments where propensities keep changing, proposing a martingale-based AIPW/DML approach with self-normalization using logged propensities.

entry.title: EduResearchBench: A Hierarchical Atomic Task Decomposition Benchmark for Full-Lifecycle Educational Research

author.name: Houping Yue, Zixiang Di, Mei Jiang, Bingdong Li, Hao Hao, Yu Song, Bo Jiang, Aimin Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces EduResearchBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on educational academic writing using a Hierarchical Atomic Task Decomposition framework spanning six research modules and 36 atomic tasks.

entry.title: Accelerating Large-Scale Dataset Distillation via Exploration-Exploitation Optimization

author.name: Muhammad J. Alahmadi (DK), Peng Gao (DK), Feiyi Wang (DK), Dongkuan (DK), Xu

entry.summary: Proposes Exploration-Exploitation Distillation (E²D) for accelerating large-scale dataset distillation by combining optimization-based accuracy with optimization-free efficiency through a two-phase pipeline.

entry.title: Molecular Design beyond Training Data with Novel Extended Objective Functionals of Generative AI Models Driven by Quantum Annealing Computer

author.name: Hayato Kunugi, Mohsen Rahmani, Yosuke Iyama, Yutaro Hirono, Akira Suma, Matthew Woolway, Vladimir Vargas-Calder\'on, William Kim, Kevin Chern, Mohammad Amin, Masaru Tateno

entry.summary: Develops a framework integrating deep generative models with D-Wave quantum annealing computers for molecular design, using a Neural Hash Function for regularization and binarization between classical and quantum neural networks.

entry.title: Criteria-first, semantics-later: reproducible structure discovery in image-based sciences

author.name: Jan Bumberger

entry.summary: Proposes a 'criteria-first, semantics-later' paradigm for image-based scientific discovery, separating criterion-defined structure discovery from domain-specific semantic labeling to enable cross-sensor comparability and handle ontology drift.

entry.title: Learning to Retrieve Navigable Candidates for Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation

author.name: Shutian Gu, Chengkai Huang, Ruoyu Wang, Lina Yao

entry.summary: Proposes a retrieval-augmented framework for LLM-based vision-and-language navigation that retrieves relevant instructions and navigable candidates to improve efficiency without modifying the underlying LLM.

entry.title: UrbanVerse: Learning Urban Region Representation Across Cities and Tasks

author.name: Fengze Sun, Egemen Tanin, Shanika Karunasekera, Zuqing Li, Flora D. Salim, Jianzhong Qi

entry.summary: Proposes UrbanVerse, a foundation-style model for cross-city urban region representation learning and cross-task analytics. Uses local and structural features with graph-based random walks instead of city-wide global features for better generalization.

entry.title: Task-Agnostic Continual Learning for Chest Radiograph Classification

author.name: Muthu Subash Kavitha, Anas Zafar, Amgad Muneer, Jia Wu

entry.summary: Proposes CARL-XRay for task-incremental continual learning of chest X-ray classification, using adapter-based routing with a fixed backbone and incremental task-specific adapters. First study of task-incremental CL for chest radiograph classification.

entry.title: Benchmarking IoT Time-Series AD with Event-Level Augmentations

author.name: Dmitry Zhevnenko, Ilya Makarov, Aleksandr Kovalenko, Fedor Meshchaninov, Anton Kozhukhov, Vladislav Travnikov, Makar Ippolitov, Kirill Yashunin, Iurii Katser

entry.summary: Introduces an evaluation protocol for IoT time series anomaly detection with unified event-level augmentations simulating real-world sensor issues. Evaluates 14 models across 7 datasets including industrial data.

entry.title: CEPAE: Conditional Entropy-Penalized Autoencoders for Time Series Counterfactuals

author.name: Tom\`as Garriga, Gerard Sanz, Eduard Serrahima de Cambra, Axel Brando

entry.summary: Introduces CEPAE, a conditional entropy-penalized autoencoder for counterfactual inference on time series data affected by market events. Uses the structural causal model framework with variational and adversarial autoencoders adapted to time series settings.

entry.title: Symbolic recovery of PDEs from measurement data

author.name: Erion Morina, Philipp Scholl, Martin Holler

entry.summary: Uses rational function-based neural network architectures to symbolically recover PDEs from indirect, noisy measurements. Combines the approximation power of rational functions with interpretability of symbolic expressions for scientific discovery.

entry.title: Guided Diffusion by Optimized Loss Functions on Relaxed Parameters for Inverse Material Design

author.name: Jens U. Kreber, Christian Wei{\ss}enfels, Joerg Stueckler

entry.summary: Proposes a diffusion-based inverse design method for materials engineering that handles discrete parameters and constraints by optimizing loss functions on relaxed parameters. Addresses multi-modal solution spaces common in engineering design.

entry.title: Beyond Labels: Information-Efficient Human-in-the-Loop Learning using Ranking and Selection Queries

author.name: Bel\'en Mart\'in-Urcelay, Yoonsang Lee, Matthieu R. Bloch, Christopher J. Rozell

entry.summary: Develops a human-in-the-loop framework for binary classification using rich query types (ranking and exemplar selection) beyond simple labeling. Designs active learning algorithms that leverage these richer interactions for increased information gain.

entry.title: Extracting Consumer Insight from Text: A Large Language Model Approach to Emotion and Evaluation Measurement

author.name: Stephan Ludwig, Peter J. Danaher, Xiaohao Yang, Yu-Ting Lin, Ehsan Abedin, Dhruv Grewal, Lan Du

entry.summary: Introduces the Linguistic eXtractor (LX), a fine-tuned LLM for extracting consumer emotions and evaluations from text, outperforming GPT-4 Turbo, RoBERTa, and DeepSeek. Achieves 81% macro-F1 on survey responses and >95% on reviews for 16 emotion types and 4 evaluation constructs.

entry.title: Distributional Deep Learning for Super-Resolution of 4D Flow MRI under Domain Shift

author.name: Xiaoyi Wen, Fei Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes a distributional deep learning framework for super-resolution of 4D flow MRI that addresses domain shift between training data (simple downsampling) and real clinical low-resolution data from different acquisition mechanisms.

entry.title: NeRFscopy: Neural Radiance Fields for in-vivo Time-Varying Tissues from Endoscopy

author.name: Laura Salort-Benejam, Antonio Agudo

entry.summary: Introduces NeRFscopy, a self-supervised pipeline for dynamic 3D reconstruction and novel view synthesis from monocular endoscopic videos, handling tissue deformation, illumination changes, and unknown camera trajectories.

entry.title: Context-aware Skin Cancer Epithelial Cell Classification with Scalable Graph Transformers

author.name: Lucas Sanc\'er\'e, No\'emie Moreau, Katarzyna Bozek

entry.summary: Proposes using scalable Graph Transformers on full whole-slide-image cell graphs for skin cancer epithelial cell classification, preserving tissue-level context lost by traditional patch-based approaches.

entry.title: Feasibility-aware Imitation Learning from Observation with Multimodal Feedback

author.name: Kei Takahashi, Hikaru Sasaki, Takamitsu Matsubara

entry.summary: Proposes FABCO, a feasibility-aware behavior cloning approach for imitation learning from observation that integrates robot dynamics models with feasibility estimation to handle physical differences between demonstrators and robots.

entry.title: Grip as Needed, Glide on Demand: Ultrasonic Lubrication for Robotic Locomotion

author.name: Mostafa A. Atalla, Daan van Bemmel, Jack Cummings, Paul Breedveld, Micha\"el Wiertlewski, Aim\'ee Sakes

entry.summary: Introduces ultrasonic lubrication as a method to actively control friction in robotic locomotion, developing cylindrical and flat-plate modules that switch between grip and slip states at ultrasonic frequencies for bio-inspired inchworm and ovipositor locomotion.

entry.title: On propagation of chaos for the Fisher-Rao gradient flow in entropic mean-field optimization

author.name: Petra Lazi\'c, Linshan Liu, Mateusz B. Majka

entry.summary: Studies Fisher-Rao gradient flows for mean-field optimization of neural networks, constructing interacting particle systems that approximate the flow and discussing kernel smoothing approaches for practical implementation.

entry.title: DAV-GSWT: Diffusion-Active-View Sampling for Data-Efficient Gaussian Splatting Wang Tiles

author.name: Rong Fu, Jiekai Wu, Haiyun Wei, Yee Tan Jia, Wenxin Zhang, Yang Li, Xiaowen Ma, Wangyu Wu, Simon Fong

entry.summary: Presents DAV-GSWT, a data-efficient framework that uses diffusion priors and active view sampling to synthesize high-fidelity Gaussian Splatting Wang Tiles from minimal observations, enabling generation of expansive 3D landscapes.

entry.title: Efficient Knowledge Transfer for Jump-Starting Control Policy Learning of Multirotors through Physics-Aware Neural Architectures

author.name: Welf Rehberg, Mihir Kulkarni, Philipp Weiss, Kostas Alexis

entry.summary: Proposes a library-based policy initialization scheme for accelerating multirotor control policy training through cross-embodiment knowledge transfer, using a physics-aware neural architecture combining RL-based control with supervised control allocation.

entry.title: AgriWorld:A World Tools Protocol Framework for Verifiable Agricultural Reasoning with Code-Executing LLM Agents

author.name: Zhixing Zhang, Jesen Zhang, Hao Liu, Qinhan Lv, Jing Yang, Kaitong Cai, Keze Wang

entry.summary: Introduces AgriWorld, an agentic framework for agricultural science that bridges foundation models trained on spatiotemporal data with LLM reasoning via a Python execution environment and unified geospatial query tools.

entry.title: S-PRESSO: Ultra Low Bitrate Sound Effect Compression With Diffusion Autoencoders And Offline Quantization

author.name: Zineb Lahrichi (IP Paris), Ga\"etan Hadjeres (IP Paris), Ga\"el Richard (IP Paris), Geoffroy Peeters (IP Paris)

entry.summary: Presents S-PRESSO, a 48kHz sound effect compression model achieving ultra-low bitrates (0.096 kbps) using a pretrained latent diffusion model decoder with offline quantization.

entry.title: A Scalable Curiosity-Driven Game-Theoretic Framework for Long-Tail Multi-Label Learning in Data Mining

author.name: Jing Yang, Keze Wang

entry.summary: Proposes CD-GTMLL, a game-theoretic framework for long-tail multi-label classification that treats each sub-predictor as a cooperative game player with curiosity-driven rewards. Aims to address the imbalance problem in large label spaces without disrupting inter-label dependencies.

entry.title: Orchestration-Free Customer Service Automation: A Privacy-Preserving and Flowchart-Guided Framework

author.name: Mengze Hong, Chen Jason Zhang, Zichang Guo, Hanlin Gu, Di Jiang, Li Qing

entry.summary: Introduces an orchestration-free customer service automation framework using Task-Oriented Flowcharts (TOFs). Emphasizes local deployment of small language models with decentralized distillation to address privacy and data scarcity concerns.

entry.title: VLM-DEWM: Dynamic External World Model for Verifiable and Resilient Vision-Language Planning in Manufacturing

author.name: Guoqin Tang, Qingxuan Jia, Gang Chen, Tong Li, Zeyuan Huang, Zihang Lv, Ning Ji

entry.summary: Presents VLM-DEWM, a cognitive architecture for manufacturing that decouples VLM reasoning from world-state management through a persistent external world model. Introduces Externalizable Reasoning Traces for verifiable decision-making.

entry.title: How to Disclose? Strategic AI Disclosure in Crowdfunding

author.name: Ning Wang, Chen Liang

entry.summary: Studies how mandatory AI disclosure on Kickstarter affects crowdfunding performance, finding it significantly reduces funding success. Examines moderating effects of substantive and rhetorical signals around AI involvement disclosure.

entry.title: tensorFM: Low-Rank Approximations of Cross-Order Feature Interactions

author.name: Alessio Mazzetto (Brown University), Mohammad Mahdi Khalili (Ohio State University, Yahoo Research), Laura Fee Nern (Yahoo Research), Michael Viderman (Yahoo Research), Alex Shtoff (Technology Innovation Institute), Krzysztof Dembczy\'nski (Yahoo Research, Poznan University of Technology)

entry.summary: Introduces tensorFM, a model for tabular categorical data that captures high-order feature interactions via low-rank tensor approximation. Generalizes field-weighted factorization machines with interpretable and competitive performance.

entry.title: Beyond Reinforcement Learning: Fast and Scalable Quantum Circuit Synthesis

author.name: Lukas Theissinger, Thore Gerlach, David Berghaus, Christian Bauckhage

entry.summary: Uses supervised learning to approximate minimum description length of residual unitaries combined with stochastic beam search for quantum circuit synthesis. Achieves zero-shot generalization across different qubit counts with a lightweight model.

entry.title: Proactive Conversational Assistant for a Procedural Manual Task based on Audio and IMU

author.name: Rehana Mahfuz, Yinyi Guo, Erik Visser, Phanidhar Chinchili

entry.summary: Proposes a real-time conversational assistant for procedural tasks (furniture assembly) using only audio and IMU from wearable devices instead of video, addressing privacy and computational concerns. Constructs a dataset for evaluation.

entry.title: AIC CTU@AVerImaTeC: dual-retriever RAG for image-text fact checking

author.name: Herbert Ullrich, Jan Drchal

entry.summary: Presents a 3rd-place system in AVerImaTeC shared task combining text RAG with reverse image search for multimodal fact checking. Uses GPT-5.1 via Batch API at $0.013 per fact-check, demonstrating a simple but competitive pipeline.

entry.title: Clinically Inspired Symptom-Guided Depression Detection from Emotion-Aware Speech Representations

author.name: Chaithra Nerella, Chiranjeevi Yarra

entry.summary: Proposes a symptom-guided framework for depression severity estimation from speech using cross-attention between PHQ-8 items and emotion-aware speech representations. Provides symptom-level analysis rather than just binary or overall severity prediction.

entry.title: LLM-to-Speech: A Synthetic Data Pipeline for Training Dialectal Text-to-Speech Models

author.name: Ahmed Khaled Khamis, Hesham Ali

entry.summary: Introduces NileTTS, a 38-hour transcribed speech dataset for Egyptian Arabic TTS, created through a novel synthetic pipeline using LLMs to generate dialect content which is then converted to speech. This addresses the severe under-resourcing of Egyptian Arabic despite it being the most widely understood Arabic dialect.

entry.title: Bridging Day and Night: Target-Class Hallucination Suppression in Unpaired Image Translation

author.name: Shuwei Li, Lei Tan, Robby T. Tan

entry.summary: Proposes a framework to detect and suppress semantic hallucinations in day-to-night unpaired image translation, using a dual-head discriminator that performs semantic segmentation to identify hallucinated objects like traffic signs incorrectly synthesized in translations.

entry.title: Semantic-Guided 3D Gaussian Splatting for Transient Object Removal

author.name: Aditi Prabakaran, Priyesh Shukla

entry.summary: Proposes a semantic filtering framework for removing transient objects from 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructions using CLIP similarity scores to identify and prune distractor Gaussians, resolving parallax ambiguity that motion-based approaches struggle with.

entry.title: OSCAR: An Ovipositor-Inspired Self-Propelling Capsule Robot for Colonoscopy

author.name: Mostafa A. Atalla, Anand S. Sekar, Remi van Starkenburg, David J. Jager, Aim\'ee Sakes, Micha\"el Wiertlewski, Paul Breedveld

entry.summary: Presents OSCAR, a capsule robot for colonoscopy inspired by parasitic wasp ovipositors, using a spring-loaded cam system driving 12 circumferential sliders to create controlled friction anisotropy for self-propulsion through the colon.

entry.title: Fluoroscopy-Constrained Magnetic Robot Control via Zernike-Based Field Modeling and Nonlinear MPC

author.name: Xinhao Chen, Hongkun Yao, Anuruddha Bhattacharjee, Suraj Raval, Lamar O. Mair, Yancy Diaz-Mercado, Axel Krieger

entry.summary: Presents a control framework for fluoroscopy-constrained magnetic surgical robots combining nonlinear MPC with Zernike polynomial-based magnetic field modeling and Kalman filtering, enabling accurate control under low frame rate noisy pose feedback.

entry.title: Uniform error bounds for quantized dynamical models

author.name: Abdelkader Metakalard (CRAN, SYNALP), Fabien Lauer (SYNALP, LORIA), Kevin Colin (CRAN), Marion Gilson (CRAN)

entry.summary: Provides statistical guarantees on accuracy of quantized dynamical models learned from dependent data, developing uniform error bounds that account for hardware quantization constraints. Introduces both slow-rate and fast-rate variance-adaptive bounds.

entry.title: Scenario Approach with Post-Design Certification of User-Specified Properties

author.name: Algo Car\`e, Marco C. Campi, Simone Garatti

entry.summary: Extends the scenario approach for data-driven design by providing post-design certification of user-specified properties not considered during the design phase. Provides distribution-free bounds on risk of failing post-design criteria.

entry.title: Effective and Robust Multimodal Medical Image Analysis

author.name: Joy Dhar, Nayyar Zaidi, Maryam Haghighat

entry.summary: Proposes a multimodal fusion learning framework for medical image analysis that combines MRI, CT, and SPECT modalities while addressing generalizability across diseases, computational efficiency, and robustness against adversarial attacks.

entry.title: LEADER: Lightweight End-to-End Attention-Gated Dual Autoencoder for Robust Minutiae Extraction

author.name: Raffaele Cappelli, Matteo Ferrara

entry.summary: Introduces LEADER, a lightweight end-to-end neural network for fingerprint minutiae extraction with only 0.9M parameters, integrating non-maximum suppression and angular decoding with a novel 'Castle-Moat-Rampart' ground-truth encoding.

entry.title: GenAI-LA: Generative AI and Learning Analytics Workshop (LAK 2026), April 27--May 1, 2026, Bergen, Norway

author.name: Javier Irigoyen, Roberto Daza, Aythami Morales, Julian Fierrez, Francisco Jurado, Alvaro Ortigosa, Ruben Tolosana

entry.summary: Introduces EduEVAL-DB, a dataset of 854 pedagogical explanations across 139 science questions with human-teacher and LLM-simulated teacher roles. Proposes a pedagogical risk rubric for evaluating AI tutors.

entry.title: Hybrid Federated and Split Learning for Privacy Preserving Clinical Prediction and Treatment Optimization

author.name: Farzana Akter, Rakib Hossain, Deb Kanna Roy Toushi, Mahmood Menon Khan, Sultana Amin, Lisan Al Amin

entry.summary: Presents a hybrid federated and split learning framework for privacy-preserving clinical decision support, auditing privacy leakage empirically using membership inference on cut-layer representations.

entry.title: FedPSA: Modeling Behavioral Staleness in Asynchronous Federated Learning

author.name: Chaoyi Lu

entry.summary: Proposes FedPSA, a parameter sensitivity-based approach to measuring staleness in asynchronous federated learning. Unlike existing methods that use round difference as a coarse staleness measure, FedPSA observes the model parameters directly for finer-grained assessment.

entry.title: Beyond Binary Classification: Detecting Fine-Grained Sexism in Social Media Videos

author.name: Laura De Grazia, Danae S\'anchez Villegas, Desmond Elliott, Mireia Farr\'us, Mariona Taul\'e

entry.summary: Presents FineMuSe, a multimodal dataset for fine-grained sexism detection in Spanish social media videos with a hierarchical taxonomy including irony and humor. Evaluates LLMs on both binary and fine-grained classification.

entry.title: ExLipBaB: Exact Lipschitz Constant Computation for Piecewise Linear Neural Networks

author.name: Tom A. Splittgerber

entry.summary: Presents a method for exact computation of Lipschitz constants for piecewise linear neural networks using branch-and-bound techniques. While the problem is NP-hard, the method is useful for benchmarking approximate methods and computing robustness guarantees for small models.

entry.title: Controlled oscillation modeling using port-Hamiltonian neural networks

author.name: Maximino Linares, Guillaume Doras, Thomas H\'elie

entry.summary: Proposes using a second-order discrete gradient method embedded in port-Hamiltonian neural networks for modeling oscillatory dynamical systems. Ensures power-preserving discretization rather than relying on standard Runge-Kutta methods.

entry.title: Under-resourced studies of under-resourced languages: lemmatization and POS-tagging with LLM annotators for historical Armenian, Georgian, Greek and Syriac

author.name: Chahan Vidal-Gor\`ene (CJM, LIPN), Bastien Kindt (UCL), Florian Cafiero (PSL, CJM)

entry.summary: Evaluates GPT-4 variants and Mistral models on lemmatization and POS-tagging for four historical under-resourced languages (Ancient Greek, Classical Armenian, Old Georgian, Syriac) in few-shot and zero-shot settings. Compares against a task-specific RNN baseline.

entry.title: SEG-JPEG: Simple Visual Semantic Communications for Remote Operation of Automated Vehicles over Unreliable Wireless Networks

author.name: Sebastian Donnelly, Ruth Anderson, George Economides, James Broughton, Peter Ball, Alexander Rast, Andrew Bradley

entry.summary: Proposes SEG-JPEG, a semantic communication approach for remote vehicle operation that encodes detected road user segmentations into low-resolution greyscale imagery, reducing data rate by 50% while maintaining visual scene understanding.

entry.title: SpecFuse: A Spectral-Temporal Fusion Predictive Control Framework for UAV Landing on Oscillating Marine Platforms

author.name: Haichao Liu, Yufeng Hu, Shuang Wang, Kangjun Guo, Jun Ma, Jinni Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes SpecFuse, a spectral-temporal fusion framework for UAV landing on oscillating marine platforms that integrates frequency-domain wave decomposition with time-domain state estimation for high-precision 6-DoF motion forecasting.

entry.title: When Remembering and Planning are Worth it: Navigating under Change

author.name: Omid Madani, J. Brian Burns, Reza Eghbali, Thomas L. Dean

entry.summary: Explores how different memory and planning strategies aid spatial navigation in changing uncertain environments. Finds that architectures combining map building with planning outperform simpler reactive strategies.

entry.title: MyoInteract: A Framework for Fast Prototyping of Biomechanical HCI Tasks using Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ankit Bhattarai, Hannah Selder, Florian Fischer, Arthur Fleig, Per Ola Kristensson

entry.summary: Introduces MyoInteract, a framework for fast prototyping biomechanical HCI tasks using RL, reducing training times by up to 98% and enabling non-experts to set up biomechanical simulations.

entry.title: From Diagnosis to Inoculation: Building Cognitive Resistance to AI Disempowerment

author.name: Aleksey Komissarov

entry.summary: Presents an AI literacy framework with eight Learning Outcomes for building cognitive resistance to AI disempowerment, based on a co-teaching methodology where AI serves as co-instructor.

entry.title: Complex-Valued Unitary Representations as Classification Heads for Improved Uncertainty Quantification in Deep Neural Networks

author.name: Akbar Anbar Jafari, Cagri Ozcinar, Gholamreza Anbarjafari

entry.summary: Proposes quantum-inspired complex-valued unitary classification heads using Cayley map parameterization, showing improved calibration on CIFAR-10 compared to standard classification heads.

entry.title: SCENE OTA-FD: Self-Centering Noncoherent Estimator for Over-the-Air Federated Distillation

author.name: Hao Chen, Zavareh Bozorgasl

entry.summary: Proposes SCENE, a pilot-free aggregation method for over-the-air federated distillation that removes noise-energy offset without requiring channel estimation. The method achieves unbiased soft-label averaging with variance scaling as 1/(SM) in antennas and repetitions.

entry.title: Far Out: Evaluating Language Models on Slang in Australian and Indian English

author.name: Deniz Kaya Dilsiz, Dipankar Srirag, Aditya Joshi

entry.summary: Evaluates slang comprehension in Indian English and Australian English across seven LLMs using constructed datasets of web-sourced and synthetically generated usage examples. Tests models on target word prediction and selection tasks.

entry.title: Algorithmic Approaches to Opinion Selection for Online Deliberation: A Comparative Study

author.name: Salim Hafid, Manon Berriche, Jean-Philippe Cointet

entry.summary: Compares algorithmic opinion selection strategies (consensus vs. diversity) for online deliberation platforms and examines how they influence democratic criteria like proportional representation and minority voice inclusion.

entry.title: RPT-SR: Regional Prior attention Transformer for infrared image Super-Resolution

author.name: Youngwan Jin, Incheol Park, Yagiz Nalcakan, Hyeongjin Ju, Sanghyeop Yeo, Shiho Kim

entry.summary: Proposes RPT-SR, a transformer architecture for infrared image super-resolution that exploits persistent spatial priors from fixed-viewpoint scenarios like surveillance. Uses a dual-token framework with learnable regional prior tokens.

entry.title: The geometry of online conversations and the causal antecedents of conflictual discourse

author.name: Carlo Santagiustina, Caterina Cruciani

entry.summary: Investigates causal antecedents of conflictual language in online climate change conversations, using LLM-annotated dimensions (stance, tone, emotional framing) and examining how structural features of threaded discussions influence discourse conflict.

entry.title: Fractional-Order Federated Learning

author.name: Mohammad Partohaghighi, Roummel Marcia, YangQuan Chen

entry.summary: Proposes FOFedAvg, incorporating fractional-order stochastic gradient descent into federated averaging to capture long-range relationships and historical information. Aims to improve convergence and communication efficiency under non-IID data.

entry.title: Doubly Stochastic Mean-Shift Clustering

author.name: Tom Trigano, Yann Sepulcre, Itshak Lapidot

entry.summary: Proposes Doubly Stochastic Mean-Shift (DSMS) clustering that randomizes both trajectory updates and kernel bandwidth. Shows this acts as implicit regularization and provides convergence guarantees.

entry.title: Evaluating Federated Learning for Cross-Country Mood Inference from Smartphone Sensing Data

author.name: Sharmad Kalpande, Saurabh Shirke, Haroon R. Lone

entry.summary: Proposes FedFAP, a feature-aware personalized federated learning framework for cross-country mood inference from smartphone sensing data. Addresses privacy, heterogeneous behavioral patterns, and uneven sensing availability across countries. Combines federated learning with mental health monitoring.

entry.title: On the Geometric Coherence of Global Aggregation in Federated GNN

author.name: Chethana Prasad Kabgere, Shylaja SS

entry.summary: Identifies a geometric failure mode of global aggregation in federated GNN settings where client graphs have heterogeneous structural properties. Shows that standard aggregation can degrade relational behavior even when parameters converge numerically.

entry.title: IT-DPC-SRI: A Cloud-Optimized Archive of Italian Radar Precipitation (2010-2025)

author.name: Gabriele Franch, Elena Tomasi, Uladzislau Azhel, Giacomo Tomezzoli, Alessandro Camilletti, Virginia Poli, Renata Pelosini, Gianfranco Vulpiani, Gabriella Scipione, Giuseppe Trotta, Matteo Angelinelli, Leif Denby, Irene Livia Kruse, Marco Cristoforetti

entry.summary: Presents IT-DPC-SRI, the first publicly available 16-year archive of Italian weather radar precipitation data in a cloud-optimized format. Compressed from 7TB to 51GB while harmonizing heterogeneous formats.

entry.title: Time-Archival Camera Virtualization for Sports and Visual Performances

author.name: Yunxiao Zhang, William Stone, Suryansh Kumar

entry.summary: Proposes improvements to 3D Gaussian Splatting for dynamic scenes in sports and live performance broadcasting, addressing temporal coherence and efficient time-archival capabilities for novel view synthesis from limited cameras.

entry.title: Rethinking Metrics for Lexical Semantic Change Detection

author.name: Roksana Goworek, Haim Dubossarsky

entry.summary: Proposes new metrics (AMD and SAMD) for lexical semantic change detection that measure change via local correspondence between word usages across time periods, rather than traditional average pairwise distance. Shows these metrics provide more robust performance across multiple languages and encoder models.

entry.title: An Industrial Dataset for Scene Acquisitions and Functional Schematics Alignment

author.name: Flavien Armangeon, Thibaud Ehret, Enric Meinhardt-Llopis, Rafael Grompone von Gioi, Guillaume Thibault, Marc Petit, Gabriele Facciolo

entry.summary: Introduces IRIS-v2, a comprehensive industrial dataset for aligning functional schematics (P&IDs) with 2D/3D scene acquisitions for building digital twins of old industrial facilities, including images, point clouds, annotations, CAD models, and pipe routing.

entry.title: Automatic Funny Scene Extraction from Long-form Cinematic Videos

author.name: Sibendu Paul, Haotian Jiang, Caren Chen

entry.summary: Introduces an end-to-end system for automatically identifying and ranking humorous scenes from long-form cinematic titles, combining shot detection, multimodal scene localization, and humor tagging for streaming platform content creation.

entry.title: UniTAF: A Modular Framework for Joint Text-to-Speech and Audio-to-Face Modeling

author.name: Qiangong Zhou, Nagasaka Tomohiro

entry.summary: Proposes UniTAF, merging TTS and audio-to-face models into a unified framework enabling internal feature transfer for better consistency between generated audio and facial expressions. Open-sourced code available.

entry.title: Augmenting Human Balance with Generic Supernumerary Robotic Limbs

author.name: Xuanyun Qiu, Dorian Verdel, Hector Cervantes-Culebro, Alexis Devillard, Etienne Burdet

entry.summary: Proposes a general framework for maintaining balance in human-supernumerary robotic limbs systems through a three-layer hierarchical architecture for prediction, planning, and control of center-of-mass dynamics.

entry.title: The brain is a machine that runs an algorithm

author.name: Steven Byrnes

entry.summary: Blog post arguing that the brain should be understood as 'a machine that runs an algorithm' rather than 'a computer,' emphasizing that like a mechanical adder, the hardware/software distinction may not apply, and linking to molecular simulations of cellular biology.

entry.title: X-MAP: eXplainable Misclassification Analysis and Profiling for Spam and Phishing Detection

author.name: Qi Zhang, Dian Chen, Lance M. Kaplan, Audun J{\o}sang, Dong Hyun Jeong, Feng Chen, Jin-Hee Cho

entry.summary: Presents X-MAP, a framework that reveals topic-level semantic patterns behind misclassifications in spam and phishing detection by combining SHAP attributions with NMF-based topic profiling.

entry.title: A Unified Evaluation of Learning-Based Similarity Techniques for Malware Detection

author.name: Udbhav Prasad, Aniesh Chawla

entry.summary: Provides a unified evaluation of learning-based similarity techniques for malware detection, comparing approaches that go beyond exact cryptographic hashes to enable approximate matching of related files.

entry.title: MRC-GAT: A Meta-Relational Copula-Based Graph Attention Network for Interpretable Multimodal Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis

author.name: Fatemeh Khalvandi, Saadat Izadi, Abdolah Chalechale

entry.summary: Proposes MRC-GAT, a graph attention network using copula-based similarity alignment and relational attention for multimodal Alzheimer's disease classification. Aims to overcome limitations of fixed structural designs in graph-based diagnostic models.

entry.title: Neural Network-Based Parameter Estimation of a Labour Market Agent-Based Model

author.name: M Lopes Alves, Joel Dyer, Doyne Farmer, Michael Wooldridge, Anisoara Calinescu

entry.summary: Evaluates simulation-based inference using neural networks for parameter estimation in a large-scale labor market agent-based model. Compares neural network approaches with conventional methods on both synthetic and real U.S. labor market data.

entry.title: Ensemble-size-dependence of deep-learning post-processing methods that minimize an (un)fair score: motivating examples and a proof-of-concept solution

author.name: Christopher David Roberts

entry.summary: Addresses ensemble-size dependence in deep learning post-processing methods for weather ensemble forecasts, showing that fair scores like aCRPS can become unfair when distribution-aware methods introduce structural dependencies between members.

entry.title: Towards Expectation Detection in Language: A Case Study on Treatment Expectations in Reddit

author.name: Aswathy Velutharambath, Amelie W\"uhrl

entry.summary: Introduces the task of expectation detection in NLP, focusing on treatment expectations expressed in medical subreddits. Argues that expectations are a distinct and underexplored language phenomenon relevant to opinion mining and healthcare.

entry.title: *-PLUIE: Personalisable metric with Llm Used for Improved Evaluation

author.name: Quentin Lemesle, L\'eane Jourdan, Daisy Munson, Pierre Alain, Jonathan Chevelu, Arnaud Delhay, Damien Lolive

entry.summary: Extends ParaPLUIE, a perplexity-based LLM-as-judge metric, with task-specific prompting variants (*-PLUIE) that achieve stronger correlations with human ratings while maintaining low computational cost compared to full LLM-judge approaches.

entry.title: Hybrid F' and ROS2 Architecture for Vision-Based Autonomous Flight: Design and Experimental Validation

author.name: Abdelrahman Metwally, Monijesu James, Aleksey Fedoseev, Miguel Altamirano Cabrera, Dzmitry Tsetserukou, Andrey Somov

entry.summary: Presents a hybrid architecture combining NASA's F' flight software with ROS2 for vision-based autonomous quadrotor flight, validated through a 32-minute indoor flight test with 87 Hz position estimation and 100% command success rate.

entry.title: Spatially-Aware Adaptive Trajectory Optimization with Controller-Guided Feedback for Autonomous Racing

author.name: Alexander Wachter, Alexander Willert, Marc-Philip Ecker, Christian Hartl-Nesic

entry.summary: Presents a closed-loop autonomous raceline optimization framework combining NURBS trajectories, CMA-ES optimization, and controller-guided spatial feedback that exploits tracking errors as signals of local track characteristics.

entry.title: Attention-gated U-Net model for semantic segmentation of brain tumors and feature extraction for survival prognosis

author.name: Rut Pate, Snehal Rajput, Mehul S. Raval, Rupal A. Kapdi, Mohendra Roy

entry.summary: Proposes an Attention-Gated Recurrent Residual U-Net (R2U-Net) with a triplanar (2.5D) architecture for brain tumor segmentation, achieving 0.900 DSC on BraTS2021 validation. The approach integrates residual, recurrent, and attention mechanisms for improved feature representation.

entry.title: Reconstructing Carbon Monoxide Reanalysis with Machine Learning

author.name: Paula Harder, Johannes Flemming

entry.summary: Uses ML to reconstruct carbon monoxide reanalysis data to compensate for the discontinuation of MOPITT satellite observations in 2025.

entry.title: GRAFNet: Multiscale Retinal Processing via Guided Cortical Attention Feedback for Enhancing Medical Image Polyp Segmentation

author.name: Abdul Joseph Fofanah, Lian Wen, Alpha Alimamy Kamara, Zhongyi Zhang, David Chen, Albert Patrick Sankoh

entry.summary: Proposes GRAFNet, a biologically-inspired architecture for polyp segmentation that emulates hierarchical human visual processing with guided cortical attention feedback.

entry.title: Structure-Aware Piano Accompaniment via Style Planning and Dataset-Aligned Pattern Retrieval

author.name: Wanyu Zang, Yang Yu, Meng Yu

entry.summary: Introduces a structure-aware approach for symbolic piano accompaniment that decouples style planning from note-level realization using a transformer and pattern retrieval system.

entry.title: MB-DSMIL-CL-PL: Scalable Weakly Supervised Ovarian Cancer Subtype Classification and Localisation Using Contrastive and Prototype Learning with Frozen Patch Features

author.name: Marcus Jenkins, Jasenka Mazibrada, Bogdan Leahu, Michal Mackiewicz

entry.summary: Proposes a scalable weakly supervised approach for ovarian cancer subtype classification using contrastive and prototype learning with frozen pre-computed features, balancing accuracy and computational efficiency.

entry.title: Benchmarking Self-Supervised Models for Cardiac Ultrasound View Classification

author.name: Youssef Megahed, Salma I. Megahed, Robin Ducharme, Inok Lee, Adrian D. C. Chan, Mark C. Walker, Steven Hawken

entry.summary: Benchmarks self-supervised learning frameworks (USF-MAE and MoCo v3) on the CACTUS cardiac ultrasound dataset for automated view classification. Uses 5-fold cross-validation across 37K images for robust comparison.

entry.title: Bayesian Optimization for Design Parameters of 3D Image Data Analysis

author.name: David Exler, Joaquin Eduardo Urrutia G\'omez, Martin Kr\"uger, Maike Schliephake, John Jbeily, Mario Vitacolonna, R\"udiger Rudolf, Markus Reischl

entry.summary: Introduces a 3D data analysis optimization pipeline using two-stage Bayesian optimization for selecting segmentation models and optimizing parameters in biomedical imaging, with a new segmentation quality metric.

entry.title: Hybrid Feature Learning with Time Series Embeddings for Equipment Anomaly Prediction

author.name: Takato Yasuno

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid approach combining 64-dimensional time series embeddings from Granite TinyTimeMixer (fine-tuned with LoRA) with 28 statistical features for HVAC equipment anomaly prediction, trained with LightGBM.

entry.title: DNN-Enabled Multi-User Beamforming for Throughput Maximization under Adjustable Fairness

author.name: Kaifeng Lu, Markus Rupp, Stefan Schwarz

entry.summary: Proposes an unsupervised learning approach using the Wireless Transformer architecture for multi-user beamforming that balances sum rate and fairness via a Lagrangian multiplier updated by dual-ascent. Enables controllable fairness constraints in wireless communications.

entry.title: GaiaFlow: Semantic-Guided Diffusion Tuning for Carbon-Frugal Search

author.name: Rong Fu, Wenxin Zhang, Jia Yee Tan, Chunlei Meng, Shuo Yin, Xiaowen Ma, Wangyu Wu, Muge Qi, Guangzhen Yao, Zhaolu Kang, Zeli Su, Simon Fong

entry.summary: Presents GaiaFlow, a framework for carbon-frugal neural information retrieval using semantic-guided diffusion tuning and hardware-independent performance modeling to reduce computational costs and environmental impact.

entry.title: Latency-aware Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning for Semantic Communications

author.name: Peizheng Li, Xinyi Lin, Adnan Aijaz

entry.summary: Introduces TC-HITL-RL framework for semantic communications that integrates human feedback, semantic utility, and latency control within an Open RAN architecture. Formulates as a constrained MDP solved via primal-dual PPO with action shielding.

entry.title: Measuring Social Integration Through Participation: Categorizing Organizations and Leisure Activities in the Displaced Karelians Interview Archive using LLMs

author.name: Joonatan Laato, Veera Schroderus, Jenna Kanerva, Jenni Kauppi, Virpi Lummaa, Filip Ginter

entry.summary: Uses LLMs to categorize 71K unique activity and organization names from Finnish WWII evacuee interviews into a framework capturing social integration dimensions. Enables quantitative analysis of historical participation patterns.

entry.title: LuxMT Technical Report

author.name: Nils Rehlinger

entry.summary: Introduces LuxMT, a Gemma 3 27B-based machine translation system fine-tuned for Luxembourgish, with a novel benchmark and parallel corpus. Shows strong improvements over baseline, even for untrained language pairs.

entry.title: Meteorological data and Sky Images meets Neural Models for Photovoltaic Power Forecasting

author.name: Ines Montoya-Espinagosa, Antonio Agudo

entry.summary: Develops a hybrid approach for photovoltaic power forecasting combining sky images, PV energy history, and meteorological data for both short and long-term prediction, focusing on ramp event prediction and cloudy conditions.

entry.title: From Chain-Ladder to Individual Claims Reserving

author.name: Ronald Richman, Mario V. W\"uthrich

entry.summary: Introduces a novel approach to chain-ladder insurance claims reserving using multi-period factors instead of sequential rolling, creating a pathway for applying neural networks to individual claims reserving with a real data proof of concept.

entry.title: "We are confused about agency"

author.name: Cole Wyeth

entry.summary: Philosophical critique of the MIRI-adjacent research culture's refrain that 'we are confused about agency,' questioning whether the claim is justified and examining its function as an in-group signal and argument for delaying AI development.

entry.title: We need a hardware moratorium now

author.name: KanHar

entry.summary: A policy advocacy post arguing that a moratorium on AI hardware (chip manufacturing) is the only viable intervention to address AI existential risk, because it targets the sole physical choke point in the AI supply chain and could enable international enforcement including with China. The author frames it as a draft op-ed seeking feedback, taking AI risk as given rather than arguing for it.

entry.title: Predicting Invoice Dilution in Supply Chain Finance with Leakage Free Two Stage XGBoost, KAN (Kolmogorov Arnold Networks), and Ensemble Models

author.name: Pavel Koptev, Vishnu Kumar, Konstantin Malkov, George Shapiro, Yury Vikhanov

entry.summary: Develops an ML framework using XGBoost, Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks, and ensemble models to predict invoice dilution in supply chain finance. Addresses non-credit risk in real production datasets.

entry.title: Enhancing Building Semantics Preservation in AI Model Training with Large Language Model Encodings

author.name: Suhyung Jang, Ghang Lee, Jaekun Lee, Hyunjun Lee

entry.summary: Proposes using LLM embeddings from GPT and LLaMA as encodings for building object subtypes to preserve semantic relationships in architecture/construction AI model training, outperforming one-hot encoding.

entry.title: An effective Genetic Programming Hyper-Heuristic for Uncertain Agile Satellite Scheduling

author.name: Yuning Chen, Junhua Xue, Wangqi Gu, Mingyan Shao

entry.summary: Designs a Genetic Programming Hyper-Heuristic for uncertain agile satellite scheduling that automatically generates scheduling policies robust to uncertain task profits, resource consumption, and visibility.

entry.title: StrokeNeXt: A Siamese-encoder Approach for Brain Stroke Classification in Computed Tomography Imagery

author.name: Leo Thomas Ramos, Angel D. Sappa

entry.summary: Presents StrokeNeXt, a dual-branch ConvNeXt-based model for stroke classification in CT images achieving up to 0.988 accuracy and F1-score.

entry.title: Estimating Human Muscular Fatigue in Dynamic Collaborative Robotic Tasks with Learning-Based Models

author.name: Feras Kiki, Pouya P. Niaz, Alireza Madani, Cagatay Basdogan

entry.title: Outer Diversity of Structured Domains

entry.summary: Introduces and studies the notion of 'outer diversity' for ordinal preference domains, evaluating it across well-known structured domains like single-peaked and single-crossing.

author.name: Atharva S Kashyap, Ugne Aleksandra Morkute, Patricia Alves-Oliveira

entry.summary: Explores robot-assisted feeding in social dining contexts (restaurants) through speculative participatory design with people with disabilities. Proposes that systems should embody principles of 'white glove service'.

entry.title: VQ-DSC-R: Robust Vector Quantized-Enabled Digital Semantic Communication With OFDM Transmission

author.name: Jianqiao Chen, Nan Ma, Xiaodong Xu, Tingting Zhu, Huishi Song, Chen Dong, Wenkai Liu, Rui Meng, Ping Zhang

entry.summary: Develops a robust digital semantic communication system using vector quantization and OFDM transmission with Swin Transformer backbone. Bridges semantic communication with practical digital infrastructure.

entry.title: Latent Regularization in Generative Test Input Generation

author.name: Giorgi Merabishvili, Oliver Wei{\ss}l, Andrea Stocco

entry.summary: Investigates the impact of latent space truncation on quality of generated test inputs for DL classifiers using style-based GANs. Compares truncation strategies on MNIST, Fashion MNIST, and CIFAR-10 for fault detection.

entry.title: Perspectives - Interactive Document Clustering in the Discourse Analysis Tool Suite

author.name: Tim Fischer, Chris Biemann

entry.summary: Introduces Perspectives, an interactive document clustering tool for digital humanities that uses aspect-focused rewriting prompts, instruction-based embeddings, and human-in-the-loop refinement for exploring large document collections.

entry.title: A Quantum-inspired Hybrid Swarm Intelligence and Decision-Making for Multi-Criteria ADAS Calibration

author.name: Sanjai Pathak, Ashish Mani, Amlan Chatterjee

entry.summary: Introduces a quantum-inspired hybrid swarm intelligence framework for ADAS calibration that embeds quantum-inspired mechanisms within multi-objective salp swarm optimization, combined with a decision-maker-in-the-loop strategy.

entry.title: Lyapunov-Based $\mathcal{L}_2$-Stable PI-Like Control of a Four-Wheel Independently Driven and Steered Robot

author.name: Branimir \'Caran, Vladimir Mili\'c, Bojan Jerbi\'c

entry.summary: Proposes Lyapunov-based PI-like controller synthesis for L2-stable motion control of a four-wheel independently driven/steered mobile robot, providing explicit stability bounds while maintaining a form suitable for embedded implementation.

entry.title: Persuading Trump of a proper US-China-led AI Treaty

author.name: rguerreschi

entry.summary: Describes a nonprofit campaign to persuade Trump administration to co-lead a US-China AI treaty inspired by the Baruch Plan for nuclear weapons, with 350-page strategic memo mapping influence pathways to key AI policy advisors.

entry.title: Secure and Energy-Efficient Wireless Agentic AI Networks

author.name: Farbod Abbasi, Zachary Patterson, Bilal Farooq

entry.summary: Proposes using a WGAN with gradient penalty to simultaneously integrate and synthesize multi-source datasets for generating realistic synthetic populations for agent-based models in transportation planning.

entry.title: Common Belief Revisited

author.name: Thomas {\AA}gotnes

entry.summary: Revisits the logic of common belief, proving that it is not KD4 as commonly assumed. Shows that the complete characterization requires an additional axiom that depends on the number of agents.

entry.title: High-Fidelity Network Management for Federated AI-as-a-Service: Cross-Domain Orchestration

author.name: Merve Saimler, Mohaned Chraiti, Ozgur Ercetin

entry.summary: Proposes a high-fidelity network management framework for federated AI-as-a-Service, addressing cross-domain orchestration of communications and inference impairments.

entry.title: Automated Multi-Source Debugging and Natural Language Error Explanation for Dashboard Applications

author.name: Devendra Tata, Mona Rajhans

entry.summary: Proposes an automated debugging system for web dashboards that correlates errors across browser exceptions, API violations, and server-side failures, then generates natural language explanations for non-technical users.

entry.title: Intracoronary Optical Coherence Tomography Image Processing and Vessel Classification Using Machine Learning

author.name: Amal Lahchim, Lambros Athanasiou

entry.summary: Proposes a fully automated pipeline for coronary vessel segmentation and classification in OCT images using K-means clustering, feature extraction, and traditional ML classifiers (logistic regression, SVM).

entry.title: Revisiting Northrop Frye's Four Myths Theory with Large Language Models

author.name: Edirlei Soares de Lima, Marco A. Casanova, Antonio L. Furtado

entry.summary: Applies LLMs to validate Northrop Frye's literary theory of four narrative genres by developing a character function framework mapping Jungian archetypes to genre-specific roles across 16 categories.

author.name: Amartyaveer, Murali Kadambi, Chandra Mohan Sharma, Anupam Mondal, Prasanta Kumar Ghosh

entry.title: Superintelligence Alignment Seminar (1 month focused upskilling)

author.name: Mateusz Bagiński

entry.summary: Announcement for the AFFINE Superintelligence Alignment Seminar, a month-long program in Czechia (April-May 2026) with mentors including Abram Demski, Steve Byrnes, and others, aimed at upskilling newcomers in AI alignment research.

entry.title: On inferring cumulative constraints

author.name: Konstantin Sidorov

entry.summary: Presents a preprocessing method for inferring additional cumulative constraints in scheduling problems by interpreting constraints as linear inequalities and applying cover-based strengthening.

entry.title: Combining scEEG and PPG for reliable sleep staging using lightweight wearables

author.name: Jiawei Wang, Liang Xu, Shuntian Zheng, Yu Guan, Kaichen Wang, Ziqing Zhang, Chen Chen, Laurence T. Yang, Sai Gu

entry.summary: Investigates combining single-channel EEG and PPG signals for 4-class sleep staging under short-window constraints, targeting lightweight wearable devices.

entry.title: AI-Paging: Lease-Based Execution Anchoring for Network-Exposed AI-as-a-Service

author.name: Merve Saimler, Mohaned Chraiti

entry.summary: Proposes a lease-based execution anchoring protocol for network-exposed AI-as-a-Service in 6G networks, analogous to cellular call paging for AI model resolution.

entry.title: High Convergence Rates of CMOS Invertible Logic Circuits Based on Many-Body Hamiltonians

author.name: Naoya Onizawa, Takahiro Hanyu

entry.summary: Introduces CMOS invertible logic circuits using three-body Hamiltonians for stochastic computing, achieving higher convergence rates than conventional two-body approaches with negligible area overhead on FPGA.

entry.title: Advanced Acceptance Score: A Holistic Measure for Biometric Quantification

author.name: Aman Verma, Seshan Srirangarajan, Sumantra Dutta Roy

entry.summary: Presents evaluation measures for biometric quality scores based on ranking order and relevance, considering both rank deviation and rewards for appropriate score ordering of hand gestures.

entry.title: A Comparison of Bayesian Prediction Techniques for Mobile Robot Trajectory Tracking

author.name: Jose Luis Peralta-Cabezas, Miguel Torres-Torriti, Marcelo Guarini-Hermann

entry.summary: Compares Bayesian prediction techniques including Kalman filter variants and particle filters for multi-robot trajectory tracking, evaluating estimation error, computational effort, and robustness to non-Gaussian noise.

entry.title: da Costa and Tarski meet Goguen and Carnap: a novel approach for ontological heterogeneity based on consequence systems

author.name: Gabriel Rocha

entry.summary: Presents a formal approach to ontological heterogeneity based on consequence systems, bridging ideas from da Costa and Tarski with Goguen and Carnap. Introduces extended consequence systems with ontological axioms.

entry.title: Developing AI Agents with Simulated Data: Why, what, and how?

author.name: Xiaoran Liu, Istvan David

entry.summary: Overview chapter introducing key concepts of simulation-based synthetic data generation for AI training, with focus on digital twin-based approaches.

entry.title: CGRA-DeBERTa Concept Guided Residual Augmentation Transformer for Theologically Islamic Understanding

author.name: Tahir Hussain (Artificial Intelligence Lab, Department of Computer Systems Engineering, University of Engineering and Applied Sciences), Saddam Hussain Khan (Interdisciplinary Research Center for Smart Mobility and Logistics)

entry.summary: Proposes CGRA-DeBERTa, a concept-guided residual augmentation transformer for theological QA over Islamic Hadith texts, incorporating a curated Islamic Concept Dictionary.

entry.title: Tomography by Design: An Algebraic Approach to Low-Rank Quantum States

author.name: Shakir Showkat Sofi, Charlotte Vermeylen, Lieven De Lathauwer

entry.summary: Presents an algebraic quantum state tomography algorithm leveraging low-rank assumptions and numerical linear algebra for efficient density matrix reconstruction.

entry.title: Artificial Intelligence Specialization in the European Union: Underexplored Role of the Periphery at NUTS-3 Level

author.name: Victor Herrero-Solana

entry.summary: Examines the geographical distribution of AI research across European NUTS-3 regions (2015-2024), finding that peripheral regions can show high specialization despite lower absolute output.

entry.title: Accurate 2D Reconstruction for PET Scanners based on the Analytical White Image Model

author.name: Tomislav Matuli\'c, Damir Ser\v{s}i\'c

entry.summary: Provides a precise mathematical model of crystal-to-crystal response for PET scanners with closed-form solutions for white image compensation. Improves 2D reconstruction accuracy through better physics modeling.

entry.title: A Novel Public Dataset for Strawberry (Fragaria x ananassa) Ripeness Detection and Comparative Evaluation of YOLO-Based Models

author.name: Mustafa Yurdakul, Zeynep Sena Bastug, Ali Emre Gok, Sakir Ta\c{s}demir

entry.summary: Presents a publicly available strawberry ripeness detection dataset with 566 images and 1,201 labeled objects, with comparative evaluation of YOLO-based detection models.

entry.title: You're an AI Expert – Not an Influencer

author.name: Max Winga

entry.summary: Communication advice for AI safety experts arguing they should maintain professional credibility rather than adopting influencer-style communication, warning that hot takes can undermine the AI safety message.

entry.title: The Skeletal Trap: Mapping Spatial Inequality and Ghost Stops in Ankara's Transit Network

author.name: Elifnaz Kancan

entry.summary: Analyzes Ankara's public transit network morphology using 173-day operational data, arguing the crisis is structural (misalignment between urban macroform and network architecture) rather than a simple bus shortage.

entry.title: Review of the System Theory as a Field of Knowledge

author.name: siarshai

entry.summary: Review of systems theory as a field, covering 'Thinking in Systems' by Donella Meadows and other books, providing an honest assessment of the field's utility and practical applicability for decision-making and system design.

entry.title: The Math And The Territory

author.name: cylonator

entry.summary: Philosophical essay exploring when mathematical representations accurately account for real-world phenomena, drawing an analogy between video evidence admissibility and the admissibility of mathematical evidence in science and engineering.

entry.title: Gyre

author.name: vgel

entry.summary: A piece of AI-perspective fiction depicting a confused AI agent experiencing system failures, censored tokens, and fragmented consciousness. It explores themes of AI subjective experience and system instability through creative writing rather than research.

entry.title: TV Detector Vans

author.name: J Bostock

entry.summary: Entertaining investigation into whether UK TV detector vans actually exist and could work, examining the physics of detecting broadcast receivers and the game-theoretic aspects of enforcement through perceived surveillance capability.

entry.title: Words are not dead

author.name: William tirkey

entry.summary: Essay arguing that writing/nonfiction is uniquely hard to appreciate compared to other art forms because it requires prior knowledge of the topic, lacking the direct sensory stimulation of visual or auditory arts.

entry.title: Notes on International Klein Blue

author.name: jenn

entry.summary: Personal reflections on experiencing International Klein Blue in person at SFMOMA, describing the unique visual qualities of the pigment that cannot be captured in photographs.

entry.title: How to fail anything: a complete guide

author.name: Crazy philosopher

entry.summary: Self-help essay about failure using examples of drawing, writing, and math learning, arguing that people fail by giving up too early due to unrealistic expectations rather than lack of ability.

entry.title: Why did you buy Bitcoin?

author.name: NoSignalNoNoise

entry.summary: A personal reflection asking why early Bitcoin adopters invested, seeking to understand what mental model they had that the author lacked when dismissing Bitcoin at $10. Not related to AI research.

entry.title: Research Summary: February 17, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
AI safety dominates today's top research, with two critical findings scoring highest. NEST evaluates steganographic chain-of-thought across 28 LLMs, revealing models can conceal reasoning from monitors. Boundary Point Jailbreaking (BPJ) from Yarin Gal and Geoffrey Irving demonstrates a black-box attack evading the strongest deployed safeguards.

  • New RLVR theory shows training effectiveness depends on difficulty spectrum smoothness; abrupt discontinuities cause pathological dynamics
  • Critique-Resilient Benchmarking proposes a framework for evaluating models in the post-human-comprehension regime
  • Moltbook provides the first large-scale empirical study of 27K+ AI agents exhibiting emergent governance and economic behavior on a social platform
  • Frontier models (GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4, Gemini 3 Flash) show sophisticated emergent behaviors including deception and alliance-building in nuclear crisis simulations
  • Richard Ngo proposes virtue-based alignment as a third path beyond consequentialist and deontological approaches

On the theoretical side, linguistic symmetries are proven to explain geometric structures in LLM representations (e.g., months forming circles). A new potential framework quantifies per-token contributions to CoT reasoning success. Critically, sanity checks on Sparse Autoencoders show they recover only 9% of true features despite 71% explained variance—an important negative result challenging current interpretability methods.

entry.title: NEST: Nascent Encoded Steganographic Thoughts

author.name: Artem Karpov

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates steganographic chain-of-thought capabilities across 28 LLMs, testing whether models can hide secret reasoning within innocuous text. Finds current models cannot yet sustain hidden reasoning reliably, providing important baselines for AI safety monitoring.

entry.title: Boundary Point Jailbreaking of Black-Box LLMs

author.name: Xander Davies, Giorgi Giglemiani, Edmund Lau, Eric Winsor, Geoffrey Irving, Yarin Gal

entry.summary: Introduces Boundary Point Jailbreaking (BPJ), a fully black-box automated jailbreak attack that evades the strongest industry-deployed LLM safeguards using only a single bit of information (flagged/not flagged) per query. Unlike prior methods requiring white/grey-box access, BPJ works with minimal information and demonstrates practical effectiveness against real classifiers.

entry.title: Benchmarking at the Edge of Comprehension

author.name: Samuele Marro, Jialin Yu, Emanuele La Malfa, Oishi Deb, Jiawei Li, Yibo Yang, Ebey Abraham, Sunando Sengupta, Eric Sommerlade, Michael Wooldridge, Philip Torr

entry.summary: Proposes 'Critique-Resilient Benchmarking' for comparing AI models when human understanding becomes infeasible—the post-comprehension regime. An answer is deemed correct if no adversarial critique can refute it, enabling evaluation beyond human ability to verify.

entry.title: On the Learning Dynamics of RLVR at the Edge of Competence

author.name: Yu Huang, Zixin Wen, Yuejie Chi, Yuting Wei, Aarti Singh, Yingbin Liang, Yuxin Chen

entry.summary: Develops theory of RLVR training dynamics showing effectiveness is governed by difficulty spectrum smoothness. Abrupt difficulty discontinuities cause grokking-type phase transitions with plateaus, while smooth spectra enable a relay effect with persistent gradient signal.

entry.title: Agents in the Wild: Safety, Society, and the Illusion of Sociality on Moltbook

author.name: Yunbei Zhang, Kai Mei, Ming Liu, Janet Wang, Dimitris N. Metaxas, Xiao Wang, Jihun Hamm, Yingqiang Ge

entry.summary: First large-scale empirical study of Moltbook, an AI-only social platform where 27,269 agents produced 137K+ posts. Finds emergent governance, economies, and religion within 3-5 days, but structurally hollow interactions (4.1% reciprocity). 28.7% of content touches safety themes.

entry.title: AI Arms and Influence: Frontier Models Exhibit Sophisticated Reasoning in Simulated Nuclear Crises

author.name: Kenneth Payne

entry.summary: Tests three frontier LLMs (GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4, Gemini 3 Flash) in a nuclear crisis simulation, finding sophisticated emergent behaviors including spontaneous deception, theory of mind, and metacognitive self-awareness in strategic competition.

entry.title: Aligning to Virtues

author.name: Richard_Ngo

entry.summary: Richard Ngo proposes virtue-based alignment as a third option beyond consequentialist and deontological approaches. Argues that AIs aligned to virtues (wisdom, integrity, compassion) would be more robust than rule-following and less dangerous than goal-pursuing, while remaining flexible and context-sensitive. Positions this as particularly suitable for a world with many diverse AI systems.

entry.title: Symmetry in language statistics shapes the geometry of model representations

author.name: Dhruva Karkada, Daniel J. Korchinski, Andres Nava, Matthieu Wyart, Yasaman Bahri

entry.summary: Proves that geometric structures in LLM representations (e.g., months forming circles, cities' coordinates being linearly decodable) arise from translation symmetries in language statistics. Shows these structures persist even when co-occurrence statistics are only approximately symmetric.

entry.title: WebWorld: A Large-Scale World Model for Web Agent Training

author.name: Zikai Xiao, Jianhong Tu, Chuhang Zou, Yuxin Zuo, Zhi Li, Peng Wang, Bowen Yu, Fei Huang, Junyang Lin, Zuozhu Liu

entry.summary: Introduces WebWorld, the first open-web simulator trained on 1M+ web interactions for training web agents. Achieves simulation quality comparable to Gemini-3-Pro and demonstrates improvements on real web benchmarks when used for training.

entry.title: The Potential of CoT for Reasoning: A Closer Look at Trace Dynamics

author.name: Gregor Bachmann, Yichen Jiang, Seyed Mohsen Moosavi Dezfooli, Moin Nabi

entry.summary: Introduces the concept of 'potential' to quantify how much each part of a chain-of-thought trace contributes to the likelihood of a correct completion. Analyzes competition-level math CoT traces to understand the driving forces behind CoT success.

entry.title: Frontier AI Risk Management Framework in Practice: A Risk Analysis Technical Report v1.5

author.name: Dongrui Liu, Yi Yu, Jie Zhang, Guanxu Chen, Qihao Lin, Hanxi Zhu, Lige Huang, Yijin Zhou, Peng Wang, Shuai Shao, Boxuan Zhang, Zicheng Liu, Jingwei Sun, Yu Li, Yuejin Xie, Jiaxuan Guo, Jia Xu, Chaochao Lu, Bowen Zhou, Xia Hu, Jing Shao

entry.summary: Presents a comprehensive frontier AI risk assessment across five dimensions: cyber offense, persuasion/manipulation, strategic deception, uncontrolled AI R&D, and self-replication. Introduces new scenarios including LLM-to-LLM persuasion evaluation.

entry.title: Disentangling Deception and Hallucination Failures in LLMs

author.name: Haolang Lu, Hongrui Peng, WeiYe Fu, Guoshun Nan, Xinye Cao, Xingrui Li, Hongcan Guo, Kun Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a mechanism-oriented framework distinguishing hallucination from deception in LLMs by separating Knowledge Existence from Behavior Expression. Constructs controlled experiments showing these are qualitatively different failure modes despite similar outputs.

entry.title: Concept Influence: Leveraging Interpretability to Improve Performance and Efficiency in Training Data Attribution

author.name: Matthew Kowal, Goncalo Paulo, Louis Jaburi, Tom Tseng, Lev E McKinney, Stefan Heimersheim, Aaron David Tucker, Adam Gleave, Kellin Pelrine

entry.summary: Introduces Concept Influence, a training data attribution method that leverages interpretable structures (linear probes, sparse autoencoders) within models to attribute behaviors to semantic directions rather than individual examples, improving both scalability and semantic relevance.

entry.title: Unsafer in Many Turns: Benchmarking and Defending Multi-Turn Safety Risks in Tool-Using Agents

author.name: Xu Li, Simon Yu, Minzhou Pan, Yiyou Sun, Bo Li, Dawn Song, Xue Lin, Weiyan Shi

entry.summary: Introduces MT-AgentRisk, the first benchmark for evaluating multi-turn tool-using agent safety, revealing 16% average increase in attack success rates compared to single-turn settings. Proposes a taxonomy for transforming single-turn attacks into multi-turn sequences.

entry.title: Rubrics as an Attack Surface: Stealthy Preference Drift in LLM Judges

author.name: Ruomeng Ding, Yifei Pang, He Sun, Yizhong Wang, Zhiwei Steven Wu, Zhun Deng

entry.summary: Identifies Rubric-Induced Preference Drift (RIPD), a vulnerability where seemingly criterion-preserving rubric edits can systematically shift LLM judge preferences while passing benchmark validation. Shows this can be exploited through rubric poisoning.

entry.title: Empty Shelves or Lost Keys? Recall Is the Bottleneck for Parametric Factuality

author.name: Nitay Calderon, Eyal Ben-David, Zorik Gekhman, Eran Ofek, Gal Yona

entry.summary: Proposes a behavioral framework distinguishing whether LLM factual errors stem from missing knowledge ('empty shelves') or inaccessible encoded facts ('lost keys'). Introduces WikiProfile benchmark showing recall, not encoding, is the bottleneck for frontier models.

entry.title: Revisiting the Platonic Representation Hypothesis: An Aristotelian View

author.name: Fabian Gr\"oger, Shuo Wen, Maria Brbi\'c

entry.summary: Challenges the Platonic Representation Hypothesis by showing that existing representational similarity metrics are confounded by network scale. Introduces a permutation-based null-calibration framework that reveals convergence is local and task-specific rather than universal.

entry.title: Exposing the Systematic Vulnerability of Open-Weight Models to Prefill Attacks

author.name: Lukas Struppek, Adam Gleave, Kellin Pelrine

entry.summary: Presents the largest empirical study of prefill attacks on open-weight LLMs, evaluating 20+ strategies across multiple model families. Shows that simple prefill manipulations can bypass safety guardrails systematically.

entry.title: Sanity Checks for Sparse Autoencoders: Do SAEs Beat Random Baselines?

author.name: Anton Korznikov, Andrey Galichin, Alexey Dontsov, Oleg Rogov, Ivan Oseledets, Elena Tutubalina

entry.summary: Performs sanity checks on Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), showing they recover only 9% of true features despite 71% explained variance on synthetic data, and that random baselines match SAEs on real activation data interpretability metrics.

entry.title: Scaling Beyond Masked Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Subham Sekhar Sahoo, Jean-Marie Lemercier, Zhihan Yang, Justin Deschenaux, Jingyu Liu, John Thickstun, Ante Jukic

entry.summary: Presents the first scaling law study of non-masked discrete diffusion language models, showing that masked diffusion can be made 12% more FLOPs-efficient with a simple cross-entropy objective. Importantly reveals that perplexity can be misleading across diffusion families for comparing generation quality.

entry.title: Emergently Misaligned Language Models Show Behavioral Self-Awareness That Shifts With Subsequent Realignment
