entry.summary: Introduces an Information Bottleneck regularizer for Concept Bottleneck Models that penalizes I(X;C) while preserving I(C;Y), improving both accuracy and faithfulness across six CBM families and three benchmarks.

entry.title: Unbiased Approximate Vector-Jacobian Products for Efficient Backpropagation

author.name: Killian Bakong (DI-ENS), Laurent Massouli\'e (Inria, ARGO, CMAP), Edouard Oyallon (MLIA), Kevin Scaman

entry.summary: Introduces unbiased randomized approximations of vector-Jacobian products for backpropagation, establishing optimality properties under sparsity constraints and validating on MLPs, BagNets, and Vision Transformers.

entry.title: On the Stability of Nonlinear Dynamics in GD and SGD: Beyond Quadratic Potentials

author.name: Rotem Mulayoff, Sebastian U. Stich

entry.summary: Studies stability of nonlinear dynamics in GD/SGD beyond quadratic potentials, deriving exact criteria for stable oscillations near linearly unstable minima. Shows linear analysis can be misleading.

entry.title: FUTON: Fourier Tensor Network for Implicit Neural Representations

author.name: Pooya Ashtari, Pourya Behmandpoor, Nikos Deligiannis, Aleksandra Pizurica

entry.summary: Introduces FUTON, an implicit neural representation that models signals as generalized Fourier series with low-rank tensor decomposition coefficients. Provides universal approximation guarantees and improved convergence and extrapolation over MLP-based INRs.

entry.title: Quantifying Normality: Convergence Rate to Gaussian Limit for Stochastic Approximation and Unadjusted OU Algorithm

author.name: Shaan Ul Haque, Zedong Wang, Zixuan Zhang, Siva Theja Maguluri

entry.summary: Establishes non-asymptotic bounds on the Wasserstein distance between rescaled stochastic approximation iterates and their Gaussian limit for various step-size schedules, yielding sharp convergence rates.

entry.title: Learning Part-Aware Dense 3D Feature Field for Generalizable Articulated Object Manipulation

author.name: Yue Chen, Muqing Jiang, Kaifeng Zheng, Jiaqi Liang, Chenrui Tie, Haoran Lu, Ruihai Wu, Hao Dong

entry.summary: Proposes PartField for learning part-aware dense 3D feature fields for generalizable articulated object manipulation, addressing multi-view inconsistencies and low resolution in prior 2D-to-3D feature lifting approaches.

entry.title: Fast Compute for ML Optimization

author.name: Nick Polson, Vadim Sokolov

entry.summary: Introduces Scale Mixture EM (SM-EM), an optimization algorithm derived from variance-mean scale-mixture representations that naturally derives Adam-like scaling and weight decay, removing user-specified learning rates and momentum schedules.

entry.title: Frequentist Regret Analysis of Gaussian Process Thompson Sampling via Fractional Posteriors

author.name: Somjit Roy, Prateek Jaiswal, Anirban Bhattacharya, Debdeep Pati, Bani K. Mallick

entry.summary: Provides frequentist regret analysis for GP Thompson Sampling over continuous action spaces without domain discretization, showing variance inflation equals fractional posterior tempering. Derives kernel-agnostic bounds.

entry.title: Beyond Translation: Evaluating Mathematical Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs in Sinhala and Tamil

author.name: Sukumar Kishanthan, Kumar Thushalika, Buddhi Jayasekara, Asela Hevapathige

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs' mathematical reasoning in Sinhala and Tamil to determine whether they genuinely reason in these languages or implicitly translate to English. Uses a taxonomy of six problem types with parallel native-language datasets.

entry.title: GenPANIS: A Latent-Variable Generative Framework for Forward and Inverse PDE Problems in Multiphase Media

author.name: Matthaios Chatzopoulos, Phaedon-Stelios Koutsourelakis

entry.summary: Proposes GenPANIS, a unified generative framework for forward and inverse PDE problems in multiphase media that preserves exact discrete microstructures while enabling gradient-based inference through continuous latent embeddings.

entry.title: DistillLens: Symmetric Knowledge Distillation Through Logit Lens

author.name: Manish Dhakal, Uthman Jinadu, Anjila Budathoki, Rajshekhar Sunderraman, Yi Ding

entry.summary: Introduces DistillLens, a knowledge distillation framework that aligns intermediate hidden states of student and teacher models by projecting them into vocabulary space via the Logit Lens technique. Uses symmetric divergence to capture uncertainty profiles throughout the model's layers.

entry.title: LogitsCoder: Towards Efficient Chain-of-Thought Path Search via Logits Preference Decoding for Code Generation

author.name: Jizheng Chen, Weiming Zhang, Xinyi Dai, Weiwen Liu, Kounianhua Du, Yasheng Wang, Ruiming Tang, Yong Yu, Weinan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes LogitsCoder, a framework that uses lightweight logit-level control mechanisms to improve chain-of-thought reasoning for code generation, addressing both underthinking (shallow reasoning) and overthinking (verbose inefficiency).

entry.title: Index Light, Reason Deep: Deferred Visual Ingestion for Visual-Dense Document Question Answering

author.name: Tao Xu

entry.summary: Proposes Deferred Visual Ingestion (DVI) for document QA that performs lightweight metadata extraction during indexing and defers heavy VLM processing to query time, reducing costs compared to pre-ingestion approaches that run VLMs on every page.

entry.title: SecureGate: Learning When to Reveal PII Safely via Token-Gated Dual-Adapters for Federated LLMs

author.name: Mohamed Shaaban, Mohamed Elmahallawy

entry.summary: Proposes SecureGate, a dual-adapter approach for federated LLM fine-tuning that uses token-level gating to balance PII privacy protection with downstream utility, addressing the tension between global generalization and local utility.

entry.title: T2MBench: A Benchmark for Out-of-Distribution Text-to-Motion Generation

author.name: Bin Yang, Rong Ou, Weisheng Xu, Jiaqi Xiong, Xintao Li, Taowen Wang, Luyu Zhu, Xu Jiang, Jing Tan, Renjing Xu

entry.summary: Proposes T2MBench, a benchmark for evaluating text-to-motion generation under out-of-distribution textual conditions, with 1,025 OOD prompts and evaluation of 14 baseline models.

entry.title: SAM4Dcap: Training-free Biomechanical Twin System from Monocular Video

author.name: Li Wang, HaoYu Wang, Xi Chen, ZeKun Jiang, Kang Li, Jian Li

entry.summary: Presents SAM4Dcap, an open-source training-free framework for biomechanical analysis from monocular video, integrating 4D human mesh recovery with OpenSim biomechanical solver for clinical metrics.

entry.title: UniRef-Image-Edit: Towards Scalable and Consistent Multi-Reference Image Editing

author.name: Hongyang Wei, Bin Wen, Yancheng Long, Yankai Yang, Yuhang Hu, Tianke Zhang, Wei Chen, Haonan Fan, Kaiyu Jiang, Jiankang Chen, Changyi Liu, Kaiyu Tang, Haojie Ding, Xiao Yang, Jia Sun, Huaiqing Wang, Zhenyu Yang, Xinyu Wei, Xianglong He, Yangguang Li, Fan Yang, Tingting Gao, Lei Zhang, Guorui Zhou, Han Li

entry.summary: Presents UniRef-Image-Edit, a unified framework for single-image editing and multi-image composition using Sequence-Extended Latent Fusion (SELF) to serialize multiple reference images into a coherent latent sequence.

entry.title: A Generative AI Approach for Reducing Skin Tone Bias in Skin Cancer Classification

author.name: Areez Muhammed Shabu, Mohammad Samar Ansari, Asra Aslam

entry.summary: Addresses skin tone bias in skin cancer classification using generative AI to balance dataset representation across skin tones, targeting the severe imbalance in the ISIC dataset.

entry.title: Neurosim: A Fast Simulator for Neuromorphic Robot Perception

author.name: Richeek Das, Pratik Chaudhari

entry.summary: Neurosim is a high-performance simulator library for neuromorphic robot perception, capable of simulating dynamic vision sensors, RGB cameras, depth sensors, and multi-rotor dynamics at ~2700 FPS. Includes a ZeroMQ-based communication library called Cortex.

entry.title: AgentRob: From Virtual Forum Agents to Hijacked Physical Robots

author.name: Wenrui Liu, Yaxuan Wang, Xun Zhang, Yanshu Wang, Jiashen Wei, Yifan Xiang, Yuhang Wang, Mingshen Ye, Elsie Dai, Zhiqi Liu, Yingjie Xu, Xinyang Chen, Hengzhe Sun, Jiyu Shen, Jingjing He, Tong Yang

entry.summary: AgentRob bridges online community forums, LLM-powered agents, and physical robots through the Model Context Protocol, enabling autonomous agents to read forum posts, extract commands, dispatch robot actions, and report results back to the community.

entry.title: A Latency-Aware Framework for Visuomotor Policy Learning on Industrial Robots

author.name: Daniel Ruan (Princeton University), Salma Mozaffari (Princeton University), Sigrid Adriaenssens (Princeton University), Arash Adel (Princeton University)

entry.summary: Presents a latency-aware framework for deploying visuomotor policies on industrial robots, addressing the large observation-execution gap caused by sensing, inference, and control latency on industrial platforms compared to research robots.

entry.title: A Soft Wrist with Anisotropic and Selectable Stiffness for Robust Robot Learning in Contact-rich Manipulation

author.name: Steven Oh, Tomoya Takahashi, Cristian C. Beltran-Hernandez, Yuki Kuroda, Masashi Hamaya

entry.summary: CLAW is a compliant soft wrist mechanism using orthogonal leaf springs with locking to provide large 6-DOF deformation and selectable anisotropic stiffness for robust contact-rich robot manipulation learning.

entry.title: Measuring Neural Network Complexity via Effective Degrees of Freedom

author.name: Jia Zhou, Douglas Landsittel

entry.summary: Applies generalized degrees of freedom (GDF) to measure complexity of feed-forward neural networks with binary outcomes, comparing with cross-validation-based effective parameters. Shows GDF provides robust complexity assessment.

entry.title: Why Code, Why Now: Learnability, Computability, and the Real Limits of Machine Learning

author.name: Zhimin Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes a five-level hierarchy of learnability based on information structure, arguing that code generation succeeds because it provides dense, local, verifiable feedback. Distinguishes expressibility, computability, and learnability.

entry.title: Skeleton2Stage: Reward-Guided Fine-Tuning for Physically Plausible Dance Generation

author.name: Jidong Jia, Youjian Zhang, Huan Fu, Dacheng Tao

entry.summary: Addresses skeleton-to-mesh gap in dance generation by deriving physics-based rewards from body meshes and applying reinforcement learning fine-tuning to reduce self-penetration and foot-ground contact anomalies.

entry.title: Learning Significant Persistent Homology Features for 3D Shape Understanding

author.name: Prachi Kudeshia, Jiju Poovvancheri

entry.summary: Introduces topologically-enriched versions of ModelNet40 and ShapeNet with persistent homology features, and proposes TopoGAT for learning significant persistent points for 3D shape understanding.

entry.title: SketchingReality: From Freehand Scene Sketches To Photorealistic Images

author.name: Ahmed Bourouis, Mikhail Bessmeltsev, Yulia Gryaditskaya

entry.summary: Proposes SketchingReality for generating photorealistic images from true freehand scene sketches, addressing the gap between edge maps (commonly misnamed 'sketches') and actual human drawings with their inherent abstraction.

entry.title: Variation is the Key: A Variation-Based Framework for LLM-Generated Text Detection

author.name: Xuecong Li, Xiaohong Li, Qiang Hu, Yao Zhang, Junjie Wang

entry.summary: VaryBalance detects LLM-generated text by measuring the difference between original text and its LLM-rewritten version, exploiting the observation that human text changes more when rewritten by LLMs. Uses mean standard deviation as the distinguishing metric.

entry.title: NL2LOGIC: AST-Guided Translation of Natural Language into First-Order Logic with Large Language Models

author.name: Rizky Ramadhana Putra, Raihan Sultan Pasha Basuki, Yutong Cheng, Peng Gao

entry.summary: NL2LOGIC translates natural language into first-order logic using AST-guided constraints for LLMs, enforcing global grammar constraints and improving clause-level semantic understanding for automated reasoning in law and governance.

entry.title: Mirror: A Multi-Agent System for AI-Assisted Ethics Review

author.name: Yifan Ding, Yuhui Shi, Zhiyan Li, Zilong Wang, Yifeng Gao, Yajun Yang, Mengjie Yang, Yixiu Liang, Xipeng Qiu, Xuanjing Huang, Xingjun Ma, Yu-Gang Jiang, Guoyu Wang

entry.summary: Mirror is a multi-agent system for AI-assisted ethics review that generates synthetic review data (EthicSim dataset) to overcome privacy constraints on authentic review materials, using LLMs to support research ethics governance.

entry.title: Differentiable Rule Induction from Raw Sequence Inputs

author.name: Kun Gao, Katsumi Inoue, Yongzhi Cao, Hanpin Wang, Feng Yang

entry.summary: Integrates self-supervised differentiable clustering into inductive logic programming to handle raw sequence inputs without explicit label supervision, bridging the gap between symbolic and sub-symbolic learning.

entry.title: StackingNet: Collective Inference Across Independent AI Foundation Models

author.name: Siyang Li, Chenhao Liu, Dongrui Wu, Zhigang Zeng, Lieyun Ding

entry.summary: StackingNet is a meta-ensemble framework for combining predictions from heterogeneous black-box foundation models during inference, improving accuracy and reducing bias through collective intelligence principles.

entry.title: A Generalizable Physics-guided Causal Model for Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Zhenyu Zong, Yuchen Wang, Haohong Lin, Lu Gan, Huajie Shao

entry.summary: PCM is a physics-guided causal model for trajectory prediction in autonomous driving that incorporates domain-invariant kinematics for zero-shot generalization, using disentangled scene encoding and causal intervention.

entry.title: GRAIL: Goal Recognition Alignment through Imitation Learning

author.name: Osher Elhadad, Felipe Meneguzzi, Reuth Mirsky

entry.summary: Introduces GRAIL, a goal recognition method using imitation learning and inverse RL to learn goal-directed policies from potentially suboptimal demonstrations. Enables one-shot inference by scoring observed trajectories against learned policies.

entry.title: Global AI Bias Audit for Technical Governance

author.name: Jason Hung

entry.summary: Audits Llama-3 8B for geographic and socioeconomic biases in technical AI governance awareness across 213 countries, finding significant digital divide between Global North and South.

entry.title: Agent Mars: Multi-Agent Simulation for Multi-Planetary Life Exploration and Settlement

author.name: Ziyang Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Agent Mars, a 93-agent multi-agent simulation framework for Mars base operations across seven organizational layers, addressing coordination challenges in safety-critical space environments.

entry.title: A Formal Framework for the Explanation of Finite Automata Decisions

author.name: Jaime Cuartas Granada, Alexey Ignatiev, Peter J. Stuckey

entry.summary: Develops a formal framework for explaining decisions of finite automata using abductive and contrastive explanations based on the input word's characters, providing XAI for a fundamental computational model.

entry.title: An Online Reference-Free Evaluation Framework for Flowchart Image-to-Code Generation

author.name: Giang Son Nguyen, Zi Pong Lim, Sarthak Ketanbhai Modi, Yon Shin Teo, Wenya Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a reference-free evaluation framework for flowchart image-to-code generation using OCR-based recall and visual entailment-based precision metrics, enabling quality monitoring at inference time without ground truth.

entry.title: SemanticFeels: Semantic Labeling during In-Hand Manipulation

author.name: Anas Al Shikh Khalil, Haozhi Qi, Roberto Calandra

entry.summary: Presents SemanticFeels, extending NeuralFeels to integrate material classification from tactile readings into neural implicit shape representations during robotic in-hand manipulation.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Debate: A Unified Agentic Framework for Tabular Anomaly Detection

author.name: Pinqiao Wang, Sheng Li

entry.summary: Proposes MAD, a multi-agent debating framework for tabular anomaly detection that treats disagreement between heterogeneous detectors as a signal, coordinated by an LLM-based critic.

entry.title: TruthStance: An Annotated Dataset of Conversations on Truth Social

author.name: Fathima Ameen, Danielle Brown, Manusha Malgareddy, Amanul Haque

entry.summary: Introduces TruthStance, a large-scale dataset from Truth Social with 24K posts, 523K comments, and 1,500 human-annotated instances for argument mining and stance detection on an alt-tech platform.

entry.title: On the Rate-Distortion-Complexity Tradeoff for Semantic Communication

author.name: Jingxuan Chai, Yong Xiao, Guangming Shi

entry.summary: Proposes a rate-distortion-complexity framework for semantic communication that extends classical rate-distortion theory by incorporating computational complexity constraints for deep learning-based encoders and decoders.

entry.title: Breaking Data Efficiency Dilemma: A Federated and Augmented Learning Framework For Alzheimer's Disease Detection via Speech

author.name: Xiao Wei, Bin Wen, Yuqin Lin, Kai Li, Mingyang gu, Xiaobao Wang, Longbiao Wang, Jianwu Dang

entry.summary: Proposes FAL-AD, integrating federated learning with voice conversion-based data augmentation for Alzheimer's disease detection via speech, addressing data scarcity and privacy constraints simultaneously.

entry.title: What hackers talk about when they talk about AI: Early-stage diffusion of a cybercrime innovation

author.name: Beno\^it Dupont, Chad Whelan, Serge-Olivier Paquette

entry.summary: Analyzes cybercrime forum conversations about AI, finding growing curiosity about criminal AI applications alongside doubts and anxieties about effectiveness. Uses 160 forum conversations from a cyber threat intelligence platform.

entry.title: Debiasing Central Fixation Confounds Reveals a Peripheral "Sweet Spot" for Human-like Scanpaths in Hard-Attention Vision

author.name: Pengcheng Pan, Yonekura Shogo, Yasuo Kuniyosh

entry.summary: Shows that center-fixation baselines achieve surprisingly strong scanpath similarity scores on object-centric datasets, confounding evaluation of hard-attention vision models. Identifies a peripheral 'sweet spot' for human-like scanpaths.

entry.title: BLUEPRINT Rebuilding a Legacy: Multimodal Retrieval for Complex Engineering Drawings and Documents

author.name: Ethan Seefried, Ran Eldegaway, Sanjay Das, Nathaniel Blanchard, Tirthankar Ghosal

entry.summary: Presents Blueprint, a layout-aware multimodal retrieval system for large-scale engineering archives that detects drawing regions, applies VLM-based OCR, normalizes identifiers, and fuses retrieval methods. Deployed on ~770K files.

entry.title: Federated Learning of Nonlinear Temporal Dynamics with Graph Attention-based Cross-Client Interpretability

author.name: Ayse Tursucular, Ayush Mohanty, Nazal Mohamed, Nagi Gebraeel

entry.summary: Proposes a federated learning framework for learning nonlinear temporal dynamics across distributed industrial systems using graph attention for cross-client interpretability, without requiring modification of proprietary client models.

entry.title: QuaRK: A Quantum Reservoir Kernel for Time Series Learning

author.name: Abdallah Aaraba, Soumaya Cherkaoui, Ola Ahmad, Shengrui Wang

entry.summary: Introduces QuaRK, coupling a hardware-realistic quantum reservoir with kernel-based readout using classical shadow tomography for time series learning, with theoretical learning guarantees.

entry.title: Cast-R1: Learning Tool-Augmented Sequential Decision Policies for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Xiaoyu Tao, Mingyue Cheng, Chuang Jiang, Tian Gao, Huanjian Zhang, Yaguo Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Cast-R1, a framework that reformulates time series forecasting as sequential decision-making with tool-augmented reasoning and memory-based state management. Uses reinforcement learning for iterative prediction refinement.

entry.title: Steady-State Behavior of Constant-Stepsize Stochastic Approximation: Gaussian Approximation and Tail Bounds

author.name: Zedong Wang, Yuyang Wang, Ijay Narang, Felix Wang, Yuzhou Wang, Siva Theja Maguluri

entry.summary: Provides non-asymptotic error bounds for Gaussian approximation of the steady-state distribution of constant-stepsize stochastic approximation. Bounds Wasserstein distance for fixed step sizes rather than asymptotic limits.

entry.title: A Penalty Approach for Differentiation Through Black-Box Quadratic Programming Solvers

author.name: Yuxuan Linghu, Zhiyuan Liu, Qi Deng

entry.summary: Proposes dXPP, a penalty-based framework for differentiating through quadratic programs that decouples solving from differentiation, enabling use of any black-box QP solver while only needing to solve a smaller linear system for gradients.

entry.title: TS-Haystack: A Multi-Scale Retrieval Benchmark for Time Series Language Models

author.name: Nicolas Zumarraga, Thomas Kaar, Ning Wang, Maxwell A. Xu, Max Rosenblattl, Markus Kreft, Kevin O'Sullivan, Paul Schmiedmayer, Patrick Langer, Robert Jakob

entry.summary: Introduces TS-Haystack, a long-context temporal retrieval benchmark for Time Series Language Models with ten task types across four categories, testing precise temporal localization in million-scale datapoint sequences.

entry.title: Truly Adapting to Adversarial Constraints in Constrained MABs

author.name: Francesco Emanuele Stradi, Kalana Kalupahana, Matteo Castiglioni, Alberto Marchesi, Nicola Gatti

entry.summary: Studies constrained MABs in non-stationary environments with adversarial constraints under full and bandit feedback, providing algorithms that adapt to both stochastic and adversarial constraint patterns.

entry.title: D2-LoRA: A Synergistic Approach to Differential and Directional Low-Rank Adaptation

author.name: Nozomu Fujisawa, Masaaki Kondo

entry.summary: Proposes D2-LoRA combining signed low-rank residual updates with column-wise projection for parameter-efficient fine-tuning, achieving 76.4% average accuracy across 8 benchmarks with only 5K samples per task while maintaining mergeability.

entry.title: Algorithmic Simplification of Neural Networks with Mosaic-of-Motifs

author.name: Pedram Bakhtiarifard, Tong Chen, Jonathan Wensh{\o}j, Erik B Dam, Raghavendra Selvan

entry.summary: Proposes analyzing neural network compressibility through algorithmic complexity, hypothesizing trained models have lower algorithmic complexity than randomly initialized ones. Uses 'Mosaic-of-Motifs' patterns to study structure.

entry.title: Coverage Guarantees for Pseudo-Calibrated Conformal Prediction under Distribution Shift

author.name: Farbod Siahkali, Ashwin Verma, Vijay Gupta

entry.summary: Analyzes pseudo-calibration for conformal prediction under bounded label-conditional covariate shift, deriving coverage lower bounds in terms of classifier loss and Wasserstein shift measure.

entry.title: Stochastic variance reduced extragradient methods for solving hierarchical variational inequalities

author.name: Pavel Dvurechensky, Andrea Ebner, Johannes Carl Schnebel, Shimrit Shtern, Mathias Staudigl

entry.summary: Proves first convergence rates for variance-reduced stochastic algorithms for hierarchical variational inequalities in both Euclidean and Bregman setups, addressing finite-sum structures at both levels.

entry.title: MamaDino: A Hybrid Vision Model for Breast Cancer 3-Year Risk Prediction

author.name: Ruggiero Santeramo, Igor Zubarev, Florian Jug

entry.summary: Introduces MamaDino, a hybrid vision model combining convolutional and transformer-based features with explicit contralateral asymmetry modeling for breast cancer 3-year risk prediction, achieving competitive performance at lower resolution.

entry.title: Floe: Federated Specialization for Real-Time LLM-SLM Inference

author.name: Chunlin Tian, Kahou Tam, Yebo Wu, Shuaihang Zhong, Li Li, Nicholas D. Lane, Chengzhong Xu

entry.summary: Proposes Floe, a hybrid federated framework combining cloud LLMs with edge SLMs for real-time privacy-preserving inference, using heterogeneity-aware LoRA and logit-level fusion.

entry.title: Constrained and Composite Sampling via Proximal Sampler

author.name: Thanh Dang, Jiaming Liang

entry.summary: Studies constrained and composite log-concave sampling using proximal samplers with epigraph transformations, providing implementations using only separation and subgradient oracles.

entry.title: LLMStructBench: Benchmarking Large Language Model Structured Data Extraction

author.name: S\"onke Tenckhoff, Mario Koddenbrock, Erik Rodner

entry.summary: Introduces LLMStructBench for evaluating LLMs on structured data extraction and JSON generation from natural language, testing 22 models across 5 prompting strategies. Shows prompting strategy matters more than model size.

entry.title: RF-GPT: Teaching AI to See the Wireless World

author.name: Hang Zou, Yu Tian, Bohao Wang, Lina Bariah, Samson Lasaulce, Chongwen Huang, M\'erouane Debbah

entry.summary: Introduces RF-GPT, a radio-frequency language model that uses multimodal LLM visual encoders to process RF spectrograms, bridging the gap between RF signal perception and high-level language reasoning.

entry.title: Bridging the Multilingual Safety Divide: Efficient, Culturally-Aware Alignment for Global South Languages

author.name: Somnath Banerjee, Rima Hazra, Animesh Mukherjee

entry.summary: Synthesizes evidence that LLM safety guardrails weaken on low-resource and code-mixed inputs, and proposes a research roadmap for culturally-aware safety alignment for Global South languages.

entry.title: HyperRAG: Reasoning N-ary Facts over Hypergraphs for Retrieval Augmented Generation

author.name: Wen-Sheng Lien, Yu-Kai Chan, Hao-Lung Hsiao, Bo-Kai Ruan, Meng-Fen Chiang, Chien-An Chen, Yi-Ren Yeh, Hong-Han Shuai

entry.summary: Proposes HyperRAG, a RAG framework built on n-ary hypergraphs rather than standard binary knowledge graphs, enabling richer relational expressiveness and shallower, more efficient reasoning paths for multi-hop QA.

entry.title: GradMAP: Faster Layer Pruning with Gradient Metric and Projection Compensation

author.name: Hao Liu, Guangyan Li, Wensheng Zhang, Yongqiang Tang

entry.summary: Proposes GradMAP for efficient LLM layer pruning using gradient magnitude metrics for importance assessment and projection compensation for recovery, achieving both pruning performance and efficiency simultaneously.

entry.title: DriveMamba: Task-Centric Scalable State Space Model for Efficient End-to-End Autonomous Driving

author.name: Haisheng Su, Wei Wu, Feixiang Song, Junjie Zhang, Zhenjie Yang, Junchi Yan

entry.summary: Proposes DriveMamba, an end-to-end autonomous driving framework using State Space Models that replaces the sequential perception-prediction-planning paradigm with flexible relation modeling, addressing information loss and quadratic attention complexity.

entry.title: Nighttime Autonomous Driving Scene Reconstruction with Physically-Based Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Tae-Kyeong Kim, Xingxin Chen, Guile Wu, Chengjie Huang, Dongfeng Bai, Bingbing Liu

entry.summary: Integrates physically-based rendering into 3D Gaussian Splatting for nighttime autonomous driving scene reconstruction, addressing complex lighting conditions that degrade existing methods. This fills a practical gap since most driving simulation work focuses on daytime.

entry.title: EchoTorrent: Towards Swift, Sustained, and Streaming Multi-Modal Video Generation

author.name: Rang Meng, Weipeng Wu, Yingjie Yin, Yuming Li, Chenguang Ma

entry.summary: Proposes EchoTorrent for real-time multi-modal video generation using multi-teacher training, adaptive CFG calibration, and temporal distillation. Addresses latency and multimodal degradation in streaming inference.

entry.title: Inject Where It Matters: Training-Free Spatially-Adaptive Identity Preservation for Text-to-Image Personalization

author.name: Guandong Li, Mengxia Ye

entry.summary: Proposes SpatialID, a training-free framework for personalized text-to-image generation that spatially decouples identity injection into face-relevant and context-free regions using cross-attention masks.

entry.title: HiVid: LLM-Guided Video Saliency For Content-Aware VOD And Live Streaming

author.name: Jiahui Chen, Bo Peng, Lianchen Jia, Zeyu Zhang, Tianchi Huang, Lifeng Sun

entry.summary: Introduces HiVid, using LLMs as human proxies to generate chunk-level importance weights for content-aware video streaming, with solutions for modality extension, rating consistency, and latency constraints.

entry.title: Learnable Multi-level Discrete Wavelet Transforms for 3D Gaussian Splatting Frequency Modulation

author.name: Hung Nguyen, An Le, Truong Nguyen

entry.summary: Introduces multi-level learnable discrete wavelet transforms for frequency modulation in 3D Gaussian Splatting, addressing limitations of single-level DWT approaches and gradient competition during training to reduce memory costs.

entry.title: Ontological grounding for sound and natural robot explanations via large language models

author.name: Alberto Olivares-Alarcos, Muhammad Ahsan, Satrio Sanjaya, Hsien-I Lin, Guillem Aleny\`a

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid framework combining ontology-based reasoning with LLMs to generate logically sound, natural robot explanations. Ontologies ensure consistency while LLMs provide fluent, context-aware language generation.

entry.title: UAV-SEAD: State Estimation Anomaly Dataset for UAVs

author.name: Aykut Kabaoglu, Sanem Sariel

entry.summary: UAV-SEAD provides a large-scale real-world UAV dataset of 1396 real flights for state estimation anomaly detection, unlike existing datasets that rely on simulated/injected faults.

entry.title: It Takes Two to Tango: A Holistic Simulator for Joint Order Scheduling and Multi-Agent Path Finding in Robotic Warehouses

author.name: Haozheng Xu, Wenhao Li, Zifan Wei, Bo Jin, Hongxing Bai, Ben Yang, Xiangfeng Wang

entry.summary: WareRover is a holistic warehouse simulator that tightly couples order scheduling with multi-agent pathfinding, integrating dynamic order streams, physics-aware constraints, and recovery mechanisms for robotic mobile fulfillment systems.

entry.title: Rigidity-Based Multi-Finger Coordination for Precise In-Hand Manipulation of Force-Sensitive Objects

author.name: Xinan Rong, Changhuang Wan, Aochen He, Xiaolong Li, Gangshan Jing

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-layer framework for multi-finger coordination of force-sensitive objects without tactile feedback, using rigidity-based coordinated contact force planning for high-precision manipulation.

entry.title: Replanning Human-Robot Collaborative Tasks with Vision-Language Models via Semantic and Physical Dual-Correction

author.name: Taichi Kato, Takuya Kiyokawa, Namiko Saito, Kensuke Harada

entry.summary: Proposes an HRC framework augmenting VLM-based reasoning with dual correction (semantic and physical) for replanning collaborative tasks, addressing VLM hallucination and physical feasibility failures.

entry.title: Simultaneous State Estimation and Online Model Learning in a Soft Robotic System

author.name: Jan-Hendrik Ewering, Max Bartholdt, Simon F. G. Ehlers, Niklas Wahlstr\"om, Thomas B. Sch\"on, Thomas Seel

entry.summary: Shows how a gray-box system identification tool can simultaneously estimate a soft robot's pose and learn a bending stiffness model online from base reaction measurements and a nominal constant-curvature model.

entry.title: Efficient and Debiased Learning of Average Hazard Under Non-Proportional Hazards

author.name: Xiang Meng, Lu Tian, Kenneth Kehl, Hajime Uno

entry.summary: Develops efficient and debiased estimators for average hazard under non-proportional hazards, providing a framework for flexible high-dimensional nuisance estimation with valid statistical inference when hazard ratios are unstable.

entry.title: Bayesian Cosmic Void Finding with Graph Flows

author.name: Leander Thiele

entry.summary: Presents a Bayesian method to sample probabilistic void catalogs from galaxy surveys using deep graph neural networks with flow-matching, addressing the underconstrained nature of identifying matter underdensities from sparse observations.

entry.title: What’s Your P(WEIRD)?

author.name: RogerDearnaley

entry.summary: Argues that even if alignment is fully solved, there remain under-discussed AI existential risks that could still lead to catastrophic outcomes. The post attempts to name and frame a novel category of risk (called 'P(WEIRD)') that persists independent of whether AI systems do what we intend.

entry.title: PlotChain: Deterministic Checkpointed Evaluation of Multimodal LLMs on Engineering Plot Reading

author.name: Mayank Ravishankara

entry.summary: PlotChain benchmarks multimodal LLMs on reading engineering plots (Bode, FFT, stress-strain, etc.) with exact ground truth from generating processes. Includes checkpoint-based diagnostic evaluation isolating sub-skills.

entry.title: BEAGLE: Behavior-Enforced Agent for Grounded Learner Emulation

author.name: Hanchen David Wang, Clayton Cohn, Zifan Xu, Siyuan Guo, Gautam Biswas, Meiyi Ma

entry.summary: BEAGLE is a neuro-symbolic framework for simulating student learning behaviors that addresses LLMs' competency bias by incorporating Self-Regulated Learning theory, enabling simulation of novice learners' erratic, iterative struggle patterns.

entry.title: NeuroWeaver: An Autonomous Evolutionary Agent for Exploring the Programmatic Space of EEG Analysis Pipelines

author.name: Guoan Wang, Shihao Yang, Jun-En Ding, Hao Zhu, Feng Liu

entry.summary: NeuroWeaver is an autonomous evolutionary agent for EEG analysis that generates scientifically plausible pipelines by incorporating neurophysiological priors, addressing the gap between foundation models and resource-constrained clinical settings.

entry.title: From Pixels to Policies: Reinforcing Spatial Reasoning in Language Models for Content-Aware Layout Design

author.name: Sha Li, Stefano Petrangeli, Yu Shen, Xiang Chen

entry.summary: LaySPA uses reinforcement learning to train LLMs for spatial reasoning in graphic layout design, reformulating it as policy learning over structured textual spatial environments with dual-level outputs (reasoning traces + layout specs).

entry.title: ReusStdFlow: A Standardized Reusability Framework for Dynamic Workflow Construction in Agentic AI

author.name: Gaoyang Zhang, Shanghong Zou, Yafang Wang, He Zhang, Ruohua Xu, Feng Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes ReusStdFlow, a framework for reusable workflow construction in agentic AI using an extraction-storage-construction paradigm with dual knowledge architecture (graph + vector databases). Achieves 90%+ accuracy on real n8n workflows.

entry.title: Adversarial Network Imagination: Causal LLMs and Digital Twins for Proactive Telecom Mitigation

author.name: Vignesh Sriram, Yuqiao Meng, Luoxi Tang, Zhaohan Xi

entry.summary: Proposes Adversarial Network Imagination, integrating causal LLMs with knowledge graphs and digital twins for proactive telecom network failure prediction and mitigation.

entry.title: WildfireVLM: AI-powered Analysis for Early Wildfire Detection and Risk Assessment Using Satellite Imagery

author.name: Aydin Ayanzadeh, Prakhar Dixit, Sadia Kamal, Milton Halem

entry.summary: Introduces WildfireVLM combining satellite imagery wildfire detection (YOLOv12) with language-driven risk assessment using multiple satellite data sources.

entry.title: Synthesizing the Kill Chain: A Zero-Shot Framework for Target Verification and Tactical Reasoning on the Edge

author.name: Jesse Barkley, Abraham George, Amir Barati Farimani

entry.summary: Introduces a hierarchical zero-shot framework for military target verification using lightweight VLMs (4B-12B parameters) on edge hardware, evaluated on synthetic Battlefield 6 videos. Achieves high accuracy on false-positive filtering, damage assessment, and vehicle identification.

entry.title: An Integrated Causal Inference Framework for Traffic Safety Modeling with Semantic Street-View Visual Features

author.name: Lishan Sun, Yujia Cheng, Pengfei Cui, Lei Han, Mohamed Abdel-Aty, Yunhan Zheng, Xingchen Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes an integrated causal inference framework for traffic safety modeling using semantic features extracted from Google Street View imagery. Uses a Doubly Robust estimator to establish causal relationships between visual environmental features and crash risks.

entry.title: Two-Stream Interactive Joint Learning of Scene Parsing and Geometric Vision Tasks

author.name: Guanfeng Tang, Hongbo Zhao, Ziwei Long, Jiayao Li, Bohong Xiao, Wei Ye, Hanli Wang, Rui Fan

entry.summary: Presents TwInS, a bio-inspired two-stream joint learning framework for scene parsing and geometric vision tasks, with cross-task feature fusion via a novel adapter mechanism.

entry.title: LeafNet: A Large-Scale Dataset and Comprehensive Benchmark for Foundational Vision-Language Understanding of Plant Diseases

author.name: Khang Nguyen Quoc, Phuong D. Dao, Luyl-Da Quach

entry.summary: Introduces LeafNet, a comprehensive multimodal dataset of 186K leaf images across 97 disease classes, and LeafBench, a VQA benchmark for evaluating VLMs on plant disease understanding.

entry.title: Beyond Static Snapshots: Dynamic Modeling and Forecasting of Group-Level Value Evolution with Large Language Models

author.name: Qiankun Pi, Guixin Su, Jinliang Li, Mayi Xu, Xin Miao, Jiawei Jiang, Ming Zhong, Tieyun Qian

entry.summary: Uses LLMs to model and forecast dynamic evolution of group-level social values over time, moving beyond static snapshot approaches to capture how values change through long-term social processes.

entry.title: GPT-5 vs Other LLMs in Long Short-Context Performance

author.name: Nima Esmi (Bernoulli Institute, RUG, Groningen, Netherlands, ISRC, Khazar University, Baku, Azerbaijan), Maryam Nezhad-Moghaddam (Department of Computer Engineering, University of Guilan, Rasht, Iran), Fatemeh Borhani (Department of Computer Engineering, University of Guilan, Rasht, Iran), Asadollah Shahbahrami (ISRC, Khazar University, Baku, Azerbaijan, Department of Computer Engineering, University of Guilan, Rasht, Iran), Amin Daemdoost (Department of Computer Engineering, University of Guilan, Rasht, Iran), Georgi Gaydadjiev (QCE Department, TU Delft, Delft, Netherlands)

entry.summary: Evaluates GPT-5, GPT-4, Grok-4, and Gemini 2.5 on long and short context tasks using recipe retrieval, math problems, and 20K social media posts for depression detection.

entry.title: AD-Bench: A Real-World, Trajectory-Aware Advertising Analytics Benchmark for LLM Agents

author.name: Lingxiang Hu, Yiding Sun, Tianle Xia, Wenwei Li, Ming Xu, Liqun Liu, Peng Shu, Huan Yu, Jie Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces AD-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on real-world advertising and marketing analytics tasks requiring multi-round interaction with professional marketing tools.

entry.title: Key Considerations for Domain Expert Involvement in LLM Design and Evaluation: An Ethnographic Study

author.name: Annalisa Szymanski, Oghenemaro Anuyah, Toby Jia-Jun Li, Ronald A. Metoyer

entry.summary: 12-week ethnographic study of a team building a pedagogical chatbot, revealing practices around data collection workarounds, expert input augmentation, co-developed evaluation criteria, and hybrid evaluation strategies.

entry.title: CoCoDiff: Correspondence-Consistent Diffusion Model for Fine-grained Style Transfer

author.name: Wenbo Nie, Zixiang Li, Renshuai Tao, Bin Wu, Yunchao Wei, Yao Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes CoCoDiff, a training-free style transfer framework using pretrained diffusion models that achieves pixel-wise semantic correspondence between content and style images, going beyond global-level style transfer.

entry.title: Qute: Towards Quantum-Native Database

author.name: Muzhi Chen, Xuanhe Zhou, Wei Zhou, Bangrui Xu, Surui Tang, Guoliang Li, Bingsheng He, Yeye He, Yitong Song, Fan Wu

entry.summary: Envisions Qute, a quantum-native database that compiles SQL into quantum circuits, uses hybrid quantum-classical optimization, and introduces selective quantum indexing. Demonstrates on a real quantum processor.

entry.title: The Speed-up Factor: A Quantitative Multi-Iteration Active Learning Performance Metric

author.name: Hannes Kath, Thiago S. Gouv\^ea, Daniel Sonntag

entry.summary: Formally introduces the speed-up factor as a quantitative multi-iteration performance metric for active learning, indicating what fraction of samples is needed to match random sampling performance.

entry.title: Accelerated Discovery of Cryoprotectant Cocktails via Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization

author.name: Daniel Emerson, Nora Gaby-Biegel, Purva Joshi, Yoed Rabin, Rebecca D. Sandlin, Levent Burak Kara

entry.summary: Combines multi-objective Bayesian optimization with high-throughput screening for accelerating cryoprotectant cocktail design, balancing ice suppression and cell viability.

entry.title: Discrete Double-Bracket Flows for Isotropic-Noise Invariant Eigendecomposition

author.name: ZhiMing Li, JiaHe Feng

entry.summary: Introduces a discrete double-bracket flow for matrix-free eigendecomposition that is invariant to isotropic noise shifts. The method's stability depends only on the trace-free covariance, making it robust to varying noise levels.

entry.title: AnomaMind: Agentic Time Series Anomaly Detection with Tool-Augmented Reasoning

author.name: Xiaoyu Tao, Yuchong Wu, Mingyue Cheng, Ze Guo, Tian Gao

entry.summary: Proposes AnomaMind, an agentic framework for time series anomaly detection that uses tool-augmented reasoning for adaptive feature preparation, reasoning-aware detection, and iterative refinement during inference.

entry.title: KoopGen: Koopman Generator Networks for Representing and Predicting Dynamical Systems with Continuous Spectra

author.name: Liangyu Su, Jun Shu, Rui Liu, Deyu Meng, Zongben Xu

entry.summary: Introduces KoopGen, a generator-based neural Koopman framework for modeling dynamical systems with continuous spectra. Uses structured, state-dependent representation instead of restrictive finite-dimensional assumptions.

entry.title: Replicable Constrained Bandits

author.name: Matteo Bollini, Gianmarco Genalti, Francesco Emanuele Stradi, Matteo Castiglioni, Alberto Marchesi

entry.summary: Initiates the study of algorithmic replicability in constrained multi-armed bandits, designing algorithms whose regret and violation match non-replicable counterparts in terms of T dependence.

entry.title: Learning Gradient Flow: Using Equation Discovery to Accelerate Engineering Optimization

author.name: Grant Norman, Conor Rowan, Kurt Maute, Alireza Doostan

entry.summary: Proposes Learned Gradient Flow (LGF), which uses equation discovery to learn the continuous-time dynamics of optimization algorithms (gradient descent, Newton's method, ADAM) from trajectory data, then solves the learned ODE as a surrogate.

entry.title: Locally Private Parametric Methods for Change-Point Detection

author.name: Anuj Kumar Yadav, Cemre Cadir, Yanina Shkel, Michael Gastpar

entry.summary: Studies parametric change-point detection under local differential privacy, proposing two private algorithms with theoretical accuracy bounds. Characterizes the statistical cost of local differential privacy for this problem.

entry.title: Federated Ensemble Learning with Progressive Model Personalization

author.name: Ala Emrani, Amir Najafi, Abolfazl Motahari

entry.summary: Proposes a boosting-inspired federated ensemble learning framework that progressively adds and personalizes ensemble members, navigating the tradeoff between shared features and personalized heads.

entry.title: LRD-MPC: Efficient MPC Inference through Low-rank Decomposition

author.name: Tingting Tang, Yongqin Wang, Murali Annavaram

entry.summary: Proposes LRD-MPC, using low-rank decomposition to reduce the cost of matrix multiplications in secure multi-party computation for ML inference, achieving significant speedups.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Vision-Language Segmentation for Medical Imaging

author.name: Aryan Das, Tanishq Rachamalla, Koushik Biswas, Swalpa Kumar Roy, Vinay Kumar Verma

entry.summary: Introduces an uncertainty-aware multimodal segmentation framework for medical imaging with a Modality Decoding Attention Block, State Space Mixer, and novel Spectral-Entropic Uncertainty loss combining spatial overlap, spectral consistency, and uncertainty.

entry.title: From Classical to Quantum: Extending Prometheus for Unsupervised Discovery of Phase Transitions in Three Dimensions and Quantum Systems

author.name: Brandon Yee, Wilson Collins, Maximilian Rutkowski

entry.summary: Extends the Prometheus unsupervised phase transition discovery framework to 3D classical and quantum systems, detecting critical temperatures within 0.01% of literature values and correctly identifying universality classes.

entry.title: Faster Molecular Dynamics with Neural Network Potentials via Distilled Multiple Time-Stepping and Non-Conservative Forces

author.name: Nicola\"i Gouraud, C\^ome Cattin, Thomas Pl\'e, Olivier Adjoua, Louis Lagard\`ere, Jean-Philip Piquemal

entry.summary: Proposes DMTS-NC, a distilled multi-time-step strategy using non-conservative forces to accelerate molecular dynamics simulations with neural network potentials. The method couples accurate conservative potentials with simplified distilled representations to achieve significant speedups while preserving physical priors like equivariance.

entry.title: Is Information Density Uniform when Utterances are Grounded on Perception and Discourse?

author.name: Matteo Gay, Coleman Haley, Mario Giulianelli, Edoardo Ponti

entry.summary: Presents the first computational study of Uniform Information Density in visually grounded settings, finding that perceptual grounding consistently smooths information distribution across 30 languages in image-caption and visual storytelling data.

entry.title: GLIMPSE : Real-Time Text Recognition and Contextual Understanding for VQA in Wearables

author.name: Akhil Ramachandran, Ankit Arun, Ashish Shenoy, Abhay Harpale, Srihari Jayakumar, Debojeet Chatterjee, Mohsen Moslehpour, Pierce Chuang, Yichao Lu, Vikas Bhardwaj, Peyman Heidari

entry.summary: Proposes GLIMPSE for real-time text recognition on wearable devices that exploits asymmetric resolution requirements between OCR (needs high detail) and scene understanding (tolerates coarse features) to optimize battery and thermal performance.

entry.title: Diff-Aid: Inference-time Adaptive Interaction Denoising for Rectified Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Binglei Li, Mengping Yang, Zhiyu Tan, Junping Zhang, Hao Li

entry.summary: Proposes Diff-Aid, a lightweight inference-time method for text-to-image diffusion models that adaptively adjusts per-token text-image interactions across transformer blocks and denoising timesteps. Improves generation quality without retraining.

entry.title: Offline-Poly: A Polyhedral Framework For Offline 3D Multi-Object Tracking

author.name: Xiaoyu Li, Yitao Wu, Xian Wu, Haolin Zhuo, Lijun Zhao, Lining Sun

entry.summary: Proposes Offline-Poly, a general offline 3D multi-object tracking method using a tracking-centric Tracking-by-Tracking paradigm that works on arbitrary tracking outputs, improving 4D auto-labeling.

entry.title: Event-based Visual Deformation Measurement

author.name: Yuliang Wu, Wei Zhai, Yuxin Cui, Tiesong Zhao, Yang Cao, Zheng-Jun Zha

entry.summary: Proposes an event-frame fusion framework for visual deformation measurement using an Affine Invariant Simplicial approach, exploiting events for temporally dense motion cues and frames for spatial precision.

entry.title: Cross-view Domain Generalization via Geometric Consistency for LiDAR Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Jindong Zhao, Yuan Gao, Yang Xia, Sheng Nie, Jun Yue, Weiwei Sun, Shaobo Xia

entry.summary: Proposes CVGC for cross-view domain generalization in LiDAR semantic segmentation, addressing viewpoint-dependent structural incompleteness through geometric consistency constraints.

entry.title: Frequency-Enhanced Hilbert Scanning Mamba for Short-Term Arctic Sea Ice Concentration Prediction

author.name: Feng Gao, Zheng Gong, Wenli Liu, Yanhai Gan, Zhuoran Zheng, Junyu Dong, Qian Du

entry.summary: Proposes FH-Mamba, a frequency-enhanced Mamba model with 3D Hilbert scanning for Arctic sea ice concentration prediction. Uses wavelet transforms for high-frequency details and a Hybrid Shuffle Attention module for spatiotemporal modeling.

entry.title: DORA: Dataflow Oriented Robotic Architecture

author.name: Xiaodong Zhang, Baorui Lv, Xavier Tao, Xiong Wang, Jie Bao, Yong He, Yue Chen, Zijiang Yang

entry.summary: DORA is a robotic middleware architecture that eliminates serialization overhead for large data through zero-copy shared memory, designed for heterogeneous data sizes in Python-based and intra-robot communication environments.

entry.title: SPLIT: Sparse Incremental Learning of Error Dynamics for Control-Oriented Modeling in Autonomous Vehicles

author.name: Yaoyu Li, Chaosheng Huang, Jun Li

entry.summary: SPLIT is a sparse incremental learning framework for vehicle dynamics modeling that decomposes the model into invariant and variant components, addressing the curse of dimensionality and computational costs of Gaussian Process residual models for real-time control.

entry.title: Muscle Coactivation in the Sky: Geometry and Pareto Optimality of Energy vs. Promptness in Multirotors

author.name: Antonio Franchi

entry.summary: Introduces the concept of 'promptness' for aerial multirotors as a metric for dynamic readiness, and formulates the energy-promptness tradeoff as a multi-objective optimization on geometric fiber bundles using the propulsion model.

entry.title: Autonomous Robotic Tissue Palpation and Abnormalities Characterisation via Ergodic Exploration

author.name: Luca Beber, Edoardo Lamon, Matteo Saveriano, Daniele Fontanelli, Luigi Palopoli

entry.summary: Proposes an autonomous robotic palpation framework combining viscoelastic tissue modeling with ergodic exploration, using an EKF for online parameter estimation and Gaussian Process Regression for spatial elasticity mapping.

entry.title: Real-time Monocular 2D and 3D Perception of Endoluminal Scenes for Controlling Flexible Robotic Endoscopic Instruments

author.name: Ruofeng Wei, Kai Chen, Yui Lun Ng, Yiyao Ma, Justin Di-Lang Ho, Hon Sing Tong, Xiaomei Wang, Jing Dai, Ka-Wai Kwok, Qi Dou

entry.summary: Presents a visual perception platform for continuum robotic endoscopic surgery, using monocular image-based algorithms to identify instrument position/orientation and measure distances from tissues, with a physically-realistic simulator.

entry.title: Accelerating Posterior Inference from Pulsar Light Curves via Learned Latent Representations and Local Simulator-Guided Optimization

author.name: Farhana Taiyebah, Abu Bucker Siddik, Indronil Bhattacharjee, Diane Oyen, Soumi De, Greg Olmschenk, Constantinos Kalapotharakos

entry.summary: Introduces a framework accelerating pulsar posterior inference by combining learned latent representations from a masked U-Net with local simulator-guided optimization, identifying similar simulated light curves in embedding space.

entry.title: building sqlite with a small swarm

author.name: kiankyars

entry.summary: Appears to describe an experiment using a swarm of AI agents to collaboratively build SQLite, a well-known database engine. Content is empty/truncated but the title suggests a multi-agent software engineering experiment.

entry.title: MAPLE: A Sub-Agent Architecture for Memory, Learning, and Personalization in Agentic AI Systems

author.name: Deepak Babu Piskala

entry.summary: MAPLE decomposes LLM agent personalization into three distinct sub-systems: memory (storage/retrieval), learning (intelligence extraction), and personalization (applying learned knowledge), arguing these operate on different timescales.

entry.title: Contrastive explanations of BDI agents

author.name: Michael Winikoff

entry.summary: Extends Belief-Desire-Intention agent explanations to support contrastive questions ('why X instead of Y?'). Shows contrastive answers are significantly shorter and evaluates their effect on trust development through human studies.

entry.title: A First Proof Sprint

author.name: Joseph Corneli

entry.summary: Reports a multi-agent proof sprint on ten research-level math problems, using wiring-diagram decompositions for claim dependencies and adversarial verification. Shows heterogeneous outcomes with explicit mathematical vs validation status.

entry.title: Enabling Option Learning in Sparse Rewards with Hindsight Experience Replay

author.name: Gabriel Romio, Mateus Begnini Melchiades, Bruno Castro da Silva, Gabriel de Oliveira Ramos

entry.summary: Proposes MOC-HER integrating Hindsight Experience Replay into Multi-updates Option Critic for hierarchical RL in sparse reward environments, with extensions for object manipulation tasks.

entry.title: VSAL: A Vision Solver with Adaptive Layouts for Graph Property Detection

author.name: Jiahao Xie, Guangmo Tong

entry.summary: VSAL uses adaptive graph layout generation to create informative visualizations tailored to individual graph instances for property detection, overcoming the limitation of fixed layouts in existing vision-based graph methods.

entry.title: FloCA: Towards Faithful and Logically Consistent Flowchart Reasoning

author.name: Jinzi Zou, Bolin Wang, Liang Li, Shuo Zhang, Nuo Xu, Junzhou Zhao

entry.summary: FloCA enables faithful flowchart-oriented dialogue by explicitly representing and reasoning over flowchart topology, addressing LLM hallucination and topology-unawareness in zero-shot settings.

entry.title: EmbeWebAgent: Embedding Web Agents into Any Customized UI

author.name: Chenyang Ma, Clyde Fare, Matthew Wilson, Dave Braines

entry.summary: Introduces EmbeWebAgent, a framework for embedding AI agents directly into existing UIs using lightweight frontend hooks and WebSocket-based backends, targeting enterprise settings with explicit frontend/backend control.

entry.title: Future of Edge AI in biodiversity monitoring

author.name: Aude Vuilliomenet, Kate E. Jones, Duncan Wilson

entry.summary: Reviews 82 studies implementing edge AI for biodiversity monitoring across acoustic, vision, tracking, and multi-modal systems, identifying key architectural trade-offs and implementation challenges.

entry.title: Discrete-Space Generative AI Pipeline for Semantic Transmission of Signals

author.name: Silvija Kokalj-Filipovic, Yagna Kaasaragadda

entry.summary: Introduces Discernment, a semantic communication system using GenAI models in discrete spaces that dynamically adapts between autoregressive and diffusion-based algorithms based on channel erasure patterns.

entry.title: Chemical Language Models for Natural Products: A State-Space Model Approach

author.name: Ho-Hsuan Wang, Afnan Sultan, Andrea Volkamer, Dietrich Klakow

entry.summary: Develops NP-specific chemical language models using state-space models (Mamba/Mamba-2) for natural product chemistry, comparing against transformer baselines with 8 tokenization strategies on ~1M natural products.

entry.title: AbracADDbra: Touch-Guided Object Addition by Decoupling Placement and Editing Subtasks

author.name: Kunal Swami, Raghu Chittersu, Yuvraj Rathore, Rajeev Irny, Shashavali Doodekula, Alok Shukla

entry.summary: Introduces AbracADDbra for touch-guided object addition in images, using a decoupled architecture with vision-language transformer for placement and diffusion model for generation, plus Touch2Add benchmark.

entry.title: Machine Learning as a Tool (MLAT): A Framework for Integrating Statistical ML Models as Callable Tools within LLM Agent Workflows

author.name: Edwin Chen, Zulekha Bibi

entry.summary: Introduces MLAT pattern where pre-trained ML models are exposed as callable tools within LLM agent workflows, validated through PitchCraft system for converting sales calls into proposals.

entry.title: pFedNavi: Structure-Aware Personalized Federated Vision-Language Navigation for Embodied AI

author.name: Qingqian Yang, Hao Wang, Sai Qian Zhang, Jian Li, Yang Hua, Miao Pan, Tao Song, Zhengwei Qi, Haibing Guan

entry.summary: Proposes pFedNavi, a structure-aware personalized federated learning framework for Vision-Language Navigation that adaptively identifies client-specific layers for fine-grained parameter fusion.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Comedy Club: Investigating Community Discussion Effects on LLM Humor Generation

author.name: Shiwei Hong, Lingyao Li, Ethan Z. Rong, Chenxinran Shen, Zhicong Lu

entry.summary: Tests whether community discussion improves LLM comedy writing using a multi-agent sandbox with critic and audience feedback stored as social memory. Discussion condition wins 75.6% of comparisons judged by expert annotators.

entry.title: VIPA: Visual Informative Part Attention for Referring Image Segmentation

author.name: Yubin Cho, Hyunwoo Yu, Kyeongbo Kong, Kyomin Sohn, Bongjoon Hyun, Suk-Ju Kang

entry.summary: Proposes VIPA for referring image segmentation, using visual informative parts (visual expressions) to provide structural and semantic target information, reducing cross-modal projection variance.

entry.title: Interpretable clustering via optimal multiway-split decision trees

author.name: Hayato Suzuki, Shunnosuke Ikeda, Yuichi Takano

entry.summary: Proposes interpretable clustering using optimal multiway-split decision trees formulated as 0-1 integer linear optimization, producing shallower trees that are easier to interpret than binary alternatives.

entry.title: Optimization-Free Graph Embedding via Distributional Kernel for Community Detection

author.name: Shuaibin Song, Kai Ming Ting, Kaifeng Zhang, Tianrun Liang

entry.summary: Proposes an optimization-free graph embedding using distributional kernels that captures node degree distributions, addressing over-smoothing in neighborhood aggregation methods.

entry.title: Advancing Analytic Class-Incremental Learning through Vision-Language Calibration

author.name: Binyu Zhao, Wei Zhang, Xingrui Yu, Zhaonian Zou, Ivor Tsang

entry.summary: Proposes VILA, a dual-branch framework for class-incremental learning with pre-trained models that uses vision-language calibration to address representation rigidity. Systematically diagnoses failure modes of analytic CIL approaches.

entry.title: Conformal Signal Temporal Logic for Robust Reinforcement Learning Control: A Case Study

author.name: Hani Beirami, M M Manjurul Islam

entry.summary: Introduces conformal STL shields for RL control in aerospace, combining Signal Temporal Logic specifications with online conformal prediction to filter unsafe actions from a PPO agent in F-16 simulation.

entry.title: Learning Structural Hardness for Combinatorial Auctions: Instance-Dependent Algorithm Selection via Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Sungwoo Kang

entry.summary: Trains a lightweight MLP to predict when combinatorial auction instances are hard for greedy heuristics, enabling instance-dependent algorithm selection rather than trying to replace solvers with ML.

entry.title: Extending Multi-Source Bayesian Optimization With Causality Principles

author.name: Luuk Jacobs, Mohammad Ali Javidian

entry.summary: Extends multi-source Bayesian optimization with causal principles, enabling the framework to leverage causal graphs and interventional knowledge across multiple information sources.

entry.title: Expected Moral Shortfall for Ethical Competence in Decision-making Models

author.name: Aisha Aijaz, Raghava Mutharaju, Manohar Kumar

entry.summary: Introduces Expected Moral Shortfall (EMS), a mathematical framework for quantifying ethical competence in AI decision-making models, analogous to financial risk metrics. Compares techniques for instilling ethical competence across multiple performance metrics.

entry.title: NeuroMambaLLM: Dynamic Graph Learning of fMRI Functional Connectivity in Autistic Brains Using Mamba and Language Model Reasoning

author.name: Yasaman Torabi, Parsa Razmara, Hamed Ajorlou, Bardia Baraeinejad

entry.summary: Proposes NeuroMambaLLM, combining dynamic latent graph learning with Mamba state-space models and LLM reasoning for fMRI-based autism classification. Integrates brain connectivity analysis with language model reasoning.

entry.title: Evolving Multi-Channel Confidence-Aware Activation Functions for Missing Data with Channel Propagation

author.name: Naeem Shahabi Sani, Ferial Najiantabriz, Shayan Shafaei, Dean F. Hougen

entry.summary: Proposes Three-Channel Evolved Activations (3C-EA) using genetic programming to create activation functions that take feature values, missingness indicators, and confidence scores, with a channel propagation mechanism for deeper layers.

entry.title: Exploring the limits of pre-trained embeddings in machine-guided protein design: a case study on predicting AAV vector viability

author.name: Ana F. Rodrigues, Lucas Ferraz, Laura Balbi, Pedro Giesteira Cotovio, Catia Pesquita

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates pre-trained protein sequence embeddings for predicting AAV vector viability, finding that sequence-level representations struggle with sparse mutation patterns typical of bioengineering.

entry.title: NutVLM: A Self-Adaptive Defense Framework against Full-Dimension Attacks for Vision Language Models in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Xiaoxu Peng, Dong Zhou, Jianwen Zhang, Guanghui Sun, Anh Tu Ngo, Anupam Chattopadhyay

entry.summary: Proposes NutVLM, a self-adaptive defense framework for vision-language models in autonomous driving that handles both local patches and global perturbations through a unified detection-purification mechanism.

entry.title: MotionWeaver: Holistic 4D-Anchored Framework for Multi-Humanoid Image Animation

author.name: Xirui Hu, Yanbo Ding, Jiahao Wang, Tingting Shi, Yali Wang, Guo Zhi Zhi, Weizhan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MotionWeaver for multi-humanoid image animation using unified motion representations with 4D-anchored spatial reasoning, addressing the challenges of diverse humanoid forms, complex interactions, and occlusions.

entry.title: Explore Intrinsic Geometry for Query-based Tiny and Oriented Object Detector with Momentum-based Bipartite Matching

author.name: Junpeng Zhang, Zewei Yang, Jie Feng, Yuhui Zheng, Ronghua Shang, Mengxuan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes IGOFormer for query-based oriented object detection that integrates intrinsic geometry into feature decoding and uses momentum-based bipartite matching for inter-stage consistency. Targets tiny and oriented objects.

entry.title: ARport: An Augmented Reality System for Markerless Image-Guided Port Placement in Robotic Surgery

author.name: Zheng Han, Zixin Yang, Yonghao Long, Lin Zhang, Peter Kazanzides, Qi Dou

entry.summary: Presents ARport, a markerless augmented reality system for surgical port placement that maps pre-planned trocar layouts onto the patient using only an optical see-through HMD without external sensors.

entry.title: Differential pose optimization in descriptor space -- Combining Geometric and Photometric Methods for Motion Estimation

author.name: Andreas L. Teigen, Annette Stahl, Rudolf Mester

entry.summary: Proposes combining geometric and photometric methods for two-frame relative pose optimization using dense descriptor residuals instead of photometric error, enabling sub-pixel accuracy with geometric features.

entry.title: Hierarchical Vision-Language Interaction for Facial Action Unit Detection

author.name: Yong Li, Yi Ren, Yizhe Zhang, Wenhua Zhang, Tianyi Zhang, Muyun Jiang, Guo-Sen Xie, Cuntai Guan

entry.summary: Proposes HiVA for facial action unit detection using hierarchical vision-language interaction with LLM-generated AU descriptions as semantic priors to guide detection under limited data.

entry.title: Efficient Text-Guided Convolutional Adapter for the Diffusion Model

author.name: Aryan Das, Koushik Biswas, Swalpa Kumar Roy, Badri Narayana Patro, Vinay Kumar Verma

entry.summary: Introduces Nexus Adapters, text-guided efficient adapters for diffusion-based structure-preserving conditional generation that are prompt-aware and much more parameter-efficient than existing approaches.

entry.title: Error Patterns in Historical OCR: A Comparative Analysis of TrOCR and a Vision-Language Model

author.name: Ari Vesalainen, Eetu M\"akel\"a, Laura Ruotsalainen, Mikko Tolonen

entry.summary: Compares TrOCR and a vision-language model (Qwen) for historical OCR, finding VLMs achieve lower error rates but exhibit linguistic regularization that can alter original spellings.

entry.title: Discrete Gene Crossover Accelerates Solution Discovery in Quality-Diversity Algorithms

author.name: Joshua Hutchinson, J. Michael Herrmann, Sim\'on C. Smith

entry.summary: Proposes a mutation operator for Quality-Diversity algorithms that augments variation-based operators with discrete gene-level crossover, inspired by biological meiosis. This enables rapid recombination of elite genetic material across large populations.

entry.title: High-Fidelity, Customizable Force Sensing for the Wearable Human-Robot Interface

author.name: Noah Rubin, Ava Schraeder, Hrishikesh Sahu, Thomas C. Bulea, Lillian Chin

entry.summary: Presents a 3D-printed silicone force-sensing pad with embedded air channels for measuring forces at the human-robot wearable interface, achieving R²=0.998 linearity between pad pressure and applied force.

entry.title: ONRAP: Occupancy-driven Noise-Resilient Autonomous Path Planning

author.name: Faizan M. Tariq, Avinash Singh, Vipul Ramtekkar, Jovin D'sa, David Isele, Yosuke Sakamoto, Sangjae Bae

entry.summary: ONRAP is a path planner operating on occupancy grids with optional occupancy-flow predictions, using a nonlinear program based on a modified bicycle model. Runs in real-time (>10 Hz) and handles unknown obstacle classes.

entry.title: XIT: Exploration and Exploitation Informed Trees for Active Gas Distribution Mapping in Unknown Environments

author.name: Mal Fazliu, Matthew Coombes, Sen Wang, Cunjia Liu

entry.summary: XIT (Exploration-Exploitation Informed Trees) is a sampling-based planner for autonomous gas distribution mapping that balances exploring unknown space with exploiting gas distribution beliefs, formulated as a next-best-trajectory informative path planning problem.

entry.title: Modeling and Optimizing the Provisioning of Exhaustible Capabilities for Simultaneous Task Allocation and Scheduling

author.name: Jinwoo Park, Harish Ravichandar, Seth Hutchinson

entry.summary: TRAITS is a multi-robot task allocation framework handling exhaustible traits (depleting capabilities) under battery and temporal constraints, using nonlinear programming for trait distribution optimization across heterogeneous robot teams.

entry.title: RoboSolver: A Multi-Agent Large Language Model Framework for Solving Robotic Arm Problems

author.name: Hamid Khabazi, Ali F. Meghdari, Alireza Taheri

entry.summary: RoboSolver is a multi-agent LLM/VLM framework for automatically solving robotic arm problems - performing kinematics, computing velocities, generating 3D simulations, and executing motion control from text/visual inputs.

entry.title: ROSA: Roundabout Optimized Speed Advisory with Multi-Agent Trajectory Prediction in Multimodal Traffic

author.name: Anna-Lena Schlamp, Jeremias Gerner, Klaus Bogenberger, Werner Huber, Stefanie Schmidtner

entry.summary: ROSA combines multi-agent trajectory prediction (Transformer-based) with coordinated speed guidance for mixed traffic at roundabouts, achieving 1.29m ADE at 5-second horizon, with improvements when route intention is available.

entry.title: Mixture-of-experts Wishart model for covariance matrices with an application to Cancer drug screening

author.name: The Tien Mai, Zhi Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces a mixture-of-experts Wishart model where Wishart mixture weights depend on predictors through multinomial logistic gating, enabling modeling of heterogeneous covariance structures with covariate-dependent cluster membership.

entry.title: MacNet: An End-to-End Manifold-Constrained Adaptive Clustering Network for Interpretable Whole Slide Image Classification

author.name: Mingrui Ma, Chentao Li, Pan Huang, Jing Qin

entry.summary: Proposes MacNet, an end-to-end MIL framework for WSI classification using Grassmann re-embedding and manifold adaptive clustering for interpretable pathological diagnosis.

entry.title: Freq-DP Net: A Dual-Branch Network for Fence Removal using Dual-Pixel and Fourier Priors

author.name: Kunal Swami, Sudha Velusamy, Chandra Sekhar Seelamantula

entry.summary: Proposes Freq-DP Net, the first framework to leverage dual-pixel sensors for fence removal, combining defocus disparity and structural priors via Fast Fourier Convolution.

entry.title: OmniVTON++: Training-Free Universal Virtual Try-On with Principal Pose Guidance

author.name: Zhaotong Yang, Yong Du, Shengfeng He, Yuhui Li, Xinzhe Li, Yangyang Xu, Junyu Dong, Jian Yang

entry.summary: Presents OmniVTON++, a training-free virtual try-on framework with Principal Pose Guidance for universal applicability across different garment types and body poses.

entry.title: MeFEm: Medical Face Embedding model

author.name: Yury Borets, Stepan Botman

entry.summary: Presents MeFEm, a face embedding model based on modified JEPA with axial stripe masking and probabilistic CLS token reassignment, targeting biometric and medical analysis from facial images.

entry.title: Agentic AI for Commercial Insurance Underwriting with Adversarial Self-Critique

author.name: Joyjit Roy, Samaresh Kumar Singh

entry.summary: Presents an agentic AI system for commercial insurance underwriting that uses adversarial self-critique as a safety mechanism, with a critic agent challenging the primary agent's decisions. The human-in-the-loop design is practically relevant for regulated industries.

entry.title: Intelligence as Trajectory-Dominant Pareto Optimization

author.name: Truong Xuan Khanh, Truong Quynh Hoa

entry.summary: Formulates intelligence as trajectory-level multi-objective optimization, introducing 'Pareto traps' - locally non-dominated trajectory regions that restrict access to globally superior paths. Offers a theoretical framework for understanding stagnation in long-horizon AI.

entry.title: Situation Graph Prediction: Structured Perspective Inference for User Modeling

author.name: Jisung Shin, Daniel Platnick, Marjan Alirezaie, Hossein Rahnama

entry.summary: Proposes Situation Graph Prediction (SGP) for modeling user perspectives as structured, ontology-aligned representations, using synthetic data generation and retrieval-augmented in-context learning. Addresses privacy issues in perspective modeling.

entry.title: Detecting Jailbreak Attempts in Clinical Training LLMs Through Automated Linguistic Feature Extraction

author.name: Tri Nguyen, Huy Hoang Bao Le, Lohith Srikanth Pentapalli, Laurah Turner, Kelly Cohen

entry.summary: Detects jailbreak attempts in clinical training LLMs by training BERT-based models to automatically predict linguistic features (professionalism, medical relevance, ethical behavior, contextual distraction) that were previously manually annotated.

entry.title: An end-to-end agentic pipeline for smart contract translation and quality evaluation

author.name: Abhinav Goel, Chaitya Shah, Agostino Capponi, Alfio Gliozzo

entry.summary: End-to-end pipeline for translating natural language contractual specifications into Solidity smart contracts, with automated quality assessment across five dimensions including functional completeness and business-logic fidelity.

entry.title: Experimentation Accelerator: Interpretable Insights and Creative Recommendations for A/B Testing with Content-Aware ranking

author.name: Zhengmian Hu, Lei Shi, Ritwik Sinha, Justin Grover, David Arbour

entry.summary: Framework for A/B testing that prioritizes which variants to test, explains why winners win, and suggests new higher-potential variants by leveraging treatment embeddings and historical outcomes with content-aware ranking.

entry.title: GREAT-EER: Graph Edge Attention Network for Emergency Evacuation Responses

author.name: Attila Lischka, Bal\'azs Kulcs\'ar

entry.summary: Proposes GREAT-EER, a deep RL-based graph edge attention network for bus evacuation routing optimization (BEOP), addressing NP-hard combinatorial optimization for emergency evacuations.

entry.title: Removing Planner Bias in Goal Recognition Through Multi-Plan Dataset Generation

author.name: Mustafa F. Abdelwahed, Felipe Meneguzzi Kin Max Piamolini Gusmao, Joan Espasa

entry.summary: Addresses planner bias in goal recognition datasets by using top-k planning to generate multiple plans per goal hypothesis, creating more challenging and realistic benchmarks.

entry.title: Lifted Relational Probabilistic Inference via Implicit Learning

author.name: Luise Ge, Brendan Juba, Kris Nilsson, Alison Shao

entry.summary: Studies answering queries in first-order relational probabilistic logic through implicit learning without constructing explicit models, merging incomplete first-order axioms with independently sampled data.

entry.title: Judging the Judges: Human Validation of Multi-LLM Evaluation for High-Quality K--12 Science Instructional Materials

author.name: Peng He, Zhaohui Li, Zeyuan Wang, Jinjun Xiong, Tingting Li

entry.summary: Examines how human experts evaluate AI-generated assessments of K-12 science instructional materials, using GPT-4o, Claude, and Gemini to evaluate curriculum units against the EQuIP rubric.

entry.title: Explanatory Interactive Machine Learning for Bias Mitigation in Visual Gender Classification
