entry.title: Research Summary: February 16, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research centers on foundational challenges in LLM evaluation, efficient training, and reasoning robustness. Soft Contamination reveals that semantic duplicates evade standard n-gram decontamination, undermining benchmark validity across the field—potentially the most consequential finding of the day.

  • Native Low-Rank Pretraining shows LLMs can be trained from scratch with exclusively factorized weights by controlling spectral norm growth, offering significant compute savings
  • ARTS identifies a 'Normalization Squeeze' pathology in RLVR that systematically suppresses valid but rare reasoning paths, proposing amortized tree search as a fix
  • Continuous diffusion language models can be steered to obey formal syntax constraints (regex, CFGs) via training-free guidance
  • A Frankenstein-style dissection of RL in vision-language models reveals RL selectively improves specific functional components rather than broadly enhancing reasoning

Architecture and safety insights are also prominent. Two papers target MoE Transformers: one identifies multi-head attention (not experts) as the primary source of catastrophic forgetting, while SD-MoE uses spectral decomposition to fix expert specialization collapse. On safety, CC-Delta leverages sparse autoencoders to detect jailbreak-relevant features, and MonoLoss proposes a single-pass objective for monosemantic SAE representations. Finally, a study of nine frontier reasoning models under multi-turn adversarial attacks catalogues five distinct failure modes including Self-Doubt and Social Conformity.

entry.title: Soft Contamination Means Benchmarks Test Shallow Generalization

author.name: Ari Spiesberger, Juan J. Vazquez, Nicky Pochinkov, Tom\'a\v{s} Gaven\v{c}iak, Peli Grietzer, Gavin Leech, Nandi Schoots

entry.summary: Demonstrates that 'soft contamination' (semantic duplicates not caught by n-gram decontamination) is widespread in LLM training data, finding semantic duplicates for 78% of CodeForces problems. Shows that benchmark improvements from such contamination don't transfer to genuinely novel problems.

entry.title: Stabilizing Native Low-Rank LLM Pretraining

author.name: Paul Janson, Edouard Oyallon, Eugene Belilovsky

entry.summary: Demonstrates that LLMs can be stably trained from scratch with exclusively low-rank factorized weights by controlling spectral norm growth, eliminating the need for full-rank guidance required by prior methods. Achieves performance matching dense models.

entry.title: Continuous Diffusion Models Can Obey Formal Syntax

author.name: Jinwoo Kim, Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick, Loris D'Antoni

entry.summary: Introduces a training-free guidance method for steering continuous diffusion language models to satisfy formal syntactic constraints (regular expressions) by constructing an analytic score function and using its gradient during sampling.

entry.title: What does RL improve for Visual Reasoning? A Frankenstein-Style Analysis

author.name: Xirui Li, Ming Li and Tianyi Zhou

entry.summary: Uses a 'Frankenstein-style' analysis to dissect what RL actually improves in vision-language models compared to supervised fine-tuning, finding that RL primarily induces inference-time shifts in mid-to-late layers that are transferable and composable via model merging.

entry.title: Multi-Head Attention as a Source of Catastrophic Forgetting in MoE Transformers

author.name: Anrui Chen, Ruijun Huang, Xin Zhang, Fang Dong, Hengjie Cao, Zhendong Huang, Yifeng Yang, Mengyi Chen, Jixian Zhou, Mingzhi Dong, Yujiang Wang, Jinlong Hou, Qin Lv, Robert P. Dick, Yuan Cheng, Tun Lu, Fan Yang, Li Shang

entry.summary: Identifies multi-head attention as a key source of catastrophic forgetting in Mixture-of-Experts Transformers, attributing it to a pre-routing bottleneck where attention concatenates signals into a single router input. This forces routing to act on co-occurring feature compositions rather than separable channels, undermining sparse expert utilization for continual learning.

entry.title: Amortized Reasoning Tree Search: Decoupling Proposal and Decision in Large Language Models

author.name: Zesheng Hong, Jiadong Yu, Hui Pan

entry.summary: Identifies a 'Normalization Squeeze' pathology in RLVR where valid but rare reasoning paths are systematically suppressed. Proposes ARTS (Amortized Reasoning Tree Search) to maintain reasoning diversity by decoupling proposal from decision.

entry.title: Sparse Autoencoders are Capable LLM Jailbreak Mitigators

author.name: Yannick Assogba, Jacopo Cortellazzi, Javier Abad, Pau Rodriguez, Xavier Suau, Arno Blaas

entry.summary: Proposes CC-Delta, a defense against LLM jailbreaks using sparse autoencoders to identify jailbreak-relevant features by comparing representations of harmful requests with and without jailbreak context, then steering in SAE latent space at inference time.

entry.title: SD-MoE: Spectral Decomposition for Effective Expert Specialization

author.name: Ruijun Huang, Fang Dong, Xin Zhang, Hengjie Cao, Zhendong Huang, Anrui Chen, Jixian Zhou, Mengyi Chen, Yifeng Yang, Mingzhi Dong, Yujiang Wang, Jinlong Hou, Qin Lv, Robert P. Dick, Yuan Cheng, Fan Yang, Tun Lu, Chun Zhang, Li Shang

entry.summary: Proposes SD-MoE, a spectral decomposition approach for improving expert specialization in MoE LLMs. Identifies that experts share overlapping dominant spectral components and gating routes along these directions, then proposes spectral regularization to improve differentiation.

entry.title: GT-HarmBench: Benchmarking AI Safety Risks Through the Lens of Game Theory

author.name: Pepijn Cobben, Xuanqiang Angelo Huang, Thao Amelia Pham, Isabel Dahlgren, Terry Jingchen Zhang, Zhijing Jin

entry.summary: Introduces GT-HarmBench, a benchmark of 2,009 game-theoretic scenarios for evaluating AI safety in multi-agent settings. Tests 15 frontier models and finds agents choose socially beneficial actions only 62% of the time.

entry.title: propella-1: Multi-Property Document Annotation for LLM Data Curation at Scale

author.name: Maximilian Idahl, Benedikt Droste, Bj\"orn Pl\"uster, Jan Philipp Harries

entry.summary: Introduces propella-1, a family of small multilingual LLMs (0.6B-4B) that annotate documents across 18 properties in 57 languages for LLM pretraining data curation, replacing single scalar quality scores with structured multi-property annotations.

entry.title: Designing RNAs with Language Models

author.name: Milan Gautam, Ning Dai, Tianshuo Zhou, Bowen Xie, David Mathews and Liang Huang

entry.summary: Reframes RNA design as conditional sequence generation using an autoregressive language model, training first in supervised mode on structure-sequence pairs then optimizing with RL, achieving strong results on RNA design benchmarks.

entry.title: HyperMLP: An Integrated Perspective for Sequence Modeling

author.name: Jiecheng Lu and Shihao Yang

entry.summary: Proposes HyperMLP, which reframes autoregressive attention as a dynamic two-layer MLP whose weights are instantiated from context history. This perspective enables using standard MLP activations like ReLU/GLU for input-conditioned selection, introducing HyperMLP and HyperGLU variants.

entry.title: RelBench v2: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Repository for Relational Data

author.name: Justin Gu, Rishabh Ranjan, Charilaos Kanatsoulis, Haiming Tang, Martin Jurkovic, Valter Hudovernik, Mark Znidar, Pranshu Chaturvedi, Parth Shroff, Fengyu Li, Jure Leskovec

entry.summary: Introduces RelBench v2, expanding a relational deep learning benchmark to 11 datasets with 22M+ rows across 29 tables, adding new large-scale datasets and autocomplete tasks. From Jure Leskovec's group, it aims to drive progress toward relational foundation models.

entry.title: RLinf-Co: Reinforcement Learning-Based Sim-Real Co-Training for VLA Models

author.name: Liangzhi Shi, Shuaihang Chen, Feng Gao, Yinuo Chen, Kang Chen, Tonghe Zhang, Hongzhi Zhang, Weinan Zhang, Chao Yu, Yu Wang

entry.summary: Proposes RLinf-Co, a framework for training vision-language-action models using reinforcement learning in simulation while preserving real-world capabilities. Uses a two-stage approach: SFT warm-start on mixed data, then RL fine-tuning with interactive simulation.

entry.title: Learning Ordinal Probabilistic Reward from Preferences

author.name: Longze Chen, Lu Wang, Renke Shan, Ze Gong, Run Luo, Jiaming Li, Jing Luo, Qiyao Wang, Min Yang

entry.summary: Proposes OPRM (Ordinal Probabilistic Reward Model), which models rewards as probability distributions over ordinal quality levels rather than deterministic scalars. Offers a practical closed-form discrete realization that can be trained from preference data without point-wise supervision.

entry.title: Flow Matching from Viewpoint of Proximal Operators

author.name: Kenji Fukumizu, Wei Huang, Han Bao, Shuntuo Xu, Nisha Chandramoothy

entry.summary: Reformulates Optimal Transport Conditional Flow Matching through proximal operators, showing the target mapping is exactly a proximal operator via an extended Brenier potential. Proves terminal normal hyperbolicity for manifold-supported targets.

entry.title: RAT-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Text Anonymization

author.name: Nata\v{s}a Kr\v{c}o, Zexi Yao, Matthieu Meeus, Yves-Alexandre de Montjoye

entry.summary: Introduces RAT-Bench, a benchmark evaluating text anonymization tools based on re-identification risk rather than just identifier removal. Tests NER- and LLM-based anonymization tools using synthetic data with U.S. demographic statistics, revealing gaps in current approaches.

entry.title: Information-theoretic analysis of world models in optimal reward maximizers

author.name: Alfred Harwood, Jose Faustino, Alex Altair

entry.summary: Proves that observing an optimal deterministic policy for a CMP conveys exactly n log m bits of information about the environment, providing formal quantification of how much world knowledge optimal policies encode.

entry.title: ProbeLLM: Automating Principled Diagnosis of LLM Failures

author.name: Yue Huang, Zhengzhe Jiang, Yuchen Ma, Yu Jiang, Xiangqi Wang, Yujun Zhou, Yuexing Hao, Kehan Guo, Pin-Yu Chen, Stefan Feuerriegel, Xiangliang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ProbeLLM, a framework that uses hierarchical Monte Carlo Tree Search to systematically discover structured failure modes in LLMs, moving beyond isolated failure cases to principled weakness characterization.

entry.title: Look Inward to Explore Outward: Learning Temperature Policy from LLM Internal States via Hierarchical RL

author.name: Yixiao Zhou, Yang Li, Dongzhou Cheng, Hehe Fan, Yu Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes Introspective LLM, a hierarchical RL framework that learns to dynamically control sampling temperature during LLM generation based on the model's hidden state. Temperature and token policies are jointly optimized from downstream rewards.

entry.title: R-Diverse: Mitigating Diversity Illusion in Self-Play LLM Training

author.name: Gengsheng Li, Jinghan He, Shijie Wang, Dan Zhang, Ruiqi Liu, Renrui Zhang, Zijun Yao, Junfeng Fang, Haiyun Guo, Jinqiao Wang

entry.summary: Identifies 'Diversity Illusion' as a key failure mode in self-play LLM reasoning, where training signals appear diverse but collapse into recurring patterns. Proposes R-Diverse with global diversity memory and skill-aware generation to mitigate this.

entry.title: Steerable Vision-Language-Action Policies for Embodied Reasoning and Hierarchical Control

author.name: William Chen, Jagdeep Singh Bhatia, Catherine Glossop, Nikhil Mathihalli, Ria Doshi, Andy Tang, Danny Driess, Karl Pertsch, Sergey Levine

entry.summary: Introduces Steerable Policies - VLAs trained on rich synthetic commands at various abstraction levels (subtasks, motions, pixel coordinates) - to improve how VLM reasoning can control low-level robot behavior beyond just language instructions.

entry.title: Think Fast and Slow: Step-Level Cognitive Depth Adaptation for LLM Agents

author.name: Ruihan Yang, Fanghua Ye, Xiang We, Ruoqing Zhao, Kang Luo, Xinbo Xu, Bo Zhao, Ruotian Ma, Shanyi Wang, Zhaopeng Tu, Xiaolong Li, Deqing Yang, Linus

entry.summary: Introduces CogRouter, a framework that trains LLM agents to dynamically adapt cognitive depth at each step in multi-turn tasks, using four hierarchical cognitive levels from instinctive responses to strategic planning, grounded in ACT-R cognitive theory.

entry.title: Thinking Like a Radiologist: A Dataset for Anatomy-Guided Interleaved Vision Language Reasoning in Chest X-ray Interpretation

author.name: Yichen Zhao, Zelin Peng, Piao Yang, Xiaokang Yang, and Wei Shen

entry.summary: Introduces MMRad-IVL-22K, the first large-scale dataset for natively interleaved visual-language reasoning in chest X-ray interpretation, motivated by how radiologists repeatedly alternate between visual inspection and language reasoning.

entry.title: Free Lunch in Medical Image Foundation Model Pre-training via Randomized Synthesis and Disentanglement

author.name: Yuhan Wei, Yuting He, Linshan Wu, Fuxiang Huang, Junlin Hou, Hao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes RaSD, a framework for pre-training medical image foundation models entirely on synthetic data using randomized Gaussian distributions for anatomical structures. Pre-trained on 1.2M 3D volumes, achieves competitive or superior results to real-data methods.

entry.title: Abstractive Red-Teaming of Language Model Character

author.name: Nate Rahn, Allison Qi, Avery Griffin, Jonathan Michala, Henry Sleight, Erik Jones

entry.summary: Introduces abstractive red-teaming, searching for natural-language query categories that routinely elicit character specification violations in LLMs. Provides an efficient method to identify vulnerability patterns using much less than deployment-level compute.

entry.title: Intrinsic Credit Assignment for Long Horizon Interaction

author.name: Ilze Amanda Auzina and Joschka Str\"uber and Sergio Hern\'andez-Guti\'errez and Shashwat Goel and Ameya Prabhu and Matthias Bethge

entry.summary: Proposes ΔBelief-RL, which uses a language model's intrinsic belief changes as reward signals for intermediate progress in long-horizon interactions. Outperforms outcome-based RL rewards and generalizes to out-of-distribution applications.

entry.title: Agent Skills for Large Language Models: Architecture, Acquisition, Security, and the Path Forward

author.name: Renjun Xu and Yang Yan

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey of agent skills for LLMs, covering the transition from monolithic models to modular skill-equipped agents, organized along architecture, acquisition, security, and integration axes including the SKILL.md specification and MCP.

entry.title: On Robustness and Chain-of-Thought Consistency of RL-Finetuned VLMs

author.name: Rosie Zhao, Anshul Shah, Xiaoyu Zhu, Xinke Deng, Zhongyu Jiang, Yang Yang, Joerg Liebelt, Arnab Mondal

entry.summary: Shows that RL-finetuned VLMs remain vulnerable to simple textual perturbations and that CoT consistency metrics reveal more pronounced drops than answer-only accuracy, with entropy-based analysis of how perturbations reshape model uncertainty.

entry.title: DiffuRank: Effective Document Reranking with Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Qi Liu, Kun Ai, Jiaxin Mao, Yanzhao Zhang, Mingxin Li, Dingkun Long, Pengjun Xie, Fengbin Zhu, Ji-Rong Wen

entry.summary: Proposes DiffuRank, using diffusion language models instead of autoregressive models for document reranking, enabling flexible parallel decoding and iterative refinement that avoids error propagation from left-to-right generation.

entry.title: CRAFT: Adapting VLA Models to Contact-rich Manipulation via Force-aware Curriculum Fine-tuning

author.name: Yike Zhang, Yaonan Wang, Xinxin Sun, Kaizhen Huang, Zhiyuan Xu, Junjie Ji, Zhengping Che, Jian Tang, Jingtao Sun

entry.summary: Introduces CRAFT, a force-aware curriculum fine-tuning framework for VLA models in contact-rich manipulation, using a variational information bottleneck to regulate vision/language embeddings and prioritize force signals during early training.

entry.title: The Constant Eye: Benchmarking and Bridging Appearance Robustness in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Jiabao Wang, Hongyu Zhou, Yuanbo Yang, Jiahao Shao, Yiyi Liao

entry.summary: Establishes navdream, a robustness benchmark for autonomous driving that isolates appearance-based shifts from structural changes using generative style transfer, revealing that many planners fail simply due to weather/lighting changes.

entry.title: Vision Token Reduction via Attention-Driven Self-Compression for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Omer Faruk Deniz, Ruiyu Mao, Ruochen Li, Yapeng Tian, Latifur Khan

entry.summary: Introduces ADSC, a method that progressively reduces vision tokens in multimodal LLMs using the LLM's own attention mechanism rather than external pruning heuristics. Applies uniform token downsampling at selected layers to form bottleneck points, compatible with FlashAttention.

entry.title: Unifying Model-Free Efficiency and Model-Based Representations via Latent Dynamics

author.name: Jashaswimalya Acharjee and Balaraman Ravindran

entry.summary: Presents Unified Latent Dynamics (ULD), a reinforcement learning algorithm that embeds state-action pairs into a latent space where value functions are approximately linear, unifying model-free efficiency with model-based representations without planning overhead.

entry.title: SLA2: Sparse-Linear Attention with Learnable Routing and QAT

author.name: Jintao Zhang, Haoxu Wang, Kai Jiang, Kaiwen Zheng, Youhe Jiang, Ion Stoica, Jianfei Chen, Jun Zhu, Joseph E. Gonzalez

entry.summary: Proposes SLA2, an improved sparse-linear attention mechanism for diffusion models with a learnable router for dynamic sparse/linear selection, a more faithful attention decomposition, and quantization-aware training for video generation efficiency.

entry.title: ALOE: Action-Level Off-Policy Evaluation for Vision-Language-Action Model Post-Training

author.name: Rushuai Yang, Hecheng Wang, Chiming Liu, Xiaohan Yan, Yunlong Wang, Xuan Du, Shuoyu Yue, Yongcheng Liu, Chuheng Zhang, Lizhe Qi, Yi Chen, Wei Shan, Maoqing Yao

entry.summary: Proposes ALOE, an action-level off-policy evaluation method for improving VLA models through online RL. Addresses the limitation of conservative on-policy estimation when learning from mixed data sources including historical policies and human interventions.

entry.title: Scaling Single Human Demonstrations for Imitation Learning using Generative Foundational Models

author.name: Nick Heppert, Minh Quang Nguyen, Abhinav Valada

entry.summary: Proposes Real2Gen, a method to train manipulation policies from a single human demonstration by transferring task information to simulation where a programmable agent generates unlimited training data for flow matching policy learning.

entry.title: PixelRush: Ultra-Fast, Training-Free High-Resolution Image Generation via One-step Diffusion

author.name: Hong-Phuc Lai, Phong Nguyen, Anh Tran

entry.summary: Introduces PixelRush, a training-free framework for high-resolution text-to-image generation that eliminates multiple inversion/regeneration cycles. Enables efficient patch-based denoising in low-step regimes, dramatically reducing generation time for 4K images from 5+ minutes.

entry.title: GRAIL: Geometry-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Inference with LLMs over Hyperbolic Representations of Patient Trajectories

author.name: Zhan Qu and Michael F\"arber

entry.summary: Proposes GRAIL, a framework using hyperbolic space embeddings and structured retrieval to predict clinical events from longitudinal EHRs, addressing LLM hallucination when reasoning over long structured patient histories.

entry.title: MentalBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Psychiatric Diagnostic Capability of Large Language Models

author.name: Hoyun Song, Migyeong Kang, Jisu Shin, Jihyun Kim, Chanbi Park, Hangyeol Yoo, Jihyun An, Alice Oh, Jinyoung Han, KyungTae Lim

entry.summary: Introduces MentalBench with a psychiatrist-built knowledge graph encoding DSM-5 criteria for 23 disorders, generating 24,750 synthetic clinical cases. Shows LLMs perform well on structured DSM-5 queries but struggle with realistic diagnostic reasoning.

entry.title: Learning Native Continuation for Action Chunking Flow Policies

author.name: Yufeng Liu, Hang Yu, Juntu Zhao, Bocheng Li, Di Zhang, Mingzhu Li, Wenxuan Wu, Yingdong Hu, Junyuan Xie, Junliang Guo, Dequan Wang, Yang Gao

entry.summary: Proposes Legato, a training-time continuation method for action-chunked flow-based VLA policies that addresses discontinuities at chunk boundaries by initializing denoising from a mixture of known actions and noise.

entry.title: Towards Universal Video MLLMs with Attribute-Structured and Quality-Verified Instructions

author.name: Yunheng Li, Hengrui Zhang, Meng-Hao Guo, Wenzhao Gao, Shaoyong Jia, Shaohui Jiao, Qibin Hou, Ming-Ming Cheng

entry.summary: Introduces ASID-1M, a million-scale structured audiovisual instruction dataset with fine-grained attribute annotations and automatic quality verification for training universal video MLLMs. Also presents ASID-Cap, a new video captioning module. Addresses the data quality bottleneck in video understanding.

entry.title: Diverging Flows: Detecting Extrapolations in Conditional Generation

author.name: Constantinos Tsakonas, Serena Ivaldi, Jean-Baptiste Mouret

entry.summary: Introduces Diverging Flows, a method that enables flow matching models to simultaneously perform conditional generation and detect extrapolation by structurally enforcing inefficient transport for off-manifold inputs, addressing silent failure risks.

entry.title: Memory-Efficient Structured Backpropagation for On-Device LLM Fine-Tuning

author.name: Juneyoung Park, Yuri Hong, Seongwan Kim, Jaeho Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Memory-efficient Structured Backpropagation (MeSP) that exploits LoRA's low-rank structure to reduce memory for on-device LLM fine-tuning by 49% while computing mathematically identical gradients, by recomputing the low-rank intermediate projection during backward passes.

entry.title: LongStream: Long-Sequence Streaming Autoregressive Visual Geometry

author.name: Chong Cheng, Xianda Chen, Tao Xie, Wei Yin, Weiqiang Ren, Qian Zhang, Xiaoyuang Guo, Hao Wang

entry.summary: Introduces LongStream, a streaming visual geometry model for metric-scale 3D reconstruction across thousands of frames, using keyframe-relative poses, orthogonal scale learning, and Transformer cache solutions to handle long sequences.

entry.title: Semantic Chunking and the Entropy of Natural Language

author.name: Weishun Zhong, Doron Sivan, Tankut Can, Mikhail Katkov, Misha Tsodyks

entry.summary: Introduces a statistical model for the multi-scale structure of natural language through hierarchical semantic chunking, providing a first-principles account of English's ~80% redundancy. Validated with modern LLMs and open datasets.

entry.title: From Biased Chatbots to Biased Agents: Examining Role Assignment Effects on LLM Agent Robustness

author.name: Linbo Cao, Lihao Sun, Yang Yue

entry.summary: First systematic study showing that demographic-based persona assignments can degrade LLM agent task performance by up to 26.2% across strategic reasoning, planning, and technical operations benchmarks.

entry.title: ForeAct: Steering Your VLA with Efficient Visual Foresight Planning

author.name: Zhuoyang Zhang, Shang Yang, Qinghao Hu, Luke J. Huang, James Hou, Yufei Sun, Yao Lu, Song Han

entry.summary: Presents ForeAct, a visual foresight planner for Vision-Language-Action models that generates imagined future observations to guide step-by-step robot action. Achieves 0.33s generation of 640x480 future observations on H100.

entry.title: Synthetic Interaction Data for Scalable Personalization in Large Language Models

author.name: Yuchen Ma, Yue Huang, Wenjie Wang, Xiaonan Luo, Xiangliang Zhang, Stefan Feuerriegel

entry.summary: Introduces PersonaGym, a synthetic data generation framework for personalized LLM interactions that models dynamic user preferences through an agentic LLM system, addressing the lack of high-quality personalization training data.

entry.title: RankLLM: Weighted Ranking of LLMs by Quantifying Question Difficulty

author.name: Ziqian Zhang, Xingjian Hu, Yue Huang, Kai Zhang, Ruoxi Chen, Yixin Liu, Qingsong Wen, Kaidi Xu, Xiangliang Zhang, Neil Zhenqiang Gong, and Lichao Sun

entry.summary: Proposes RankLLM, a framework that quantifies question difficulty and model competency through bidirectional score propagation, enabling more fine-grained LLM evaluation that differentiates model capabilities based on question difficulty.

entry.title: Monocular Reconstruction of Neural Tactile Fields

author.name: Pavan Mantripragada, Siddhanth Deshmukh, Eadom Dessalene, Manas Desai, Yiannis Aloimonos

entry.summary: Introduces neural tactile fields, a 3D representation mapping spatial locations to expected tactile responses, predicted from a single RGB image and enabling path planning that distinguishes between high- and low-resistance obstacles.

entry.title: Self-Supervised JEPA-based World Models for LiDAR Occupancy Completion and Forecasting

author.name: Haoran Zhu, Anna Choromanska

entry.summary: Proposes AD-LiST-JEPA, a self-supervised world model for autonomous driving that predicts future spatiotemporal evolution from LiDAR data using the JEPA (joint-embedding predictive architecture) framework.

entry.title: Can I Have Your Order? Monte-Carlo Tree Search for Slot Filling Ordering in Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Joshua Ong Jun Leang, Yu Zhao, Mihaela C\u{a}t\u{a}lina Stoian, Wenda Li, Shay B. Cohen, Eleonora Giunchiglia

entry.summary: Introduces McDiffuSE, a framework that uses Monte Carlo Tree Search to optimize the slot-filling order in Masked Diffusion Models for code and math reasoning. It achieves notable improvements over autoregressive baselines (3.2% average, 19.5% on MBPP) by using look-ahead simulations to evaluate partial completions before committing.

entry.title: AI Agents for Inventory Control: Human-LLM-OR Complementarity

author.name: Jackie Baek, Yaopeng Fu, Will Ma, Tianyi Peng

entry.summary: Studies how OR algorithms, LLMs, and humans can complement each other for inventory control, introducing InventoryBench with 1000+ inventory instances. Finds that hybrid Human-LLM-OR approaches outperform individual methods, with LLMs providing flexible reasoning for distribution shifts.

entry.title: Hierarchical Successor Representation for Robust Transfer

author.name: Changmin Yu, M\'at\'e Lengyel

entry.summary: Proposes Hierarchical Successor Representation (HSR) that incorporates temporal abstractions to overcome policy dependence and spectral diffusion limitations of classical successor representations, enabling robust transfer across changing tasks and environments.

entry.title: Closing the Loop: A Control-Theoretic Framework for Provably Stable Time Series Forecasting with LLMs

author.name: Xingyu Zhang, Hanyun Du, Zeen Song, Jianqi Zhang, Changwen Zheng, Wenwen Qiang

entry.summary: Proposes F-LLM, reformulating autoregressive LLM forecasting through control theory, introducing a closed-loop feedback framework that reduces error accumulation (exposure bias) during long-horizon time series prediction.

entry.title: Left-right asymmetry in predicting brain activity from LLMs' representations emerges with their formal linguistic competence

author.name: Laurent Bonnasse-Gahot and Christophe Pallier

entry.summary: Shows that left-right brain asymmetry in predicting brain activity from LLM representations emerges alongside the model's formal linguistic competence during training. Uses OLMo-2 7B at various checkpoints with fMRI data to link linguistic competence to hemispheric lateralization.

entry.title: TRACE: Temporal Reasoning via Agentic Context Evolution for Streaming Electronic Health Records (EHRs)

author.name: Zhan Qu and Michael F\"arber

entry.summary: Introduces TRACE, a framework enabling temporal clinical reasoning with frozen LLMs via a dual-memory architecture (static global protocol + dynamic patient chronicle) rather than fine-tuning or extending context windows.

entry.title: Training-Free Acceleration for Document Parsing Vision-Language Model with Hierarchical Speculative Decoding

author.name: Wenhui Liao, Hongliang Li, Pengyu Xie, Xinyu Cai, Yufan Shen, Yi Xin, Qi Qin, Shenglong Ye, Tianbin Li, Ming Hu, Junjun He, Yihao Liu, Wenhai Wang, Min Dou, Bin Fu, Botian Shi, Yu Qiao, Lianwen Jin

entry.summary: Proposes hierarchical speculative decoding for accelerating VLM-based document parsing, using a lightweight document parsing pipeline as a draft model to accelerate autoregressive token generation.

entry.title: Buy versus Build an LLM: A Decision Framework for Governments

author.name: Jiahao Lu, Ziwei Xu, William Tjhi, Junnan Li, Antoine Bosselut, Pang Wei Koh, Mohan Kankanhalli

entry.summary: Presents a decision framework for governments choosing between buying existing LLM services from foreign corporations, building domestic capabilities, or adopting hybrid approaches. Analyzes sovereignty, security, and capability trade-offs across different public-sector use cases.

entry.title: LCSB: Layer-Cyclic Selective Backpropagation for Memory-Efficient On-Device LLM Fine-Tuning

author.name: Juneyoung Park, Eunbeen Yoon, Seongwan Kim. Jaeho Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Layer-Cyclic Selective Backpropagation (LCSB) for memory-efficient on-device LLM fine-tuning, computing gradients for only a subset of layers per step. Interprets the approach as Block Coordinate Descent on LoRA parameters.

entry.title: Which Algorithms Can Graph Neural Networks Learn?

author.name: Solveig Wittig, Antonis Vasileiou, Robert R. Nerem, Timo Stoll, Floris Geerts, Yusu Wang, and Christopher Morris

entry.summary: Proposes a theoretical framework characterizing sufficient conditions for GNNs to learn and generalize discrete algorithms, going beyond expressivity analysis to address when GNN architectures generalize from finite training sets in neural algorithmic reasoning.

entry.title: CoPE-VideoLM: Codec Primitives For Efficient Video Language Models

author.name: Sayan Deb Sarkar, R\'emi Pautrat, Ondrej Miksik, Marc Pollefeys, Iro Armeni, Mahdi Rad, Mihai Dusmanu

entry.summary: Proposes CoPE-VideoLM, which leverages video codec primitives (motion vectors, residuals) instead of full image encoding for most frames in video language models, achieving better temporal coverage with reduced computation.

entry.title: OptiML: An End-to-End Framework for Program Synthesis and CUDA Kernel Optimization

author.name: Arijit Bhattacharjee, Heng Ping, Son Vu Le, Paul Bogdan, Nesreen K. Ahmed, Ali Jannesari

entry.summary: Presents OptiML, an end-to-end framework that maps natural language or CUDA code to performance-optimized CUDA kernels through a Mixture-of-Thoughts generator and search-based optimization with verification.

entry.title: Self-Refining Vision Language Model for Robotic Failure Detection and Reasoning

author.name: Carl Qi, Xiaojie Wang, Silong Yong, Stephen Sheng, Huitan Mao, Sriram Srinivasan, Manikantan Nambi, Amy Zhang, Yesh Dattatreya

entry.summary: Introduces ARMOR, a self-refining vision-language model for robotic failure detection that formulates detection and reasoning as a multi-task self-refinement process, learning from heterogeneous supervision signals.

entry.title: RBCorr: Response Bias Correction in Language Models

author.name: Om Bhatt, Anna A. Ivanova

entry.summary: Proposes RBCorr, a simple response bias correction strategy for language models tested on 12 open-weight models across different question types. Shows response bias is prevalent and that correction effectively eliminates bias and improves performance.

entry.title: Human-Like Coarse Object Representations in Vision Models

author.name: Andrey Gizdov, Andrea Procopio, Yichen Li, Daniel Harari, Tomer Ullman

entry.summary: Studies whether segmentation models acquire human-like coarse object representations for physics, finding an inverse U-shaped curve where intermediate-capacity models best match human behavior.

entry.title: Flow-Factory: A Unified Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Flow-Matching Models

author.name: Bowen Ping, Chengyou Jia, Minnan Luo, Hangwei Qian, Ivor Tsang

entry.summary: Introduces Flow-Factory, a unified framework decoupling algorithms, models, and rewards for RL-based alignment of flow-matching models, supporting GRPO, DiffusionNFT, and AWM across multiple image and video models.

entry.title: Formalizing the Sampling Design Space of Diffusion-Based Generative Models via Adaptive Solvers and Wasserstein-Bounded Timesteps

author.name: Sangwoo Jo, Sungjoon Choi

entry.summary: Already analyzed above.

entry.title: ImageRAGTurbo: Towards One-step Text-to-Image Generation with Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion Models

author.name: Peijie Qiu, Hariharan Ramshankar, Arnau Ramisa, Ren\'e Vidal, Amit Kumar K C, Vamsi Salaka, Rahul Bhagat

entry.summary: Proposes ImageRAGTurbo, which enhances few-step diffusion models via retrieval augmentation, retrieving relevant text-image pairs to condition generation. Aims to achieve one-step high-quality text-to-image generation with reduced training costs.

entry.title: Evaluating Robustness of Reasoning Models on Parameterized Logical Problems

author.name: Na\"im Es-sebbani, Esteban Marquer, Yakoub Salhi, Zied Bouraoui

entry.summary: Introduces a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating LLM reasoning on parameterized 2-SAT problems, isolating specific failure modes through controlled structural properties like contradiction cycles, free variables, and planted backbones.

entry.title: Leverage-Weighted Conformal Prediction

author.name: Shreyas Fadnavis

entry.summary: Proposes Leverage-Weighted Conformal Prediction (LWCP), which uses statistical leverage from the hat matrix to weight nonconformity scores for adaptive prediction intervals. Proves marginal validity, asymptotic conditional coverage, and recovery of standard CP.

entry.title: VimRAG: Navigating Massive Visual Context in Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Multimodal Memory Graph

author.name: Qiuchen Wang, Shihang Wang, Yu Zeng, Qiang Zhang, Fanrui Zhang, Zhuoning Guo, Bosi Zhang, Wenxuan Huang, Lin Chen, Zehui Chen, Pengjun Xie, Ruixue Ding

entry.summary: Already analyzed above.

entry.title: 3DLAND: 3D Lesion Abdominal Anomaly Localization Dataset

author.name: Mehran Advand, Zahra Dehghanian, Navid Faraji, Reza Barati, Seyed Amir Ahmad Safavi-Naini, Hamid R. Rabiee

entry.summary: Introduces 3DLAND, a large-scale benchmark with 6,000+ CT volumes and 20,000+ 3D lesion annotations linked to seven abdominal organs. Uses a three-phase pipeline validated by radiologists with surface dice scores exceeding 0.75.

entry.title: RADAR: Revealing Asymmetric Development of Abilities in MLLM Pre-training

author.name: Yunshuang Nie, Bingqian Lin, Minzhe Niu, Kun Xiang, Jianhua Han, Guowei Huang, Xingyue Quan, Hang Xu, Bokui Chen, Xiaodan Liang

entry.summary: Proposes RADAR, an efficient evaluation framework for diagnosing perception and reasoning bottlenecks in pre-trained MLLMs without requiring supervised fine-tuning, revealing asymmetric development of abilities during pre-training.

entry.title: Annealing in variational inference mitigates mode collapse: A theoretical study on Gaussian mixtures

author.name: Luigi Fogliani, Bruno Loureiro, Marylou Gabri\'e

entry.summary: Provides mathematical analysis of annealing strategies for mitigating mode collapse in variational inference, deriving sharp formulas for mode collapse probability when learning Gaussian mixtures.

entry.title: Know More, Know Clearer: A Meta-Cognitive Framework for Knowledge Augmentation in Large Language Models

author.name: Hao Chen, Ye He, Yuchun Fan, Yukun Yan, Zhenghao Liu, Qingfu Zhu, Maosong Sun, Wanxiang Che

entry.summary: Proposes a meta-cognitive framework for knowledge augmentation in LLMs that partitions knowledge into mastered, confused, and missing regions using internal cognitive signals, then applies differentiated intervention and alignment.

entry.title: Agentic AI for Robot Control: Flexible but still Fragile

author.name: Oscar Lima, Marc Vinci, Martin G\"unther, Marian Renz, Alexander Sung, Sebastian Stock, Johannes Brust, Lennart Niecksch, Zongyao Yi, Felix Igelbrink, Benjamin Kisliuk, Martin Atzmueller, Joachim Hertzberg

entry.summary: Presents an agentic robot control system using reasoning-capable LLMs that plan and execute tasks through an iterative planner-executor loop, deployed on two physical robot platforms. Finds the approach is flexible but fragile under real-world conditions.

entry.title: SCOPE: Selective Conformal Optimized Pairwise LLM Judging

author.name: Sher Badshah, Ali Emami, Hassan Sajjad

entry.summary: Proposes SCOPE, a framework for selective pairwise LLM judging with finite-sample statistical guarantees, using Bidirectional Preference Entropy to provide bias-neutral uncertainty signals and conformal calibration for error rate control.

entry.title: Quantization-Robust LLM Unlearning via Low-Rank Adaptation

author.name: Jo\~ao Vitor Boer Abitante, Joana Meneguzzo Pasquali, Luan Fonseca Garcia, Ewerton de Oliveira, Thomas da Silva Paula, Rodrigo C. Barros, Lucas S. Kupssinsk\"u

entry.summary: Shows that standard LLM unlearning via full-parameter fine-tuning fails under 4-bit quantization, and proposes using LoRA adapters to concentrate unlearning updates so they survive aggressive post-training quantization.

entry.title: Conversational Image Segmentation: Grounding Abstract Concepts with Scalable Supervision

author.name: Aadarsh Sahoo, Georgia Gkioxari

entry.summary: Introduces Conversational Image Segmentation (CIS) covering intent, affordances, functions, safety, and physical reasoning queries, with ConverSeg benchmark and ConverSeg-Net model. Shows current models are inadequate for abstract reasoning in segmentation.

entry.title: Imitating What Works: Simulation-Filtered Modular Policy Learning from Human Videos

author.name: Albert J. Zhai, Kuo-Hao Zeng, Jiasen Lu, Ali Farhadi, Shenlong Wang, Wei-Chiu Ma

entry.summary: Proposes Perceive-Simulate-Imitate (PSI) for learning manipulation from human videos using modular policy design with simulation-based filtering to ensure grasps are task-compatible for downstream motions.

entry.title: The Appeal and Reality of Recycling LoRAs with Adaptive Merging

author.name: Haokun Liu, Gyung Hyun Je, Marco Ciccone, Zhenlin Xu, Prasanth YSS, Colin Raffel

entry.summary: Studies adaptive LoRA merging from a pool of ~1,000 user-contributed LoRAs on Hugging Face for Llama 3.1 8B. Finds that recycling wild LoRAs rarely outperforms single-task fine-tuning, challenging assumptions about LoRA reuse.

entry.title: LongNav-R1: Horizon-Adaptive Multi-Turn RL for Long-Horizon VLA Navigation

author.name: Yue Hu, Avery Xi, Qixin Xiao, Seth Isaacson, Henry X. Liu, Ram Vasudevan, Maani Ghaffari

entry.summary: Develops LongNav-R1, a multi-turn RL framework for long-horizon VLA navigation that reformulates navigation as continuous multi-turn conversation with the environment. Introduces Horizon-Adaptive Policy Optimization.

entry.title: Why Deep Jacobian Spectra Separate: Depth-Induced Scaling and Singular-Vector Alignment

author.name: Nathana\"el Haas, Franc\c{c}ois Gatine, Augustin M Cosse, Zied Bouraoui

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of why deep network Jacobian spectra separate, proving existence of Lyapunov exponents governing singular values and quantifying depth-induced exponential scaling. Verified empirically on practical networks.

entry.title: AstRL: Analog and Mixed-Signal Circuit Synthesis with Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Felicia B. Guo, Ken T. Ho, Andrei Vladimirescu, Borivoje Nikolic

entry.summary: Introduces AstRL, a deep RL approach that casts analog/mixed-signal circuit design as a graph generation problem, directly optimizing circuits for user-specified targets within a simulator-embedded environment.

entry.title: Safe Reinforcement Learning via Recovery-based Shielding with Gaussian Process Dynamics Models

author.name: Alexander W. Goodall, Francesco Belardinelli

entry.summary: Introduces a recovery-based shielding framework for safe RL with provable safety guarantees for unknown nonlinear continuous dynamical systems, using Gaussian processes for uncertainty quantification and dynamic recovery to safe trajectories.

entry.title: Layer-Specific Fine-Tuning for Improved Negation Handling in Medical Vision-Language Models

author.name: Ali Abbasi, Mehdi Taghipour, Rahmatollah Beheshti

entry.summary: Introduces NAST, a method for improving medical VLMs' handling of negation in clinical reporting through interpretability-guided layer-specific fine-tuning, with a new radiology benchmark for polarity sensitivity.

entry.title: AMPS: Adaptive Modality Preference Steering via Functional Entropy

author.name: Zihan Huang, Xintong Li, Rohan Surana, Tong Yu, Rui Wang, Julian McAuley, Jingbo Shang, Junda Wu

entry.summary: Introduces AMPS, an instance-aware method for adaptively steering modality preference in multimodal LLMs using functional entropy, avoiding the problems of uniform steering intensity that either impairs performance or is ineffective.

entry.title: QuEPT: Quantized Elastic Precision Transformers with One-Shot Calibration for Multi-Bit Switching

author.name: Ke Xu and Yixin Wang and Zhongcheng Li and Hao Cui and Jinshui Hu and Xingyi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes QuEPT, a post-training quantization scheme for Transformers that enables multi-bit deployment through one-shot calibration and can dynamically switch between different bit-widths using cascaded low-rank adapters without repeated optimization.

entry.title: Real-to-Sim for Highly Cluttered Environments via Physics-Consistent Inter-Object Reasoning

author.name: Tianyi Xiang, Jiahang Cao, Sikai Guo, Guoyang Zhao, Andrew F. Luo, Jun Ma

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-constrained Real-to-Sim pipeline that reconstructs physically consistent 3D scenes from single-view RGB-D data for cluttered environments. Uses differentiable optimization to model spatial dependencies and prevent physically invalid states like floating objects.

entry.title: $\mathcal{X}$-KD: General Experiential Knowledge Distillation for Large Language Models

author.name: Yuang Cai and Yuyu Yuan

entry.summary: Proposes X-KD (Experiential Knowledge Distillation), which enables student models to learn in the teacher's original learning environment by jointly modeling the teacher's reward function and performing policy distillation using the AVRIL framework from inverse RL.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Laplace Neural Operator for Solving Partial Differential Equations

author.name: Heechang Kim, Qianying Cao, Hyomin Shin, Seungchul Lee, George Em Karniadakis, Minseok Choi

entry.summary: Proposes PILNO, a physics-informed Laplace Neural Operator that embeds PDE physics into training through residual losses, improving generalization in small-data regimes and out-of-distribution settings compared to purely data-driven neural operators.

entry.title: SafeFlowMPC: Predictive and Safe Trajectory Planning for Robot Manipulators with Learning-based Policies

author.name: Thies Oelerich, Gerald Ebmer, Christian Hartl-Nesic, Andreas Kugi

entry.summary: Proposes SafeFlowMPC, combining flow matching with online optimization for robot trajectory planning that guarantees safety at all times while maintaining real-time execution. Addresses the gap between flexible learning-based policies and safety-guaranteed optimization.

entry.title: Reliable Thinking with Images

author.name: Haobin Li, Yutong Yang, Yijie Lin, Dai Xiang, Mouxing Yang, Xi Peng

entry.summary: Addresses Noisy Thinking in multimodal chain-of-thought, where imperfect visual cues cascade into reasoning errors. Studies the problem of unreliable interleaved image-text reasoning and proposes methods for more reliable Thinking with Images.

entry.title: TFTF: Training-Free Targeted Flow for Conditional Sampling

author.name: Qianqian Qu and Jun S. Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free conditional sampling method for flow matching using importance sampling with SMC resampling and adjustable stochastic flow. Provides theoretical guarantees and outperforms existing methods on MNIST and CIFAR-10.

entry.title: Prior-Guided Symbolic Regression: Towards Scientific Consistency in Equation Discovery

author.name: Jing Xiao, Xinhai Chen, Jiaming Peng, Qinglin Wang, Menghan Jia, Zhiquan Lai, Guangping Yu, Dongsheng Li, Tiejun Li, Jie Liu

entry.summary: Proposes PG-SR, a prior-guided symbolic regression framework that explicitly encodes scientific domain knowledge as constraint programs to prevent 'Pseudo-Equation Trap' where fitted equations violate fundamental physical laws. Uses a three-stage pipeline of warm-up, evolution, and refinement.

entry.title: UniManip: General-Purpose Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation with Agentic Operational Graph

author.name: Haichao Liu, Yuanjiang Xue, Yuheng Zhou, Haoyuan Deng, Yinan Liang, Lihua Xie, Ziwei Wang

entry.summary: Presents UniManip, a zero-shot robotic manipulation framework using a Bi-level Agentic Operational Graph that couples high-level semantic reasoning with low-level physical grounding for general-purpose manipulation in unstructured environments.

entry.title: FlashSchNet: Fast and Accurate Coarse-Grained Neural Network Molecular Dynamics

author.name: Pingzhi Li, Hongxuan Li, Zirui Liu, Xingcheng Lin, Tianlong Chen

entry.summary: Presents FlashSchNet, an IO-aware GNN molecular dynamics framework that fuses kernel operations to minimize GPU memory transfers, achieving significant speedups over standard SchNet while maintaining accuracy for coarse-grained MD simulations.

entry.title: FlexAM: Flexible Appearance-Motion Decomposition for Versatile Video Generation Control

author.name: Mingzhi Sheng, Zekai Gu, Peng Li, Cheng Lin, Hao-Xiang Guo, Ying-Cong Chen, Yuan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes FlexAM, a unified video generation control framework using 3D point cloud control signals that disentangle appearance and motion, enabling diverse tasks including I2V editing, camera control, and object manipulation.

entry.title: Decoder-only Conformer with Modality-aware Sparse Mixtures of Experts for ASR

author.name: Jaeyoung Lee, Masato Mimura

entry.summary: Presents a decoder-only Conformer for ASR using modality-aware sparse MoE with disjoint expert pools for speech and text, achieving improved WER over encoder-decoder baselines without external speech encoders or pretrained LLMs.

entry.title: Dual-Granularity Contrastive Reward via Generated Episodic Guidance for Efficient Embodied RL

author.name: Xin Liu, Yixuan Li, Yuhui Chen, Yuxing Qin, Haoran Li, Dongbin Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes DEG, a framework for generating dense reward signals in embodied RL using video generation models with minimal expert supervision. Uses dual-granularity contrastive rewards from generated episodic guidance videos to improve sample efficiency.

entry.title: Peak + Accumulation: A Proxy-Level Scoring Formula for Multi-Turn LLM Attack Detection

author.name: J Alex Corll

entry.summary: Proposes a peak + accumulation scoring formula for detecting multi-turn prompt injection attacks at the proxy layer without invoking an LLM. Identifies a fundamental flaw in weighted-average approaches and draws on CUSUM and Bayesian updating.

entry.title: Alignment or Integration? Rethinking Multimodal Fusion in DNA-language Foundation Models

author.name: Yanan Li, Christina Yi Jin, Yuan Jin, Manli Luo, Tie Xu, Shuai Jiao, Wei He, Qing Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes two new methods for DNA-language fusion: SeqCLIP for embedding-level alignment via contrastive pre-training, and OneVocab for vocabulary-level integration of genomic k-mers into LLM tokenizers. Compares alignment vs. integration approaches.

entry.title: LatentAM: Real-Time, Large-Scale Latent Gaussian Attention Mapping via Online Dictionary Learning

author.name: Junwoon Lee and Yulun Tian

entry.summary: Presents LatentAM, an online 3DGS mapping framework using dictionary learning for scalable latent feature maps from streaming RGB-D data. Enables model-agnostic, pretraining-free integration with different VLMs.

entry.title: LLaMo: Scaling Pretrained Language Models for Unified Motion Understanding and Generation with Continuous Autoregressive Tokens

author.name: Zekun Li, Sizhe An, Chengcheng Tang, Chuan Guo, Ivan Shugurov, Linguang Zhang, Amy Zhao, Srinath Sridhar, Lingling Tao, Abhay Mittal

entry.summary: Proposes LLaMo, a unified framework extending pretrained LLMs for motion-language generation and understanding using continuous autoregressive tokens and modality-specific Mixture-of-Transformers to avoid catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: Provably Convergent Actor-Critic in Risk-averse MARL

author.name: Yizhou Zhang and Eric Mazumdar

entry.summary: Studies Risk-averse Quantal Response Equilibria (RQE) in multi-agent RL and proposes a provably convergent two-timescale actor-critic algorithm for infinite-horizon general-sum Markov games.

entry.title: Prototype-driven fusion of pathology and spatial transcriptomics for interpretable survival prediction

author.name: Lihe Liu, Xiaoxi Pan, Yinyin Yuan, Lulu Shang

entry.summary: Introduces PathoSpatial, a framework integrating whole slide images with spatial transcriptomics for survival prediction using task-guided prototype learning within a multi-level experts architecture.

entry.title: Composable Model-Free RL for Navigation with Input-Affine Systems

author.name: Xinhuan Sang, Abdelrahman Abdelgawad, Roberto Tron

entry.summary: Proposes a composable model-free RL method for robot navigation that learns value functions for individual environment elements and composes them online, exploiting input-affine structure for continuous-time HJB equations.

entry.title: Visual RAG Toolkit: Scaling Multi-Vector Visual Retrieval with Training-Free Pooling and Multi-Stage Search

author.name: Ara Yeroyan

entry.summary: Presents Visual RAG Toolkit for scaling multi-vector visual retrieval with training-free spatial pooling and multi-stage search, achieving quadratic reduction in vector comparisons while maintaining retrieval quality.

entry.title: Bench-MFG: A Benchmark Suite for Learning in Stationary Mean Field Games

author.name: Lorenzo Magnino, Jiacheng Shen, Matthieu Geist, Olivier Pietquin, Mathieu Lauri\`ere

entry.summary: Introduces Bench-MFG, a comprehensive benchmark suite for Mean Field Games with a taxonomy of problem classes and prototypical environments, addressing the lack of standardized evaluation in MFG research.

entry.title: Exploring Accurate and Transparent Domain Adaptation in Predictive Healthcare via Concept-Grounded Orthogonal Inference

author.name: Pengfei Hu, Chang Lu, Feifan Liu, Yue Ning

entry.summary: Proposes ExtraCare for domain adaptation in clinical EHR prediction, decomposing representations into orthogonal invariant and covariant components with concept-grounded interpretability for clinical transparency.

entry.title: Block-Sample MAC-Bayes Generalization Bounds

author.name: Matthias Frey and Jingge Zhu and Michael C. Gastpar

entry.summary: Presents block-sample MAC-Bayes generalization bounds that bound expected generalization error using divergence terms dependent on subsets of training data rather than the full dataset. This generalizes known PAC-Bayes bounds and promises tighter bounds in practice.

entry.title: When Environments Shift: Safe Planning with Generative Priors and Robust Conformal Prediction

author.name: Kaizer Rahaman and Jyotirmoy V. Deshmukh and Ashish R. Hota and Lars Lindemann

entry.summary: Proposes a safe planning framework combining generative priors with robust conformal prediction to handle distribution shift in autonomous systems. Uses MPC with conformal prediction regions that remain valid under changing environments.

entry.title: Unleashing Low-Bit Inference on Ascend NPUs: A Comprehensive Evaluation of HiFloat Formats

author.name: Pengxiang Zhao, Hui-Ling Zhen, Xing Li, Han Bao, Weizhe Lin, Zhiyuan Yang, Ziwei Yu, Xin Wang, Mingxuan Yuan, Xianzhi Yu, Zhenhua Dong

entry.summary: Evaluates HiFloat (HiF8, HiF4) low-bit floating-point formats designed for Ascend NPUs across weight-activation and KV-cache quantization tasks. Finds HiF4's hierarchical scaling prevents accuracy collapse seen in integer formats, and HiFloat is compatible with existing PTQ frameworks.

entry.title: Trust the uncertain teacher: distilling dark knowledge via calibrated uncertainty

author.name: Jeonghyun Kim, SooKyung Kim, Richeng Xuan, Hyunsoo Cho

entry.summary: Proposes calibration-aware knowledge distillation where the teacher's uncertainty is preserved during transfer rather than collapsed into overconfident predictions. Shows improved robustness under distribution shift for high-cardinality tasks.

entry.title: SWING: Unlocking Implicit Graph Representations for Graph Random Features

author.name: Alessandro Manenti, Avinava Dubey, Arijit Sehanobish, Cesare Alippi, Krzysztof Choromanski

entry.summary: Proposes SWING, algorithms for computing Graph Random Features on implicitly-defined graphs using walks in continuous embedding spaces rather than discrete graph structures, with Gumbel-softmax sampling and linearized kernels.

entry.title: ReFilter: Improving Robustness of Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Gated Filter

author.name: Yixin Chen, Ying Xiong, Shangyu Wu, Xiangrui Ke, Nan Guan, Chun Jason Xue

entry.summary: Proposes ReFilter, a latent-based fusion framework for RAG that performs token-level filtering of retrieved content using a gated mechanism, scaling more gracefully as the number of retrieved candidates increases.

entry.title: Blessings of Multiple Good Arms in Multi-Objective Linear Bandits

author.name: Heesang Ann and Min-hwan Oh

entry.summary: Demonstrates that in multi-objective linear bandits, multiple good arms create implicit exploration, enabling simple greedy algorithms to achieve strong performance. First study introducing implicit exploration in multi-objective parametric bandits.

entry.title: Unleashing MLLMs on the Edge: A Unified Framework for Cross-Modal ReID via Adaptive SVD Distillation

author.name: Hongbo Jiang, Jie Li, Xinqi Cai, Tianyu Xie, Yunhang Shen, Pingyang Dai, Liujuan Cao

entry.summary: Proposes MLLMEmbed-ReID, a unified framework adapting MLLMs for cross-modal re-identification across RGB, infrared, sketch, and text modalities, with SVD-based knowledge distillation for edge deployment.

entry.title: TriGen: NPU Architecture for End-to-End Acceleration of Large Language Models based on SW-HW Co-Design

author.name: Jonghun Lee, Junghoon Lee, Hyeonjin Kim, Seoho Jeon, Jisup Yoon, Hyunbin Park, Meejeong Park, and Heonjae Ha

entry.summary: Proposes TriGen, an NPU architecture for end-to-end LLM acceleration on resource-constrained devices using microscaling precision, memory reuse patterns, and hardware-software co-design.

entry.title: INHerit-SG: Incremental Hierarchical Semantic Scene Graphs with RAG-Style Retrieval

author.name: YukTungSamuel Fang, Zhikang Shi, Jiabin Qiu, Zixuan Chen, Jieqi Shi, Hao Xu, Jing Huo, Yang Gao

entry.summary: Presents INHerit-SG, an incremental hierarchical semantic scene graph system with RAG-style retrieval for robot navigation, using natural-language descriptions as explicit semantic anchors aligned with human intent.

entry.title: Detecting Object Tracking Failure via Sequential Hypothesis Testing

author.name: Alejandro Monroy Mu\~noz, Rajeev Verma, Alexander Timans

entry.summary: Proposes interpreting object tracking as a sequential hypothesis test using e-processes, providing formal guarantees on false alert rates while quickly detecting tracking failures.

entry.title: Uncertainty in Federated Granger Causality: From Origins to Systemic Consequences

author.name: Ayush Mohanty, Nazal Mohamed, Nagi Gebraeel

entry.summary: Establishes the first methodology for quantifying uncertainty propagation in federated Granger Causality, distinguishing aleatoric from epistemic sources and deriving closed-form recursions for uncertainty evolution.

entry.title: Human-Aligned MLLM Judges for Fine-Grained Image Editing Evaluation: A Benchmark, Framework, and Analysis

author.name: Runzhou Liu (1), Hailey Weingord (2), Sejal Mittal (2), Prakhar Dungarwal (2), Anusha Nandula (2), Bo Ni (3), Samyadeep Basu (4), Hongjie Chen (5), Nesreen K. Ahmed (6), Li Li (7), Jiayi Zhang (8), Koustava Goswami (4), Subhojyoti Mukherjee (4), Branislav Kveton (4), Puneet Mathur (4), Franck Dernoncourt (4), Yue Zhao (7), Yu Wang (9), Ryan A. Rossi (4), Zhengzhong Tu (10), Hongru Du (1) ((1) University of Virginia, (2) Columbia University, (3) Vanderbilt University, (4) Adobe Research, (5) Dolby Laboratories, (6) Cisco Research, (7) University of Southern California, (8) University of Wisconsin-Madison, (9) University of Oregon, (10) Texas A&M University)

entry.summary: Introduces a fine-grained MLLM-as-a-Judge framework for image editing evaluation, decomposing assessment into twelve interpretable factors. Presents a human-validated benchmark integrating human judgments with MLLM evaluations across multiple editing models.

entry.title: Curriculum-DPO++: Direct Preference Optimization via Data and Model Curricula for Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Florinel-Alin Croitoru, Vlad Hondru, Radu Tudor Ionescu, Nicu Sebe, Mubarak Shah

entry.summary: Introduces Curriculum-DPO++, enhancing Direct Preference Optimization for text-to-image generation by combining data-level difficulty curriculum with a novel model-level curriculum that dynamically increases denoising network capacity during training.

entry.title: Random Forests as Statistical Procedures: Design, Variance, and Dependence

author.name: Nathaniel S. O'Connell

entry.summary: Develops a finite-sample, design-based formulation of random forests that yields exact variance identities separating finite-aggregation variability from structural dependence, identifying reuse and partition alignment as fundamental design mechanisms.

entry.title: Order Matters in Retrosynthesis: Structure-aware Generation via Reaction-Center-Guided Discrete Flow Matching

author.name: Chenguang Wang, Zihan Zhou, Lei Bai, Tianshu Yu

entry.summary: Proposes RetroDiT for retrosynthesis that exploits atom ordering in neural representations, placing reaction center atoms at sequence head to encode chemical knowledge as positional bias. Uses graph transformer with rotary position embeddings and discrete flow matching.

entry.title: Learning to Approximate Uniform Facility Location via Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Chendi Qian, Christopher Morris, Stefanie Jegelka, and Christian Sohler

entry.summary: Proposes using MPNNs to learn approximation algorithms for Uniform Facility Location, combining classical algorithm structure with neural network adaptability. Provides provable performance guarantees while exploiting input distribution structure.

entry.title: Asynchronous Verified Semantic Caching for Tiered LLM Architectures

author.name: Asmit Kumar Singh, Haozhe Wang, Laxmi Naga Santosh Attaluri, Tak Chiam, Weihua Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces Krites, an asynchronous LLM-judged semantic caching system for tiered LLM architectures that expands static cache coverage without changing serving decisions, using async verification to identify safe reuse opportunities.

entry.title: Realistic Face Reconstruction from Facial Embeddings via Diffusion Models

author.name: Dong Han, Yong Li, Joachim Denzler

entry.summary: Proposes using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for face reconstruction from embeddings of privacy-preserving face recognition systems via diffusion models, demonstrating that reconstructed faces can compromise other systems.

entry.title: Favia: Forensic Agent for Vulnerability-fix Identification and Analysis

author.name: Andr\'e Storhaug, Jiamou Sun, Jingyue Li

entry.summary: Proposes Favia, an agent-based framework for identifying vulnerability-fixing commits in large repositories, combining scalable candidate ranking with deep iterative analysis and uncovering that prior evaluations substantially underestimate real-world difficulty.

entry.title: ADEPT: RL-Aligned Agentic Decoding of Emotion via Evidence Probing Tools -- From Consensus Learning to Ambiguity-Driven Emotion Reasoning

author.name: Esther Sun, Bo-Hao Su, Abinay Reddy Naini, Shinji Watanabe, Carlos Busso

entry.summary: Introduces ADEPT, which reframes emotion recognition as a multi-turn agentic inquiry process where a Speech LLM iteratively invokes semantic and acoustic probing tools to build evidence-based emotion judgments, addressing ungrounded text-biased emotion predictions.

entry.title: LiDAR-Anchored Collaborative Distillation for Robust 2D Representations

author.name: Wonjun Jo, Hyunwoo Ha, Kim Ji-Yeon, Hawook Jeong, Tae-Hyun Oh

entry.summary: Proposes Collaborative Distillation, using 3D LiDAR as self-supervision to improve robustness of 2D image encoders under noisy and adverse weather conditions while retaining clear-weather capabilities.

entry.title: RGB-Only Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Unbounded Outdoor Scenes

author.name: Sicheng Yu, Chong Cheng, Yifan Zhou, Xiaojun Yang, Hao Wang

entry.summary: Presents OpenGS-SLAM, an RGB-only Gaussian Splatting SLAM method for unbounded outdoor scenes using pointmap regression instead of depth maps. Proposes end-to-end differentiable pose optimization with 3DGS rendering.

entry.title: OmniCustom: Sync Audio-Video Customization Via Joint Audio-Video Generation Model

author.name: Maomao Li, Zhen Li, Kaipeng Zhang, Guosheng Yin, Zhifeng Li, Dong Xu

entry.summary: Proposes OmniCustom for synchronized audio-video customization, generating videos that maintain identity from reference images while imitating timbre from reference audio. Uses DiT-based framework.

entry.title: Perceptual Self-Reflection in Agentic Physics Simulation Code Generation

author.name: Prashant Shende, Bradley Camburn

entry.summary: Presents a multi-agent framework for physics simulation code generation with perceptual self-reflection, using a vision-capable LM to validate rendered animations rather than inspecting code directly.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Adaptation to Robot Structural Damage via Natural Language-Informed Kinodynamics Modeling

author.name: Anuj Pokhrel, Aniket Datar, Mohammad Nazeri, Francesco Cancelliere, Xuesu Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes ZLIK, using natural language descriptions of structural damage grounded in kinodynamic behaviors via self-supervised learning, enabling zero-shot adaptation to novel robot structural damages.

entry.title: MiDAS: A Multimodal Data Acquisition System and Dataset for Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Surgery

author.name: Keshara Weerasinghe, Seyed Hamid Reza Roodabeh, Andrew Hawkins (MD), Zhaomeng Zhang, Zachary Schrader, Homa Alemzadeh

entry.summary: Presents MiDAS, an open-source, platform-agnostic system for time-synchronized multimodal data acquisition in robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery, validated on both open-source and clinical surgical platforms.

entry.title: Semantic-aware Adversarial Fine-tuning for CLIP

author.name: Jiacheng Zhang and Jinhao Li and Hanxun Huang and Sarah M. Erfani and Benjamin I.P. Rubinstein and Feng Liu

entry.summary: Proposes semantic-aware adversarial fine-tuning for CLIP, identifying that adversarial examples generated using simple cosine similarity may fail under semantically enriched similarity metrics, and introducing a semantic-aware approach to improve robustness.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Model-Based Reinforcement Learning with Joint State-Action Learned Embeddings

author.name: Zhizun Wang, David Meger

entry.summary: Presents a model-based multi-agent RL framework combining joint state-action representation learning (SALE) with imaginative rollouts through a world model trained with VAEs.

entry.title: PLLM: Pseudo-Labeling Large Language Models for CAD Program Synthesis

author.name: Yuanbo Li, Dule Shu, Yanying Chen, Matt Klenk, Daniel Ritchie

entry.summary: Introduces PLLM, a self-training framework for CAD program synthesis from unlabeled 3D shapes, iteratively sampling candidate programs, selecting high-fidelity ones, and augmenting for fine-tuning.

entry.title: Unbiased Gradient Estimation for Event Binning via Functional Backpropagation

author.name: Jinze Chen, Wei Zhai, Han Han, Tiankai Ma, Yang Cao, Bin Li, Zheng-Jun Zha

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for unbiased gradient estimation through discontinuous event binning functions in event-based vision, using weak derivatives during backpropagation while keeping the forward pass unchanged. This enables end-to-end learning from raw events without gradient truncation artifacts.

entry.title: GeoAgent: Learning to Geolocate Everywhere with Reinforced Geographic Characteristics

author.name: Modi Jin, Yiming Zhang, Boyuan Sun, Dingwen Zhang, MingMing Cheng, Qibin Hou

entry.summary: Presents GeoAgent, a geolocation model using reinforcement learning with expert-annotated chain-of-thought data (GeoSeek dataset) and geo-specific rewards. Introduces geo-similarity and consistency rewards that leverage geographic characteristics for training.

entry.title: Artic: AI-oriented Real-time Communication for MLLM Video Assistant

author.name: Jiangkai Wu, Zhiyuan Ren, Junquan Zhong, Liming Liu, Xinggong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Artic, an AI-oriented real-time communication framework designed for MLLM Video Assistants, addressing the mismatch between traditional RTC frameworks and AI video understanding needs. Shifts the paradigm from 'humans watching video' to 'AI understanding video'.

entry.title: PMG: Parameterized Motion Generator for Human-like Locomotion Control

author.name: Chenxi Han, Yuheng Min, Zihao Huang, Ao Hong, Hang Liu, Yi Cheng, Houde Liu

entry.summary: Proposes PMG, a Parameterized Motion Generator for humanoid locomotion that synthesizes reference trajectories from compact parameterized motion data and high-dimensional whole-body coordination, enabling real-time adaptive locomotion without large motion capture datasets.

entry.title: Lamer-SSL: Layer-aware Mixture of LoRA Experts for Continual Multilingual Expansion of Self-supervised Models without Forgetting

author.name: Jing Xu, Minglin Wu, Xueyuan Chen, Xixin Wu, Helen Meng

entry.summary: Already analyzed above (duplicate).

entry.title: Bootstrapping MLLM for Weakly-Supervised Class-Agnostic Object Counting

author.name: Xiaowen Zhang, Zijie Yue, Yong Luo, Cairong Zhao, Qijun Chen, and Miaojing Shi

entry.summary: Proposes WS-COC, the first MLLM-driven weakly-supervised framework for class-agnostic object counting using only image-level count supervision. Uses divide-and-discern dialogue tuning and other strategies to bridge the modality gap.

entry.title: Dual-Phase Cross-Modal Contrastive Learning for CMR-Guided ECG Representations for Cardiovascular Disease Assessment

author.name: Laura Alvarez-Florez, Angel Bujalance-Gomez, Femke Raijmakers, Samuel Ruiperez-Campillo, Maarten Z. H. Kolk, Jesse Wiers, Julia Vogt, Erik J. Bekkers, Ivana I\v{s}gum, Fleur V. Y. Tjong

entry.summary: Introduces a dual-phase contrastive learning framework that aligns ECG representations with 3D CMR volumes at end-diastole and end-systole to improve extraction of cardiac phenotypes from ECGs.

entry.title: Contextual Online Bilateral Trade

author.name: Romain Cosson, Federico Fusco, Anupam Gupta, Stefano Leonardi, Renato Paes Leme, and Matteo Russo

entry.summary: Studies contextual online bilateral trade with linear valuations, proving no-regret algorithms for gain-from-trade and profit objectives against the strong benchmark of best omniscient dynamic strategy, under two-bit feedback.

entry.title: Can we trust AI to detect healthy multilingual English speakers among the cognitively impaired cohort in the UK? An investigation using real-world conversational speech

author.name: Madhurananda Pahar, Caitlin Illingworth, Dorota Braun, Bahman Mirheidari, Lise Sproson, Daniel Blackburn, Heidi Christensen

entry.summary: Examines bias in AI models for detecting cognitive impairment from conversational speech across multilingual English speakers in the UK, focusing on ethnic minorities including Somali, Chinese, and South Asian language speakers.

entry.title: A Calibrated Memorization Index (MI) for Detecting Training Data Leakage in Generative MRI Models

author.name: Yash Deo, Yan Jia, Toni Lassila, Victoria J Hodge, Alejandro F Frang, Chenghao Qian, Siyuan Kang, Ibrahim Habli

entry.summary: Proposes a calibrated per-sample metric for detecting memorization and training data duplication in generative MRI models, using features from an MRI foundation model with multi-layer whitened nearest-neighbor similarities.

entry.title: AdaGrad-Diff: A New Version of the Adaptive Gradient Algorithm

author.name: Matia Bojovic, Saverio Salzo, Massimiliano Pontil

entry.summary: Proposes AdaGrad-Diff, an adaptive gradient method where adaptation is driven by cumulative squared gradient differences rather than gradient norms, avoiding unnecessary stepsize reduction when gradients are stable.

entry.title: Improved Regret Guarantees for Online Mirror Descent using a Portfolio of Mirror Maps

author.name: Swati Gupta, Jai Moondra, Mohit Singh

entry.summary: Proposes improved regret bounds for Online Mirror Descent using portfolios of mirror maps based on block norms that interpolate between L1 and L2 geometries, demonstrating polynomial gains over restricting to either geometry alone.

entry.title: Transformer-based CoVaR: Systemic Risk in Textual Information

author.name: Junyu Chen, Tom Boot, Lingwei Kong, Weining Wang

entry.summary: Develops a Transformer-based methodology integrating raw financial news text embeddings from LLMs with market data to improve Conditional Value-at-Risk (CoVaR) estimates for systemic risk, with explicit error bounds.

entry.title: MorphNLI: A Stepwise Approach to Natural Language Inference Using Text Morphing

author.name: Vlad Andrei Negru, Robert Vacareanu, Camelia Lemnaru, Mihai Surdeanu, Rodica Potolea

entry.summary: Introduces MorphNLI, a modular approach to natural language inference that incrementally transforms (morphs) the premise into the hypothesis using atomic edits, tracking entailment progression. Shows up to 12.6% relative improvement in cross-domain settings.

entry.title: Harnessing intuitive local evolution rules for physical learning

author.name: Roie Ezraty, Menachem Stern, Shmuel M. Rubinstein

entry.summary: Introduces BEASTAL, a training scheme for physical systems that learn by exploiting local physical rules for power dissipation minimization. Demonstrates autonomous learning for regression and classification without large-scale external control.

entry.title: Language-Guided Invariance Probing of Vision-Language Models

author.name: Jae Joong Lee

entry.summary: Introduces Language-Guided Invariance Probing (LGIP), a benchmark measuring VLMs' invariance to paraphrases and sensitivity to semantic flips in image-text matching. Tests nine models including CLIP variants on 40k MS COCO images.

entry.title: Deep Doubly Debiased Longitudinal Effect Estimation with ICE G-Computation

author.name: Wenxin Chen, Weishen Pan, Kyra Gan, Fei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes D3-Net for longitudinal treatment effect estimation using ICE G-computation with Sequential Doubly Robust pseudo-outcomes and multi-task Transformer, addressing error propagation in recursive structures.

entry.title: ZeroDiff++: Substantial Unseen Visual-semantic Correlation in Zero-shot Learning

author.name: Zihan Ye, Shreyank N Gowda, Kaile Du, Weijian Luo, Ling Shao

entry.summary: Identifies spurious visual-semantic correlations in generative zero-shot learning and proposes ZeroDiff++, a diffusion-based framework that enhances correlations for both seen and unseen classes through adaptive noise scheduling.

entry.title: Correctness, Artificial Intelligence, and the Epistemic Value of Mathematical Proof

author.name: James Owen Weatherall and Jesse Wolfson

entry.summary: Argues that formal correctness (formalizable in a proof system) is neither necessary nor sufficient for a mathematical proof to have epistemic value, with implications for automated theorem provers and AI applications in mathematics.

entry.title: Linear Regression with Unknown Truncation Beyond Gaussian Features

author.name: Alexandros Kouridakis, Anay Mehrotra, Alkis Kalavasis, Constantine Caramanis

entry.summary: Extends truncated linear regression to the setting where the survival set is unknown and features are non-Gaussian, providing computationally efficient algorithms that go beyond the Gaussianity assumptions of prior work.

entry.title: Monte Carlo Tree Search with Reasoning Path Refinement for Small Language Models in Conversational Text-to-NoSQL

author.name: Xubang Xiong, Raymond Chi-Wing Wong, Yuanfeng Song

entry.summary: Proposes Stage-MCTS, using Monte Carlo Tree Search with reasoning path refinement to enable small language models to generate NoSQL queries in conversational settings.

entry.title: Coden: Efficient Temporal Graph Neural Networks for Continuous Prediction

author.name: Zulun Zhu, Siqiang Luo

entry.summary: Introduces Coden, a temporal graph neural network designed for efficient continuous predictions on dynamic graphs, addressing the computational overhead of existing TGNNs when predictions need to be issued frequently over time.

entry.title: Uncovering spatial tissue domains and cell types in spatial omics through cross-scale profiling of cellular and genomic interactions

author.name: Rui Yan, Xiaohan Xing, Xun Wang, Zixia Zhou, Md Tauhidul Islam, Lei Xing

entry.summary: Presents CellScape, a deep learning framework for spatial transcriptomics that captures both spatial interactions and intrinsic genomic relationships to uncover tissue domains and cell types. Addresses the challenge of noisy, large-scale ST data.

entry.title: Motion Prior Distillation in Time Reversal Sampling for Generative Inbetweening

author.name: Wooseok Jeon, Seunghyun Shin, Dongmin Shin, Hae-Gon Jeon

entry.summary: Proposes Motion Prior Distillation (MPD) for generative inbetweening that addresses temporal discontinuities when using bidirectional I2V diffusion paths. Distills aligned motion priors during inference to reduce artifacts from misaligned forward/backward generation paths.

entry.title: A Regularization-Sharpness Tradeoff for Linear Interpolators

author.name: Qingyi Hu, Liam Hodgkinson

entry.summary: Proposes a regularization-sharpness tradeoff for overparameterized linear regression, decomposing the selection penalty into regularization alignment and geometric sharpness terms on the interpolating manifold.

entry.title: SignScene: Visual Sign Grounding for Mapless Navigation

author.name: Nicky Zimmerman, Joel Loo, Benjamin Koh, Zishuo Wang, David Hsu

entry.summary: Proposes SignScene for robot navigation using visual signs, formalizing sign grounding as mapping sign instructions to scene elements and navigational actions. Uses VLMs with a sign-centric spatial-semantic representation.

entry.title: Nonparametric Contextual Online Bilateral Trade

author.name: Emanuele Coccia, Martino Bernasconi, Andrea Celli

entry.summary: Extends contextual online bilateral trade to nonparametric settings where valuations are arbitrary Lipschitz functions of context, designing algorithms with regret bounds using hierarchical tree construction.

entry.title: Adding internal audio sensing to internal vision enables human-like in-hand fabric recognition with soft robotic fingertips

author.name: Iris Andrussow, Jans Solano, Benjamin A. Richardson, Georg Martius, Katherine J. Kuchenbecker

entry.summary: Combines internal camera-based tactile sensing with internal audio sensing in soft robotic fingertips to achieve human-like fabric recognition, investigating how each haptic modality contributes to perception.

entry.title: Beyond Benchmarks of IUGC: Rethinking Requirements of Deep Learning Methods for Intrapartum Ultrasound Biometry from Fetal Ultrasound Videos

author.name: Jieyun Bai, Zihao Zhou, Yitong Tang, Jie Gan, Zhuonan Liang, Jianan Fan, Lisa B. Mcguire, Jillian L. Clarke, Weidong Cai, Jacaueline Spurway, Yubo Tang, Shiye Wang, Wenda Shen, Wangwang Yu, Yihao Li, Philippe Zhang, Weili Jiang, Yongjie Li, Salem Muhsin Ali Binqahal Al Nasim, Arsen Abzhanov, Numan Saeed, Mohammad Yaqub, Zunhui Xian, Hongxing Lin, Libin Lan, Jayroop Ramesh, Valentin Bacher, Mark Eid, Hoda Kalabizadeh, Christian Rupprecht, Ana I. L. Namburete, Pak-Hei Yeung, Madeleine K. Wyburd, Nicola K. Dinsdale, Assanali Serikbey, Jiankai Li, Sung-Liang Chen, Zicheng Hu, Nana Liu, Yian Deng, Wei Hu, Cong Tan, Wenfeng Zhang, Mai Tuyet Nhi, Gregor Koehler, Rapheal Stock, Klaus Maier-Hein, Marawan Elbatel, Xiaomeng Li, Saad Slimani, Victor M. Campello, Benard Ohene-Botwe, Isaac Khobo, Yuxin Huang, Zhenyan Han, Hongying Hou, Di Qiu, Zheng Zheng, Gongning Luo, Dong Ni, Yaosheng Lu, Karim Lekadir, and Shuo Li

entry.summary: Reports on the IUGC challenge for intrapartum ultrasound biometry, introducing a multi-task framework integrating standard plane classification, segmentation, and biometry. Addresses the critical problem of maternal/neonatal deaths from inadequate monitoring.

entry.title: MASAR: Motion-Appearance Synergy Refinement for Joint Detection and Trajectory Forecasting

author.name: Mohammed Amine Bencheikh Lehocine, Julian Schmidt, Frank Moosmann, Dikshant Gupta, Fabian Flohr

entry.summary: Proposes MASAR, a differentiable framework for joint 3D detection and trajectory forecasting that combines appearance and motion features via object-centric spatio-temporal encoding and past trajectory prediction.

entry.title: TCRL: Temporal-Coupled Adversarial Training for Robust Constrained Reinforcement Learning in Worst-Case Scenarios

author.name: Wentao Xu and Zhongming Yao and Weihao Li and Zhenghang Song and Yumeng Song and Tianyi Li and Yushuai Li

entry.summary: Proposes TCRL, a temporal-coupled adversarial training framework for robust constrained reinforcement learning that models robustness against temporally correlated perturbations rather than independent single-step attacks.

entry.title: TraceBack: Multi-Agent Decomposition for Fine-Grained Table Attribution

author.name: Tejas Anvekar and Junha Park and Rajat Jha and Devanshu Gupta and Poojah Ganesan and Puneeth Mathur and Vivek Gupta

entry.summary: Presents TraceBack, a multi-agent framework for cell-level attribution in table QA that decomposes questions into sub-questions and aligns answers with supporting cells. Includes CITEBench benchmark for evaluation.

entry.title: Unified Multi-Domain Graph Pre-training for Homogeneous and Heterogeneous Graphs via Domain-Specific Expert Encoding

author.name: Chundong Liang, Yongqi Huang, Dongxiao He, Peiyuan Li, Yawen Li, Di Jin, Weixiong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a unified multi-domain graph pre-training method that works across both homogeneous and heterogeneous graphs using domain-specific expert encoding, addressing distribution shifts between pre-training and deployment.
