entry.title: In-Context Autonomous Network Incident Response: An End-to-End Large Language Model Agent Approach

author.name: Yiran Gao, Kim Hammar, and Tao Li

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-based agent for autonomous network incident response that integrates perception, reasoning, planning, and action in a single 14B model, fine-tuned with RL on system logs and alerts.

entry.title: Learning functional components of PDEs from data using neural networks

author.name: Torkel E. Loman, Yurij Salmaniw, Antonio Leon Villares, Jose A. Carrillo, Ruth E. Baker

entry.summary: Shows how neural networks embedded in PDEs can recover unknown functional components from data, demonstrated on nonlocal aggregation-diffusion equations for recovering interaction kernels and external potentials from steady-state observations.

entry.title: Profiling systematic uncertainties in Simulation-Based Inference with Factorizable Normalizing Flows

author.name: Davide Valsecchi, Mauro Doneg\`a, Rainer Wallny

entry.summary: Proposes Factorizable Normalizing Flows for simulation-based inference in particle physics that efficiently profile nuisance parameters while measuring multivariate distributions of interest, modeling systematic variations as parametric density deformations.

entry.title: Dom, cars don't fly! -- Or do they? In-Air Vehicle Maneuver for High-Speed Off-Road Navigation

author.name: Anuj Pokhrel, Aniket Datar, Xuesu Xiao

entry.summary: Presents a novel approach for in-air vehicle maneuver during high-speed off-road navigation, using a hybrid physics+ML kinodynamic model and sampling-based motion planner to ensure accurate landing after becoming airborne.

entry.title: Incremental Language Understanding for Online Motion Planning of Robot Manipulators

author.name: Mitchell Abrams, Thies Oelerich, Christian Hartl-Nesic, Andreas Kugi, Matthias Scheutz

entry.summary: Introduces a reasoning-based incremental language parser integrated with online motion planning for robot manipulators, enabling continuous adaptation to dynamic speech input without stopping and replanning.

entry.title: AgenticShop: Benchmarking Agentic Product Curation for Personalized Web Shopping

author.name: Sunghwan Kim, Ryang Heo, Yongsik Seo, Jinyoung Yeo, Dongha Lee

entry.summary: Introduces AgenticShop, a benchmark for evaluating agentic systems on product curation in open-web shopping settings, covering exploratory search and personalization beyond single-platform lookups.

entry.title: Schur-MI: Fast Mutual Information for Robotic Information Gathering

author.name: Kalvik Jakkala and Jason O'Kane and Srinivas Akella

entry.summary: Presents Schur-MI, a computationally efficient mutual information formulation for robotic information gathering that reduces per-evaluation cost from O(|V|³) to O(|A|³) using Schur-complement factorization.

entry.title: Variational Green's Functions for Volumetric PDEs

author.name: Joao Teixeira, Eitan Grinspun, Otman Benchekroun

entry.summary: Presents Variational Green's Functions (VGF), learning smooth differentiable representations of Green's functions for linear self-adjoint PDEs by decomposing into analytic free-space and learned corrector components.

entry.title: Policy4OOD: A Knowledge-Guided World Model for Policy Intervention Simulation against the Opioid Overdose Crisis

author.name: Yijun Ma, Zehong Wang, Weixiang Sun, Zheyuan Zhang, Kaiwen Shi, Nitesh Chawla, Yanfang Ye

entry.summary: Proposes Policy4OOD, a knowledge-guided spatio-temporal world model for simulating opioid policy interventions. Unifies forecasting, counterfactual reasoning, and optimization for policy evaluation.

entry.title: Synthetic Image Detection with CLIP: Understanding and Assessing Predictive Cues

author.name: Marco Willi, Melanie Mathys, Michael Graber

entry.summary: Investigates what CLIP features capture for synthetic image detection, analyzing whether detectors exploit visual artifacts or semantic biases. Finds CLIP-based SID shows promising but imperfect generalization.

entry.title: CacheMind: From Miss Rates to Why -- Natural-Language, Trace-Grounded Reasoning for Cache Replacement

author.name: Kaushal Mhapsekar, Azam Ghanbari, Bita Aslrousta, Samira Mirbagher-Ajorpaz

entry.summary: Introduces CacheMind, a conversational tool using RAG and LLMs to enable natural language semantic reasoning over CPU cache traces, allowing architects to ask questions about cache behavior and receive trace-grounded explanations.

entry.title: Not a Silver Bullet for Loneliness: How Attachment and Age Shape Intimacy with AI Companions

author.name: Raffaele Ciriello, Uri Gal, Ofir Turel

entry.summary: Studies how attachment style and age moderate the relationship between loneliness and intimacy with AI companions, finding that loneliness paradoxically reduces intimacy for securely attached users.

entry.title: Self-EvolveRec: Self-Evolving Recommender Systems with LLM-based Directional Feedback

author.name: Sein Kim, Sangwu Park, Hongseok Kang, Wonjoong Kim, Jimin Seo, Yeonjun In, Kanghoon Yoon, Chanyoung Park

entry.summary: Proposes Self-EvolveRec, a framework for automated recommender system design that uses LLMs with a directional feedback loop incorporating a User Simulator for qualitative critiques and a Model Diagnosis Tool for quantitative verification, going beyond scalar metrics.

entry.title: IndicFairFace: Balanced Indian Face Dataset for Auditing and Mitigating Geographical Bias in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Aarish Shah Mohsin, Mohammed Tayyab Ilyas Khan, Mohammad Nadeem, Shahab Saquib Sohail, Erik Cambria and Jiechao Gao

entry.summary: Introduces IndicFairFace, a balanced face dataset of 14,400 images representing geographical diversity across India's states and territories, addressing the treatment of Indian faces as a monolithic category in existing fairness datasets.

entry.title: Fool Me If You Can: On the Robustness of Binary Code Similarity Detection Models against Semantics-preserving Transformations

author.name: Jiyong Uhm, Minseok Kim, Michalis Polychronakis, Hyungjoon Koo

entry.summary: Evaluates the robustness of deep learning models for binary code similarity detection under semantics-preserving adversarial transformations at the binary level. Reveals vulnerabilities in current BCSD models to code transformations that preserve program behavior.

entry.title: Mixture of Predefined Experts: Maximizing Data Usage on Vertical Federated Learning

author.name: Jon Irureta, Gorka Azkune, Jon Imaz, Aizea Lojo, Javier Fernandez-Marques

entry.summary: Introduces Split-MoPE for vertical federated learning, using predefined (not learned) expert routing to handle partial sample alignment between participants, maximizing data usage during training and inference without requiring full sample overlap.

entry.title: TRANS: Terrain-aware Reinforcement Learning for Agile Navigation of Quadruped Robots under Social Interactions

author.name: Wei Zhu, Irfan Tito Kurniawan, Ye Zhao, and Mistuhiro Hayashibe

entry.summary: Presents TRANS, a deep RL framework for quadrupedal social navigation over unstructured terrains, using a two-stage training framework with three DRL pipelines for locomotion, terrain awareness, and social interaction.

entry.title: SQuTR: A Robustness Benchmark for Spoken Query to Text Retrieval under Acoustic Noise

author.name: Yuejie Li, Ke Yang, Yueying Hua, Berlin Chen, Jianhao Nie, Yueping He, Caixin Kang

entry.summary: Presents SQuTR, a robustness benchmark for spoken query retrieval under acoustic noise, with 37K queries across English and Chinese, 200 speaker profiles, and 17 noise categories. Provides a unified evaluation protocol for assessing retrieval robustness.

entry.title: When Words Don't Mean What They Say: Figurative Understanding in Bengali Idioms

author.name: Adib Sakhawat, Shamim Ara Parveen, Md Ruhul Amin, Shamim Al Mahmud, Md Saiful Islam, Tahera Khatun

entry.summary: Introduces a large-scale Bengali idiom dataset with 10,361 entries annotated under a 19-field schema, evaluating 30 LLMs on figurative meaning inference. Reveals critical performance gaps in low-resource figurative language understanding.

entry.title: Extending confidence calibration to generalised measures of variation

author.name: Andrew Thompson, Vivek Desai

entry.summary: Proposes the Variation Calibration Error (VCE) metric extending ECE to assess calibration of any variation metric (e.g., Shannon entropy) rather than just maximum probability, using the full probability distribution.

entry.title: Backdoor Attacks on Contrastive Continual Learning for IoT Systems

author.name: Alfous Tim, Kuniyilh Simi D

entry.summary: Studies backdoor attacks on contrastive continual learning in IoT systems, showing how adversaries can exploit embedding alignment and replay reinforcement to implant persistent malicious behaviors that survive model updates.

entry.title: Bus-Conditioned Zero-Shot Trajectory Generation via Task Arithmetic

author.name: Shuai Liu, Ning Cao, Yile Chen, Yue Jiang, Gao Cong

entry.summary: Proposes bus-conditioned zero-shot trajectory generation using task arithmetic to transfer mobility patterns from source to target cities using only publicly available bus timetables, without requiring any mobility data from the target city.

entry.title: SENSE-STEP: Learning Sim-to-Real Locomotion for a Sensory-Enabled Soft Quadruped Robot

author.name: Storm de Kam, Ebrahim Shahabi, Cosimo Della Santina

entry.summary: Presents a sim-to-real learning framework for a pneumatically actuated soft quadruped robot with tactile suction-cup feet, using staged training in simulation and validating on physical hardware.

entry.title: Universal Transformation of One-Class Classifiers for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection

author.name: Declan McIntosh and Alexandra Branzan Albu

entry.summary: Presents a dataset folding method that transforms any one-class classifier-based anomaly detector into a fully unsupervised method by leveraging assumptions about anomaly rarity and heterogeneity to filter training label noise.

entry.title: Operator Learning for Families of Finite-State Mean-Field Games

author.name: William Hofgard, Asaf Cohen, Mathieu Lauri\`ere

entry.summary: Proposes an operator learning framework for solving parametric families of finite-state mean-field games, enabling generalization to new initial distributions and terminal costs without retraining, with theoretical approximation guarantees.

entry.title: From Leiden to Pleasure Island: The Constant Potts Model for Community Detection as a Hedonic Game

author.name: Lucas Lopes Felipe and Konstantin Avrachenkov and Daniel Sadoc Menasche

entry.summary: Presents a game-theoretic perspective on the Constant Potts Model for community detection, proving convergence of local optimization in pseudo-polynomial time and introducing stability criteria. Demonstrates strong performance on large networks.

entry.title: Timing Is Everything: Finding the Optimal Fusion Points in Multimodal Medical Imaging

author.name: Valerio Guarrasi, Klara Mogensen, Sara Tassinari, Sara Qvarlander, Paolo Soda

entry.summary: Proposes a sequential forward search algorithm to find optimal fusion points in multimodal medical imaging networks, incrementally activating and evaluating candidate fusion modules at different layers.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Self-Taught Reasoning Model with Adaptive Chain-of-Thought for ASR Named Entity Correction

author.name: Junjie An, Jingguang Tian, Tianyi Wang, Yu Gao, Xiaofeng Mou, Yi Xu

entry.summary: Proposes A-STAR, a retrieval-augmented framework for correcting named entity errors in ASR using a self-taught reasoning model with adaptive chain-of-thought. Combines phonetic-level retrieval with LLM reasoning capabilities.

entry.title: Value Bonuses using Ensemble Errors for Exploration in Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Abdul Wahab, Raksha Kumaraswamy, Martha White

entry.summary: Introduces Value Bonuses with Ensemble errors (VBE) for exploration in RL, using ensemble of random action-value functions to encourage visiting unvisited states, addressing a limitation of reward-bonus approaches.

entry.title: Evolving Beyond Snapshots: Harmonizing Structure and Sequence via Entity State Tuning for Temporal Knowledge Graph Forecasting

author.name: Siyuan Li and Yunjia Wu, Yiyong Xiao, Pingyang Huang, Peize Li, Ruitong Liu, Yan Wen, Te Sun, and Fangyi Pei

entry.summary: Proposes Entity State Tuning (EST) for temporal knowledge graph forecasting, maintaining persistent entity states that evolve across timestamps rather than recomputing representations each step.

entry.title: High-dimensional Level Set Estimation with Trust Regions and Double Acquisition Functions

author.name: Giang Ngo, Dat Phan Trong, Dang Nguyen, Sunil Gupta

entry.summary: Proposes TRLSE, an algorithm for high-dimensional level set estimation using trust regions and dual acquisition functions operating at global and local levels. Addresses the curse of dimensionality in active learning settings with limited initial data.

entry.title: An Autonomous, End-to-End, Convex-Based Framework for Close-Range Rendezvous Trajectory Design and Guidance with Hardware Testbed Validation

author.name: Minduli C. Wijayatunga, Julian Guinane, Nathan D. Wallace, Xiaofeng Wu

entry.summary: Presents CORTEX, an autonomous trajectory design framework for satellite close-range rendezvous that integrates deep learning perception with convex optimization, including abort-to-safe-orbit recovery logic, validated in hardware-in-the-loop experiments.

entry.title: Computationally sufficient statistics for Ising models

author.name: Abhijith Jayakumar, Shreya Shukla, Marc Vuffray, Andrey Y. Lokhov, Sidhant Misra

entry.summary: Studies the trade-offs between computational power and observation in learning Ising models from sufficient statistics, demonstrating feasible parameter reconstruction with limited statistics under certain conditions.

entry.title: Geometric separation and constructive universal approximation with two hidden layers

author.name: Chanyoung Sung

entry.summary: Gives a geometric construction of neural networks that separate disjoint compact sets, yielding a constructive universal approximation theorem for networks with two hidden layers using sigmoidal or ReLU activations.

entry.title: Gradient-Enhanced Partitioned Gaussian Processes for Real-Time Quadrotor Dynamics Modeling

author.name: Xinhuan Sang, Adam Rozman, Sheryl Grace and Roberto Tron

entry.summary: Presents a gradient-enhanced partitioned Gaussian process for real-time quadrotor dynamics modeling, using state-space partitioning and Schur complement approximations to achieve real-time inference.

entry.title: Discovering Semantic Latent Structures in Psychological Scales: A Response-Free Pathway to Efficient Simplification

author.name: Bo Wang, Yuxuan Zhang, Yueqin Hu, Hanchao Hou, Kaiping Peng, Shiguang Ni

entry.summary: Introduces a topic-modeling framework for psychological scale simplification using contextual sentence embeddings and density-based clustering to discover latent semantic factors without response data.

entry.title: RQ-GMM: Residual Quantized Gaussian Mixture Model for Multimodal Semantic Discretization in CTR Prediction

author.name: Ziye Tong, Jiahao Liu, Weimin Zhang, Hongji Ruan, Derick Tang, Zhanpeng Zeng, Qinsong Zeng, Peng Zhang, Tun Lu, Ning Gu

entry.summary: Introduces RQ-GMM, a method combining Gaussian Mixture Models with residual quantization to discretize multimodal embeddings into semantic IDs for click-through rate prediction. Addresses codebook utilization and reconstruction accuracy issues in existing discretization methods.

entry.title: CBEN -- A Multimodal Machine Learning Dataset for Cloud Robust Remote Sensing Image Understanding

author.name: Marco Stricker, Masakazu Iwamura, Koichi Kise

entry.summary: Introduces CBEN, a multimodal dataset combining optical satellite imagery with radar data for cloud-robust remote sensing, addressing the limitation that most ML methods exclude cloudy images entirely.

entry.title: QTabGAN: A Hybrid Quantum-Classical GAN for Tabular Data Synthesis

author.name: Subhangi Kumari, Rakesh Achutha, Vignesh Sivaraman

entry.summary: Introduces QTabGAN, a hybrid quantum-classical GAN for tabular data synthesis that uses quantum circuits to learn complex distributions, claiming up to 54% improvement on classification datasets compared to classical generative models.

entry.title: ReBA-Pred-Net: Weakly-Supervised Regional Brain Age Prediction on MRI

author.name: Shuai Shao, Yan Wang, Shu Jiang, Shiyuan Zhao, Xinzhe Luo, Di Yang, Jiangtao Wang, Yutong Bai, Jianguo Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ReBA-Pred-Net, a Teacher-Student framework for regional brain age prediction from MRI, using weakly-supervised learning with clinical-prior consistency constraints to estimate fine-grained brain aging patterns.

entry.title: Towards a Diagnostic and Predictive Evaluation Methodology for Sequence Labeling Tasks

author.name: Elena Alvarez-Mellado, Julio Gonzalo

entry.summary: Proposes an evaluation methodology for sequence labeling that uses handcrafted linguistically-motivated test sets covering span attributes exhaustively, enabling both diagnostic insights and cross-distribution performance prediction.

entry.title: GSM-GS: Geometry-Constrained Single and Multi-view Gaussian Splatting for Surface Reconstruction

author.name: Xiao Ren, Yu Liu, Ning An, Jian Cheng, Xin Qiao, and He Kong

entry.summary: Proposes GSM-GS, a framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting surface reconstruction that integrates single-view adaptive sub-region weighting with multi-view spatial structure refinement to improve reconstruction of complex surface microstructures.

entry.title: WISE: A Multimodal Search Engine for Visual Scenes, Audio, Objects, Faces, Speech, and Metadata

author.name: Prasanna Sridhar, Horace Lee, David M. S. Pinto, Andrew Zisserman and Abhishek Dutta

entry.summary: Presents WISE, an open-source multimodal search engine integrating scene-level and object-level visual search, face search, audio retrieval, speech transcription search, and metadata filtering into a single practical tool.

entry.title: Reliable Hierarchical Operating System Fingerprinting via Conformal Prediction

author.name: Rub\'en P\'erez-Jove, Osvaldo Simeone, Alejandro Pazos, Jose V\'azquez-Naya

entry.summary: Introduces structured conformal prediction strategies for hierarchical OS fingerprinting, comparing level-wise and projection-based approaches that respect the taxonomic structure of operating systems while providing formal coverage guarantees.

entry.title: Chimera: Neuro-Symbolic Attention Primitives for Trustworthy Dataplane Intelligence

author.name: Rong Fu, Wenxin Zhang, Xiaowen Ma, Kun Liu, Wangyu Wu, Ziyu Kong, Jia Yee Tan, Tailong Luo, Xianda Li, Zeli Su, Youjin Wang, Yongtai Liu, Simon Fong

entry.summary: Introduces Chimera, a neuro-symbolic framework mapping attention-based neural computations onto programmable dataplane primitives for line-rate, trustworthy network traffic analysis with symbolic safety guarantees.

entry.title: Ultrasound-Guided Real-Time Spinal Motion Visualization for Spinal Instability Assessment

author.name: Feng Li, Yuan Bi, Tianyu Song, Zhongliang Jiang, Nassir Navab

entry.summary: Proposes ultrasound-guided real-time 3D spinal motion visualization by registering partially compounded ultrasound volumes to preoperative 3D images, enabling radiation-free spinal instability assessment.

entry.title: EPRBench: A High-Quality Benchmark Dataset for Event Stream Based Visual Place Recognition

author.name: Xiao Wang, Xingxing Xiong, Jinfeng Gao, Xufeng Lou, Bo Jiang, Si-bao Chen, Yaowei Wang, Yonghong Tian

entry.summary: Introduces EPRBench, a high-quality benchmark for event camera-based visual place recognition with 10K event sequences and 65K frames, including LLM-generated scene descriptions for language-integrated VPR research.

entry.title: RGAlign-Rec: Ranking-Guided Alignment for Latent Query Reasoning in Recommendation Systems

author.name: Junhua Liu, Yang Jihao, Cheng Chang, Kunrong LI, Bin Fu, Kwan Hui Lim

entry.summary: Proposes RGAlign-Rec, a framework integrating LLM-based semantic reasoning with ranking models for proactive intent prediction in e-commerce chatbots, using ranking-guided alignment to bridge semantic and ranking gaps.

entry.title: Statistical Opportunities in Neuroimaging

author.name: Jian Kang, Thomas Nichols, Lexin Li, Martin A. Lindquist, and Hongtu Zhu

entry.summary: Reviews statistical opportunities and challenges in neuroimaging across brain development, disorders, large-scale studies, and multimodal integration, covering MRI, fMRI, EEG, and PET modalities.

entry.title: Multimodal Classification via Total Correlation Maximization

author.name: Feng Yu, Xiangyu Wu, Yang Yang, Jianfeng Lu

entry.summary: Proposes a multimodal classification method that maximizes total correlation between multimodal features and labels from an information-theoretic perspective, addressing the modality competition problem where joint learning underperforms unimodal learning.

entry.title: DynaGuide: A Generalizable Dynamic Guidance Framework for Unsupervised Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Boujemaa Guermazi and Riadh Ksantini and Naimul Khan

entry.summary: Introduces DynaGuide, an adaptive framework for unsupervised semantic segmentation that combines global pseudo-labels from zero-shot models with local boundary refinement via a lightweight CNN, using dynamic loss optimization.

entry.title: FedHENet: A Frugal Federated Learning Framework for Heterogeneous Environments

author.name: Alejandro Dopico-Castro, Oscar Fontenla-Romero, Bertha Guijarro-Berdi\~nas, Amparo Alonso-Betanzos and Iv\'an P\'erez Dig\'on

entry.summary: Proposes FedHENet, a federated learning framework for image classification that uses a fixed pre-trained feature extractor and learns only a single output layer, aggregated analytically in one communication round using homomorphic encryption.

entry.title: SIEFormer: Spectral-Interpretable and -Enhanced Transformer for Generalized Category Discovery

author.name: Chunming Li, Shidong Wang, Tong Xin, and Haofeng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes SIEFormer, a Vision Transformer that leverages spectral analysis to reinterpret attention mechanisms for Generalized Category Discovery, using implicit and explicit spectral branches with band-adaptive filtering.

entry.title: Differentially Private Two-Stage Empirical Risk Minimization and Applications to Individualized Treatment Rule

author.name: Joowon Lee and Guanhua Chen

entry.summary: Proposes a unified differentially private two-stage empirical risk minimization framework for individualized treatment rules, addressing the challenge of privatizing data-dependent weights computed for distributional constraints.

entry.title: Can Foundation Models Really Segment Tumors? A Benchmarking Odyssey in Lung CT Imaging

author.name: Elena Mulero Ayll\'on, Massimiliano Mantegna, Linlin Shen, Paolo Soda, Valerio Guarrasi, Matteo Tortora

entry.summary: Benchmarks deep learning segmentation models for lung tumor segmentation, comparing traditional (U-Net, DeepLabV3), self-configuring (nnUNet), and foundation models (MedSAM, MedSAM 2). Evaluates few-shot and fine-tuning paradigms.

entry.title: Hi-SAM: A Hierarchical Structure-Aware Multi-modal Framework for Large-Scale Recommendation

author.name: Pingjun Pan, Tingting Zhou, Peiyao Lu, Tingting Fei, Hongxiang Chen, Chuanjiang Luo

entry.summary: Proposes Hi-SAM, a hierarchical structure-aware framework for multi-modal recommendation using disentangled semantic tokenization and hierarchical attention to handle the complexity of multi-modal item representations.

entry.title: Towards reconstructing experimental sparse-view X-ray CT data with diffusion models

author.name: Nelas J. Thomsen, Xinyuan Wang, Felix Lucka, Ezgi Demircan-Tureyen

entry.summary: Studies diffusion-based priors for sparse-view X-ray CT reconstruction using experimental data, investigating the effects of domain shift between synthetic training data and real physical phantom measurements.

entry.title: Model-Aware Rate-Distortion Limits for Task-Oriented Source Coding

author.name: Andriy Enttsel, Vincent Corlay

entry.summary: Revisits rate-distortion theory for task-oriented source coding, introducing model-aware bounds that account for task model suboptimality and architecture constraints, unlike existing bounds that assume ideal task models.

entry.title: Quantization-Aware Collaborative Inference for Large Embodied AI Models

author.name: Zhonghao Lyu, Ming Xiao, Mikael Skoglund, Merouane Debbah, H. Vincent Poor

entry.summary: Investigates quantization-aware collaborative inference for large AI models on resource-limited embodied agents, deriving bounds on quantization rate-inference distortion and formulating joint optimization of bit-width and computation frequency.

entry.title: Zero-shot Bias Correction: Efficient MR Image Inhomogeneity Reduction Without Any Data

author.name: Hongxu Yang, Edina Timko, Brice Fernandez

entry.summary: Demonstrates a zero-shot deep learning approach for MRI bias field correction that requires no training data and no assumptions about the bias field. Uses a lightweight CNN with iterative homogeneity refinement for stable convergence.

entry.title: Any-to-Any Vision-Language Model for Multimodal X-ray Imaging and Radiological Report Generation

author.name: Daniele Molino, Francesco di Feola, Linlin Shen, Paolo Soda, Valerio Guarrasi

entry.summary: Introduces an any-to-any vision-language framework for generating multi-view chest X-rays and associated clinical reports. Bridges general-purpose VLMs with healthcare-specific requirements using the MIMIC-CXR dataset.

entry.title: A Machine Learning Approach to the Nirenberg Problem

author.name: Gianfranco Cort\'es, Maria Esteban-Casadevall, Yueqing Feng, Jonas Henkel, Edward Hirst, Tancredi Schettini Gherardini, Alexander G. Stapleton

entry.summary: Introduces Nirenberg Neural Network, a PINN approach to the Nirenberg problem of prescribing Gaussian curvature on S². Uses geometry-aware loss and spherical harmonic analysis for interpretability.

entry.title: Tight Bounds for Logistic Regression with Large Stepsize Gradient Descent in Low Dimension

author.name: Michael Crawshaw, Mingrui Liu

entry.summary: Provides tighter analysis of gradient descent for logistic regression with separable data in 2D, showing an improved convergence rate with large step sizes and tight lower bounds.

entry.title: Task- and Metric-Specific Signal Quality Indices for Medical Time Series

author.name: Jad Haidamous, Christoph Hoog Antink

entry.summary: Formalizes signal quality as task- and metric-dependent for medical time series and proposes a perturbation-based signal quality index that accounts for the specific downstream algorithm and performance metric.

entry.title: Eva-Tracker: ESDF-update-free, Visibility-aware Planning with Target Reacquisition for Robust Aerial Tracking

author.name: Yue Lin, Yang Liu, Dong Wang, Huchuan Lu

entry.summary: Proposes Eva-Tracker, a visibility-aware trajectory planning framework for aerial tracking that eliminates ESDF updates and includes recovery-capable path generation for target reacquisition.

entry.title: Power Interpretable Causal ODE Networks: A Unified Model for Explainable Anomaly Detection and Root Cause Analysis in Power Systems

author.name: Yue Sun, Likai Wang, Rick S. Blum, Parv Venkitasubramaniam

entry.summary: Proposes PICODE Networks, a causality-informed architecture that jointly performs anomaly detection, root cause localization, anomaly type classification, and anomaly shape characterization in power systems using ODEs. Aims to move beyond black-box anomaly detection toward interpretable, unified models.

entry.title: SPRig: Self-Supervised Pose-Invariant Rigging from Mesh Sequences

author.name: Ruipeng Wang, Langkun Zhong, Miaowei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes SPRig, a self-supervised framework for pose-invariant rigging from mesh sequences that enforces cross-frame consistency losses, addressing the failure of existing methods that assume canonical rest poses.

entry.title: X-SYS: A Reference Architecture for Interactive Explanation Systems

author.name: Tobias Labarta, Nhi Hoang, Maximilian Dreyer, Jim Berend, Oleg Hein, Jackie Ma, Wojciech Samek, Sebastian Lapuschkin

entry.summary: Introduces X-SYS, a reference architecture for interactive explanation systems that treats XAI as an information systems problem. Provides guidance for connecting explanation user interfaces with system capabilities under governance constraints.

entry.title: Deep-Learning Atlas Registration for Melanoma Brain Metastases: Preserving Pathology While Enabling Cohort-Level Analyses

author.name: Nanna E. Wielenberg, Ilinca Popp, Oliver Blanck, Lucas Zander, Jan C. Peeken, Stephanie E. Combs, Anca-Ligia Grosu, Dimos Baltas, Tobias Fechter

entry.summary: Proposes a deep learning registration framework for aligning pathological brains with melanoma metastases to a common atlas, handling missing correspondences through distance-transformed labels and volume-preserving regularization.

entry.title: Geometric Manifold Rectification for Imbalanced Learning

author.name: Xubin Wang, Qing Li, Weijia Jia

entry.summary: Proposes Geometric Manifold Rectification (GMR) for imbalanced classification in tabular data, using local geometric priors to address majority class intrusion into minority manifold regions. Introduces asymmetric cleaning and curvature-aware voting.

entry.title: A Data-Driven Algorithm for Model-Free Control Synthesis

author.name: Sean Bowerfind, Matthew R. Kirchner, Gary Hewer

entry.summary: Presents a data-driven algorithm for optimal LQR controller synthesis that requires no knowledge of system dynamics, using only input-output data. Includes real aircraft validation.

entry.title: BoundMPC: Cartesian Trajectory Planning with Error Bounds based on Model Predictive Control in the Joint Space

author.name: Thies Oelerich, Florian Beck, Christian Hartl-Nesic, Andreas Kugi

entry.summary: Presents BoundMPC, an online model-predictive trajectory planner for robot manipulators that follows Cartesian reference paths within asymmetric error bounds. Extends path-following decomposition to orientation using Lie theory of rotations.

entry.title: Augmented Intelligence for Multimodal Virtual Biopsy in Breast Cancer Using Generative Artificial Intelligence

author.name: Aurora Rofena, Claudia Lucia Piccolo, Bruno Beomonte Zobel, Paolo Soda, Valerio Guarrasi

entry.summary: Introduces a multimodal deep learning framework for virtual biopsy in breast cancer, generating synthetic CESM-like information from standard mammography (FFDM) to avoid invasive procedures. Uses generative AI to bridge modality gaps.

entry.title: BoundPlanner: A convex-set-based approach to bounded manipulator trajectory planning

author.name: Thies Oelerich, Christian Hartl-Nesic, Florian Beck, Andreas Kugi

entry.summary: Proposes BoundPlanner, a trajectory planning framework using convex sets to compute collision-free reference paths with bounds for robot manipulators, combined with the BoundMPC online trajectory planner for real-time execution.

entry.title: Evaluating Vision Language Model Adaptations for Radiology Report Generation in Low-Resource Languages

author.name: Marco Salm\`e, Rosa Sicilia, Paolo Soda, Valerio Guarrasi

entry.summary: Benchmarks instruction-tuned vision-language models for radiology report generation in low-resource languages (Italian, German, Spanish). Evaluates LLaVA-based models with various pre-training strategies.

entry.title: Online Fine-Tuning of Carbon Emission Predictions using Real-Time Recurrent Learning for State Space Models

author.name: Julian Lemmel, Manuel Kranzl, Adam Lamine, Philipp Neubauer, Radu Grosu, Sophie Neubauer

entry.summary: Proposes online fine-tuning of structured state space models at inference time using real-time recurrent learning, applied to carbon emission prediction from embedded automotive hardware.

entry.title: A Lightweight LLM Framework for Disaster Humanitarian Information Classification

author.name: Han Jinzhen, Kim Jisung, Yang Jong Soo, Yun Hong Sik

entry.summary: Develops a lightweight framework for disaster tweet classification using parameter-efficient fine-tuning of Llama 3.1 8B. Compares LoRA, RAG, and prompting strategies on the HumAID dataset for humanitarian information categorization.

entry.title: Energy-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation of Articulated Components in Infrastructure Operation and Maintenance

author.name: Xiaowen Tao, Yinuo Wang, Haitao Ding, Yuanyang Qi, Ziyu Song

entry.summary: Proposes an energy-aware reinforcement learning framework for robotic manipulation of articulated infrastructure components (doors, valves, drawers), incorporating explicit actuation energy into multi-objective optimization.

entry.title: Beyond Musical Descriptors: Extracting Preference-Bearing Intent in Music Queries

author.name: Marion Baranes, Romain Hennequin, Elena V. Epure

entry.summary: Introduces MusicRecoIntent, a manually annotated corpus of 2,291 Reddit music requests with labeled musical descriptors and preference-bearing roles, and evaluates LLMs on extracting these descriptors.

entry.title: A Theoretical Framework for Adaptive Utility-Weighted Benchmarking

author.name: Philip Waggoner

entry.summary: Introduces a theoretical framework for adaptive utility-weighted benchmarking that incorporates stakeholder priorities and sociotechnical contexts into AI evaluation, moving beyond standard metric-based leaderboards.

entry.title: Control Barrier Functions with Audio Risk Awareness for Robot Safe Navigation on Construction Sites

author.name: Johannes Mootz and Reza Akhavian

entry.summary: Proposes using audio cues (specifically jackhammer detection) to modulate safety margins in control barrier functions for robot navigation on construction sites, addressing the limitation of purely visual perception in occluded environments.

entry.title: Intent-Driven Smart Manufacturing Integrating Knowledge Graphs and Large Language Models

author.name: Takoua Jradi, John Violos, Dimitrios Spatharakis, Lydia Mavraidi, Ioannis Dimolitsas, Aris Leivadeas, Symeon Papavassiliou

entry.summary: Presents a framework integrating fine-tuned Mistral-7B with ISA-95-aligned knowledge graphs in Neo4j to translate natural language manufacturing intents into structured, executable actions for Manufacturing-as-a-Service ecosystems.

entry.title: Insertion Network for Image Sequence Correspondence

author.name: Dingjie Su, Weixiang Hong, Benoit M. Dawant, Bennett A. Landman

entry.summary: Proposes a method for establishing correspondence between 2D image sequences by training a network to learn slice insertion, with applications to anatomical localization in medical imaging.

entry.title: Fractional Order Federated Learning for Battery Electric Vehicle Energy Consumption Modeling

author.name: Mohammad Partohaghighi, Roummel Marcia, Bruce J. West, and YangQuan Chen

entry.summary: Introduces FO-RI-FedAvg for federated learning on electric vehicles, incorporating fractional-order optimization and roughness-informed proximal regularization to handle intermittent connectivity and client heterogeneity.

entry.title: PISHYAR: A Socially Intelligent Smart Cane for Indoor Social Navigation and Multimodal Human-Robot Interaction for Visually Impaired People

author.name: Mahdi Haghighat Joo, Maryam Karimi Jafari, Alireza Taheri

entry.summary: Presents PISHYAR, a smart cane for visually impaired people that combines socially-aware navigation (using YOLOv8, activity recognition, D* Lite path planning) with a multimodal LLM-VLM interaction framework for voice and vision-based assistance.

entry.title: Efficient Personalized Federated PCA with Manifold Optimization for IoT Anomaly Detection

author.name: Xianchao Xiu, Chenyi Huang, Wei Zhang, Wanquan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes FedEP, a personalized federated PCA method for IoT anomaly detection that uses L1-norm for element-wise sparsity in local representations and L2,1-norm for row-wise sparsity, optimized via manifold methods on the Stiefel manifold.

entry.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-0: An Open-Sourced Vision-Language-Action Model with Real-Time Execution

author.name: Rui Cai, Jun Guo, Xinze He, Piaopiao Jin, Jie Li, Bingxuan Lin, Futeng Liu, Wei Liu, Fei Ma, Kun Ma, Feng Qiu, Heng Qu, Yifei Su, Qiao Sun, Dong Wang, Donghao Wang, Yunhong Wang, Rujie Wu, Diyun Xiang, Yu Yang, Hangjun Ye, Yuan Zhang, Quanyun Zhou

entry.summary: Already analyzed.

entry.title: Channel-Aware Probing for Multi-Channel Imaging

author.name: Umar Marikkar, Syed Sameed Husain, Muhammad Awais, Sara Atito

entry.summary: Proposes Channel-Aware Probing (CAP) for multi-channel imaging that exploits channel structure when probing frozen pre-trained encoders, addressing the failure of standard probing strategies transferred from other domains.

entry.title: Adaptive Structured Pruning of Convolutional Neural Networks for Time Series Classification

author.name: Javidan Abdullayev, Maxime Devanne, Cyril Meyer, Ali Ismail-Fawaz, Jonathan Weber, Germain Forestier

entry.summary: Proposes Dynamic Structured Pruning (DSP) for convolution-based time series classification models with automatic pruning ratio determination through instance-wise sparsity loss and global activation analysis.

entry.title: Media Framing Moderates Risk-Benefit Perceptions and Value Tradeoffs in Human-Robot Collaboration

author.name: Philipp Brauner, Felix Glawe, Luisa Vervier, Martina Ziefle

entry.summary: Pre-registered study (N=1150) examining how positive/negative media framing moderates risk-benefit perceptions of human-robot collaboration in industrial settings. Finds framing significantly shifts how individuals evaluate HRC value.

entry.title: Can Neural Networks Provide Latent Embeddings for Telemetry-Aware Greedy Routing?

author.name: Andreas Boltres, Niklas Freymuth, Gerhard Neumann

entry.summary: Proposes Placer, a Message Passing Network algorithm that transforms network states into latent node embeddings for greedy routing, avoiding black-box routing decisions while enabling telemetry-aware routing visualization.

entry.title: X-VORTEX: Spatio-Temporal Contrastive Learning for Wake Vortex Trajectory Forecasting

author.name: Zhan Qu and Michael F\"arber

entry.summary: Presents X-VORTEX, a contrastive learning framework for wake vortex trajectory forecasting from LiDAR, leveraging augmentation overlap theory to learn physics-aware representations from unlabeled data.

entry.title: Robustness of Object Detection of Autonomous Vehicles in Adverse Weather Conditions

author.name: Fox Pettersen and Hong Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes a method for evaluating robustness of autonomous vehicle object detection under adverse weather using synthetic augmented data at progressive intensity levels, measuring average first failure coefficients.

entry.title: Curriculum Learning and Pseudo-Labeling Improve the Generalization of Multi-Label Arabic Dialect Identification Models

author.name: Ali Mekky, Mohamed El Zeftawy, Lara Hassan, Amr Keleg, Preslav Nakov

entry.summary: Addresses multi-label Arabic dialect identification using curriculum learning and pseudo-labeling with GPT-4o to generate automatic multi-label annotations from single-label datasets, improving generalization.

entry.title: Ca-MCF: Category-level Multi-label Causal Feature selection

author.name: Wanfu Gao, Yanan Wang, Yonghao Li

entry.summary: Introduces Ca-MCF for category-level multi-label causal feature selection that decomposes label variables into specific category nodes, enabling finer-grained causal structure modeling.

entry.title: Jointly Optimizing Debiased CTR and Uplift for Coupons Marketing: A Unified Causal Framework

author.name: Siyun Yang, Shixiao Yang, Jian Wang, Di Fan, Kehe Cai, Haoyan Fu, Jiaming Zhang, Wenjin Wu, Peng Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes UniMVT for jointly optimizing debiased CTR prediction and uplift estimation in coupon marketing, disentangling confounding factors from treatment-sensitive representations for counterfactual inference.

entry.title: Drift-Aware Variational Autoencoder-based Anomaly Detection with Two-level Ensembling

author.name: Jin Li, Kleanthis Malialis, Christos G. Panayiotou, Marios M. Polycarpou

entry.summary: Presents VAE++ESDD for anomaly detection in streaming data under concept drift, combining an ensemble of VAEs with an ensemble of statistical drift detectors for incremental learning.

entry.title: Resource-Efficient Gesture Recognition through Convexified Attention

author.name: Daniel Schwartz, Dario Salvucci, Yusuf Osmanlioglu, Richard Vallett, Genevieve Dion, and Ali Shokoufandeh

entry.summary: Introduces a convexified attention mechanism for wearable e-textile gesture recognition that uses simplex projection and convex loss functions instead of softmax, providing global convergence guarantees with minimal parameters for resource-constrained devices.

entry.title: EXCODER: EXplainable Classification Of DiscretE time series Representations

author.name: Yannik Hahn, Antonin K\"onigsfeld, Hasan Tercan, Tobias Meisen

entry.summary: Investigates whether transforming time series into discrete latent representations via VQ-VAE and DVAE enhances explainability of time series classification models by reducing redundancy and focusing on informative patterns.

entry.title: Eventizing Traditionally Opaque Binary Neural Networks as 1-safe Petri net Models

author.name: Mohamed Tarraf, Alex Chan, Alex Yakovlev and Rishad Shafik

entry.summary: Proposes modeling Binary Neural Networks as 1-safe Petri nets to expose causal relationships and enable formal verification of BNN internal operations as event-driven processes.

entry.title: Doctor-in-the-Loop: An Explainable, Multi-View Deep Learning Framework for Predicting Pathological Response in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

author.name: Alice Natalina Caragliano, Filippo Ruffini, Carlo Greco, Edy Ippolito, Michele Fiore, Claudia Tacconi, Lorenzo Nibid, Giuseppe Perrone, Sara Ramella, Paolo Soda, Valerio Guarrasi

entry.summary: Proposes Doctor-in-the-Loop, a framework integrating expert domain knowledge with explainable AI for predicting pathological response in non-small cell lung cancer. Uses gradual multi-view strategy to focus on clinically relevant regions.

entry.title: Large Language Models for Healthcare Text Classification: A Systematic Review

author.name: Hajar Sakai and Sarah S. Lam

entry.summary: Systematic review of large language models applied to healthcare text classification, covering clinical notes, diagnosis coding, and related tasks. Surveys challenges including data privacy, medical terminology, and annotation scarcity.

entry.title: Beyond a Single Mode: GAN Ensembles for Diverse Medical Data Generation

author.name: Lorenzo Tronchin, Tommy L\"ofstedt, Paolo Soda, Valerio Guarrasi

entry.summary: Explores GAN ensembles to address mode collapse in medical image generation through multi-objective optimization balancing fidelity and diversity. Proposes optimal ensemble selection method for diverse synthetic medical data.

entry.title: Out of Distribution Detection for Efficient Continual Learning in Quality Prediction for Arc Welding

author.name: Yannik Hahn, Jan Voets, Antonin Koenigsfeld, Hasan Tercan, Tobias Meisen

entry.summary: Extends VQ-VAE Transformer architecture for weld quality prediction with OOD detection using autoregressive loss, combined with continual learning for adapting to distribution shifts in manufacturing.

entry.title: KORAL: Knowledge Graph Guided LLM Reasoning for SSD Operational Analysis

author.name: Mayur Akewar and Sandeep Madireddy and Dongsheng Luo and Janki Bhimani

entry.summary: Presents KORAL, a framework combining LLMs with knowledge graphs for SSD operational analysis, generating insights from fragmented telemetry data without requiring large datasets or expert input.

entry.title: Predicting Dynamic Map States from Limited Field-of-View Sensor Data

author.name: Knut Peterson and David Han

entry.summary: Explores deep learning for predicting dynamic map states from limited field-of-view sensor data, representing temporal sensor data in a single-image format for use with image-to-image learning models.

entry.title: Regularized Meta-Learning for Improved Generalization

author.name: Noor Islam S. Mohammad, Md Muntaqim Meherab

entry.summary: Proposes a regularized meta-learning framework addressing redundancy, multicollinearity, and overfitting in deep ensemble methods through a four-stage pipeline with redundancy-aware projection and statistical meta-feature augmentation.

entry.title: Matching of SAR and optical images based on transformation to shared modality

author.name: Alexey Borisov, Evgeny Myasnikov, Vladislav Myasnikov

entry.summary: Proposes a new approach for matching SAR and optical satellite images by transforming both into a shared modality that minimizes cross-modal differences while preserving geometric information.

entry.title: RoadscapesQA: A Multitask, Multimodal Dataset for Visual Question Answering on Indian Roads

author.name: Vijayasri Iyer, Maahin Rathinagiriswaran, Jyothikamalesh S

entry.summary: Presents RoadscapesQA, a multimodal VQA dataset of up to 9,000 images from diverse Indian driving environments with bounding boxes and rule-based QA pairs for object grounding, reasoning, and scene understanding.

entry.title: ViMedCSS: A Vietnamese Medical Code-Switching Speech Dataset & Benchmark

author.name: Tung X. Nguyen, Nhu Vo, Giang-Son Nguyen, Duy Mai Hoang, Chien Dinh Huynh, Inigo Jauregi Unanue, Massimo Piccardi, Wray Buntine, Dung D. Le

entry.summary: Constructs ViMedCSS, a 34-hour Vietnamese medical code-switching speech dataset with 16,576 utterances for evaluating ASR systems on Vietnamese-English medical code-switching.

entry.title: Multi-Dimensional Visual Data Recovery: Scale-Aware Tensor Modeling and Accelerated Randomized Computation

author.name: Wenjin Qin, Hailin Wang, Jiangjun Peng, Jianjun Wang, and Tingwen Huang

entry.summary: Proposes generalized nonconvex regularization and scalable recovery models for multi-dimensional data using fully-connected tensor network decomposition, with randomized computation for efficiency.

entry.title: Synaptic Activation and Dual Liquid Dynamics for Interpretable Bio-Inspired Models

author.name: M\'onika Farsang, Radu Grosu

entry.summary: Presents a unified framework for bio-inspired neural network models incorporating chemical synapses and dual liquid dynamics, demonstrating improved interpretability in recurrent neural network policies for lane-keeping control tasks.

entry.title: Barron-Wiener-Laguerre models

author.name: Rahul Manavalan, Filip Tronarp

entry.summary: Proposes probabilistic Wiener-Laguerre models that combine Laguerre-parameterized causal dynamics with Barron-type nonlinear maps for operator learning, enabling Bayesian inference and posterior predictive uncertainty.

entry.title: OpenLID-v3: Improving the Precision of Closely Related Language Identification -- An Experience Report

author.name: Mariia Fedorova, Nikolay Arefyev, Maja Buljan, Jind\v{r}ich Helcl, Stephan Oepen, Egil R{\o}nningstad, Yves Scherrer

entry.summary: Extends the OpenLID language identification classifier to handle closely related languages better and distinguish valid language from noise, focusing on Scandinavian, Balkan, and Romance language groups.

entry.title: Whole-Body Image-to-Image Translation for a Virtual Scanner in a Healthcare Digital Twin

author.name: Valerio Guarrasi, Francesco Di Feola, Rebecca Restivo, Lorenzo Tronchin, Paolo Soda

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for whole-body CT-to-PET image translation using region-specific GANs for head, trunk, arms, and legs, then stitching results together. Aims to reduce radiation exposure from PET imaging.

entry.title: Multimodal Doctor-in-the-Loop: A Clinically-Guided Explainable Framework for Predicting Pathological Response in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

author.name: Alice Natalina Caragliano, Claudia Tacconi, Carlo Greco, Lorenzo Nibid, Edy Ippolito, Michele Fiore, Giuseppe Perrone, Sara Ramella, Paolo Soda, and Valerio Guarrasi

entry.summary: Extends Doctor-in-the-Loop to a multimodal setting, combining imaging and clinical data with intermediate fusion for predicting pathological response in NSCLC. Embeds clinician domain knowledge into training.

entry.title: Class Balancing Diversity Multimodal Ensemble for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis and Early Detection

author.name: Arianna Francesconi, Lazzaro di Biase, Donato Cappetta, Fabio Rebecchi, Paolo Soda, Rosa Sicilia, Valerio Guarrasi

entry.summary: Proposes IMBALMED, a multimodal ensemble method for Alzheimer's disease diagnosis that handles class imbalance by integrating clinical, neuroimaging, biospecimen, and subject data. Uses ensemble of classifiers with class-balancing diversity optimization.

entry.title: Texture-Aware StarGAN for CT data harmonisation

author.name: Francesco Di Feola, Ludovica Pompilio, Cecilia Assolito, Valerio Guarrasi, Paolo Soda

entry.summary: Proposes a texture-aware StarGAN for harmonizing CT data across different reconstruction kernels. Uses texture-aware loss to better capture complex image relationships for style transfer in medical imaging.

entry.title: Exploring the robustness of TractOracle methods in RL-based tractography

author.name: Jeremi Levesque, Antoine Th\'eberge, Maxime Descoteaux, Pierre-Marc Jodoin

entry.summary: Investigates extensions to TractOracle-RL for brain white matter tractography, integrating recent RL advances and evaluating across five diffusion MRI datasets. Shows that oracle-guided RL consistently yields robust tractography.

entry.title: Evaluating the Creativity of LLMs in Persian Literary Text Generation

author.name: Armin Tourajmehr, Mohammad Reza Modarres, Yadollah Yaghoobzadeh

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs' ability to generate creative Persian literary text using adapted Torrance Tests of Creative Thinking. Uses LLM-as-judge with human validation across originality, fluency, flexibility, and elaboration dimensions.

entry.title: Wireless TokenCom: RL-Based Tokenizer Agreement for Multi-User Wireless Token Communications

author.name: Farshad Zeinali, Mahdi Boloursaz Mashhadi, Dusit Niyato, Rahim Tafazolli

entry.summary: Introduces a reinforcement learning framework for tokenizer agreement in multi-user wireless token communications, where transmitters and receivers cooperate to choose optimal tokenizer models for semantic communication.

entry.title: Thermal Imaging for Contactless Cardiorespiratory and Sudomotor Response Monitoring

author.name: Constantino \'Alvarez Casado, Mohammad Rahman, Sasan Sharifipour, Nhi Nguyen, Manuel Lage Ca\~nellas, Xiaoting Wu, Miguel Bordallo L\'opez

entry.summary: Characterizes extraction of EDA, heart rate, and breathing rate from facial thermal video using signal processing pipelines. Provides contactless monitoring of cardiorespiratory and sudomotor responses.

entry.title: Accelerating Feedback-based Algorithms for Quantum Optimization Using Gradient Descent

author.name: Masih Mozakka, Mohsen Heidari

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid method combining per-layer gradient estimation with Quantum Lyapunov Control to accelerate convergence of QAOA while preserving stability guarantees for combinatorial optimization.

entry.title: Reproducing DragDiffusion: Interactive Point-Based Editing with Diffusion Models

author.name: Ali Subhan, Ashir Raza

entry.summary: A reproducibility study of DragDiffusion for interactive point-based image editing. Confirms original ablation results but reveals sensitivity to hyperparameters and failure modes not discussed in the original paper.

entry.title: Neural and numerical methods for $\mathrm{G}_2$-structures on contact Calabi-Yau 7-manifolds

author.name: Elli Heyes, Edward Hirst, Henrique N. S\'a Earp, Tom\'as S. R. Silva

entry.summary: Presents a numerical framework using neural networks to approximate G₂-structure 3-forms on contact Calabi-Yau manifolds, computing approximate Ricci-flat metrics and validating learned structures via numerical exterior derivative.

entry.title: Probabilistic Design of Parametrized Quantum Circuits through Local Gate Modifications

author.name: Grier M. Jones, Aviraj Newatia, Alexander Lao, Aditya K. Rao, Viki Kumar Prasad, Hans-Arno Jacobsen

entry.summary: Proposes a local quantum architecture search algorithm using evolution-inspired probabilistic gate-level modifications to optimize parametrized quantum circuits for quantum machine learning tasks.

entry.title: Analytical Results for Two Exponential Family Distributions in Hierarchical Dirichlet Processes

author.name: Naiqi Li

entry.summary: Derives closed-form expressions for Poisson and normal distributions within the Hierarchical Dirichlet Process framework, extending analytical tractability beyond the standard Dirichlet-multinomial conjugate case.

entry.title: CLASE: A Hybrid Method for Chinese Legalese Stylistic Evaluation

author.name: Yiran Rex Ma, Yuxiao Ye, Huiyuan Xie

entry.summary: Introduces CLASE, a hybrid method for evaluating the stylistic quality of Chinese legal text generated by LLMs. Addresses the gap between factual accuracy and adherence to specialized legal writing conventions that are hard to formalize explicitly.

entry.title: Multi-Task Learning with Additive U-Net for Image Denoising and Classification

author.name: Vikram Lakkavalli and Neelam Sinha

entry.summary: Investigates additive skip fusion in U-Net architectures for image denoising and multi-task learning, replacing concatenative skips with gated additive fusion. Shows task-aware redistribution of skip weights in joint denoising-classification settings.

entry.title: "Not Human, Funnier": How Machine Identity Shapes Humor Perception in Online AI Stand-up Comedy

author.name: Xuehan Huang, Canwen Wang, Yifei Hao, Daijin Yang, Ray LC

entry.summary: Explores how AI's own machine identity can be leveraged for humor generation in stand-up comedy. Studies with human audiences (N=32) showed machine-identity-based agents were perceived as funnier than baseline GPT, suggesting identity-aware comedy design for AI.

entry.title: Knowledge-Based Design Requirements for Generative Social Robots in Higher Education

author.name: Stephan Vonschallen, Dominique Oberle, Theresa Schmiedel, and Friederike Eyssel

entry.summary: Investigates knowledge requirements for generative social robots powered by LLMs in higher education, identifying twelve design requirements across self-knowledge, context-knowledge, and world-knowledge from interviews with students and lecturers.

entry.title: Adaptive Scaling with Geometric and Visual Continuity of completed 3D objects

author.name: Jelle Vermandere, Maarten Bassier, Maarten Vergauwen

entry.summary: Introduces a part-aware scaling framework that transforms static completed SDFs into editable objects with smooth interpolation of geometry, color, and part indices for proportional deformation.

entry.title: Evaluating the Homogeneity of Keyphrase Prediction Models

author.name: Ma\"el Houbre, Florian Boudin, Beatrice Daille

entry.summary: Evaluates homogeneity of keyphrase prediction models, testing whether generation models are more consistent than extraction models in assigning the same keyphrases to documents about the same subjects.

entry.title: Probabilistic Wind Power Forecasting with Tree-Based Machine Learning and Weather Ensembles

author.name: Max Bruninx, Diederik van Binsbergen, Timothy Verstraeten, Ann Now\'e, Jan Helsen

entry.summary: Compares three probabilistic prediction methods (conformal quantile regression, natural gradient boosting, conditional diffusion models) for day-ahead wind power forecasting using gradient boosting trees with weather ensemble data. Validated on four years of Belgian offshore wind farm data. Applied ML work for renewable energy integration.

entry.title: Towards a Neuronally Consistent Ontology for Robotic Agents

author.name: Florian Ahrens, Mihai Pomarlan, Daniel Be{\ss}ler, Thorsten Fehr, Michael Beetz, Manfred Herrmann

entry.summary: Proposes using human neuroimaging data (ICA on fMRI) to validate and enrich ontologies used by robotic agents, bridging neuroscience and robot knowledge representation. The goal is to help robots learn from human experiences by grounding ontological concepts in neural information processing.

entry.title: A Model-Driven Engineering Approach to AI-Powered Healthcare Platforms

author.name: Mira Raheem, Amal Elgammal, Michael Papazoglou, Bernd Kr\"amer, Neamat El-Tazi

entry.summary: Introduces a model-driven engineering framework for healthcare AI using formal metamodels and domain-specific languages, including MILA for clinicians to define ML pipelines using shared ontologies.

entry.title: Quantum walk inspired JPEG compression of images

author.name: Abhishek Verma, Sahil Tomar, Sandeep Kumar

entry.summary: Proposes a quantum walk-inspired optimization strategy for adaptive JPEG quantization tables, showing 3-6 dB PSNR gains over standard JPEG on MNIST, CIFAR10, and ImageNet subsets.

entry.title: Geometric Stratification for Singular Configurations of the P3P Problem via Local Dual Space

author.name: Xueying Sun, Zijia Li, Nan Li

entry.summary: Provides complete geometric stratification of singular configurations in the P3P (Perspective-three-Point) problem using local dual space, relating multiplicity of camera center to geometric structures like the danger cylinder.

entry.title: Lung nodule classification on CT scan patches using 3D convolutional neural networks

author.name: Volodymyr Sydorskyi

entry.summary: Introduces three improvements for lung nodule classification on CT scans using 3D CNNs: advanced preprocessing, architecture modifications, and training strategies. Addresses the need for efficient automated lung cancer screening.

entry.title: AIWizards at MULTIPRIDE: A Hierarchical Approach to Slur Reclamation Detection

author.name: Luca Tedeschini, Matteo Fasulo

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical approach for detecting reclaimed slurs in LGBTQ+ contexts, using weakly supervised LLM-based annotation of user identity followed by slur classification. Addresses the EVALITA 2026 MultiPRIDE shared task.

entry.title: SKYSURF: A Self-learning Framework for Persistent Surveillance using Cooperative Aerial Gliders

author.name: Houssem Eddine Mohamadi, Nadjia Kara

entry.summary: Proposes a behavioral management approach for autonomous soaring-capable UAVs modeled as finite state-based rational agents, using delayed learning and tuning for cooperative surveillance in thermal updrafts.

entry.title: Never say never: Exploring the effects of available knowledge on agent persuasiveness in controlled physiotherapy motivation dialogues

author.name: Stephan Vonschallen, Rahel H\"ausler, Theresa Schmiedel, and Friederike Eyssel

entry.summary: Explores how available knowledge affects persuasiveness of ChatGPT-generated messages in physiotherapy motivation contexts, comparing responses across different knowledge configurations in human-robot interaction.

entry.title: Learning Image-based Tree Crown Segmentation from Enhanced Lidar-based Pseudo-labels

author.name: Julius Pesonen, Stefan Rua, Josef Taher, Niko Koivum\"aki, Xiaowei Yu, Eija Honkavaara

entry.summary: Presents a method to train deep learning models for individual tree crown segmentation from aerial imagery using pseudo-labels derived from lidar data, enhanced by SAM 2. Demonstrates practical approach for environmental monitoring.

entry.title: Implicit-Scale 3D Reconstruction for Multi-Food Volume Estimation from Monocular Images

author.name: Yuhao Chen, Gautham Vinod, Siddeshwar Raghavan, Talha Ibn Mahmud, Bruce Coburn, Jinge Ma, Fengqing Zhu and Jiangpeng He

entry.summary: Presents a benchmark dataset for food volume estimation reframed as implicit-scale 3D reconstruction from monocular images, where algorithms must infer scale from contextual cues like plates and utensils rather than explicit references.

entry.title: Exploring a New Competency Modeling Process with Large Language Models

author.name: Silin Du, Manqing Xin, Raymond Jia Wang

entry.summary: Proposes using LLMs to automate competency modeling in HR management, replacing manual expert analysis of interview transcripts with structured computational workflows using embedding-based similarity mapping.

entry.title: Constrained Assumption-Based Argumentation Frameworks

author.name: Emanuele De Angelis (1), Fabio Fioravanti (2), Maria Chiara Meo (2), Alberto Pettorossi (3), Maurizio Proietti (1), Francesca Toni (4) ((1) CNR-IASI, Rome, Italy, (2) DEc, University 'G. d'Annunzio', Chieti-Pescara, Italy, (3) DICII, University of Rome 'Tor Vergata', Italy, (4) Imperial, London, UK)

entry.summary: Proposes Constrained ABA (CABA), extending Assumption-Based Argumentation to support constrained variables over possibly infinite domains, with non-ground semantics that generalize standard ABA.

entry.title: Temporally-Sampled Efficiently Adaptive State Lattices for Autonomous Ground Robot Navigation in Partially Observed Environments

author.name: Ashwin Satish Menon (1), Eric R. Damm (1), Eli S. Lancaster (2), Felix A. Sanchez (3), Jason M. Gregory (2), Thomas M. Howard (1 and 2) ((1) University of Rochester, (2) DEVCOM Army Research Lab, (3) Parsons Corporation)

entry.summary: Proposes a temporal sampling approach for state lattice planning in partially observed off-road environments, addressing unsafe navigation behavior caused by rapidly changing regional plan guidance.

entry.title: Monocular Markerless Motion Capture Enables Quantitative Assessment of Upper Extremity Reachable Workspace

author.name: Seth Donahue, J.D. Peiffer, R. Tyler Richardson, Yishan Zhong, Shaun Q. Y. Tan, Benoit Marteau, Stephanie R. Russo, May D. Wang, R. James Cotton, Ross Chafetz

entry.summary: Validates monocular markerless motion capture using AI for quantifying upper extremity reachable workspace, comparing against marker-based systems in a clinical assessment context.

entry.title: Multi-Dataset Multi-Task Learning for COVID-19 Prognosis

author.name: Filippo Ruffini, Lorenzo Tronchin, Zhuoru Wu, Wenting Chen, Paolo Soda, Linlin Shen, Valerio Guarrasi

entry.summary: Introduces a multi-dataset multi-task training framework for predicting COVID-19 prognosis from chest X-rays by integrating correlated datasets from different sources. Addresses data scarcity by combining severity scoring with prognostic classification.

entry.title: Adaptive traffic signal control optimization using a novel road partition and multi-channel state representation method

author.name: Maojiang Deng, Shoufeng Lu, Jiazhao Shi, Wen Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a DQN/PPO-based adaptive traffic signal control using variable cell length road partitioning and multi-channel state representation with vehicle count, speed, and occupancy.

entry.title: A consequence of failed sequential learning: A computational account of developmental amnesia

author.name: Qi Zhang

entry.summary: Presents a computational model of developmental amnesia demonstrating impaired episodic recall with spared recognition and semantic learning, attributing it to failed sequential/spatial learning in the hippocampus.

entry.title: Vehicle behaviour estimation for abnormal event detection using distributed fiber optic sensing

author.name: Hemant Prasad, Daisuke Ikefuji, Shin Tominaga, Hitoshi Sakurai, Manabu Otani

entry.summary: Presents a method for detecting single-lane traffic abnormalities using distributed fiber-optic sensing by tracking individual vehicle paths and detecting lane changes through clustering techniques. This enables early detection of congestion causes.

entry.title: Synthetic Craquelure Generation for Unsupervised Painting Restoration

author.name: Jana Cuch-Guill\'en, Antonio Agudo, Ra\"ul P\'erez-Gonzalo

entry.summary: Proposes a fully annotation-free framework for painting craquelure detection and restoration using synthetic crack generation with Bézier trajectories, combined with a SegFormer backbone adapted via LoRA.

entry.title: BaziQA-Benchmark: Evaluating Symbolic and Temporally Compositional Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Jiangxi Chen and Qian Liu

entry.summary: Presents BaziQA-Benchmark for evaluating symbolic and temporally compositional reasoning in LLMs, derived from 200 fortune-telling competition problems requiring structured inference over symbolic charts.

entry.title: MAUNet-Light: A Concise MAUNet Architecture for Bias Correction and Downscaling of Precipitation Estimates

author.name: Sumanta Chandra Mishra Sharma, Adway Mitra, Auroop Ratan Ganguly

entry.summary: Proposes MAUNet-Light, a compact version of the MAUNet architecture for precipitation bias correction and downscaling, achieving competitive performance with fewer parameters.

entry.title: Represent Micro-Doppler Signature in Orders

author.name: Weicheng Gao

entry.summary: Proposes Chebyshev-time maps for representing micro-Doppler signatures from through-wall radar using polynomial orders, reducing input dimensionality while maintaining discriminative power.

entry.title: How Swarms Differ: Challenges in Collective Behaviour Comparison

author.name: Andr\'e Fialho Jesus and Jonas Kuckling

entry.summary: Investigates how different feature sets and similarity measures affect the comparison of collective swarm behaviors in robotics, finding that existing ad-hoc feature sets lack robustness across behavioral contexts.

entry.title: From sunblock to softblock: Analyzing the correlates of neology in published writing and on social media

author.name: Maria Ryskina, Matthew R. Gormley, Kyle Mahowald, David R. Mortensen, Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick, Vivek Kulkarni

entry.summary: Analyzes correlates of new word creation (neology) using distributional semantics, extending methodology from historical published texts to Twitter data and from static to contextual embeddings.

entry.title: Optimal Take-off under Fuzzy Clearances

author.name: Hugo Henry and Arthur Tsai and Kelly Cohen

entry.summary: Presents a hybrid obstacle avoidance system for unmanned aircraft combining fuzzy logic for adaptive constraint handling with optimal control, using FAA/EASA guidelines to modulate safety parameters.

entry.title: A Lightweight Cubature Kalman Filter for Attitude and Heading Reference Systems Using Simplified Prediction Equations

author.name: Shunsei Yamagishi, Lei Jing

entry.summary: Presents KCKF, a lightweight Cubature Kalman Filter for attitude estimation that reduces computational cost by ~19% through simplification of prediction equations while maintaining accuracy.

entry.title: VineetVC: Adaptive Video Conferencing Under Severe Bandwidth Constraints Using Audio-Driven Talking-Head Reconstruction

author.name: Vineet Kumar Rakesh and Soumya Mazumdar and Tapas Samanta and Hemendra Kumar Pandey and Amitabha Das and Sarbajit Pal

entry.summary: Describes an adaptive video conferencing system that switches to audio-driven talking-head reconstruction when bandwidth drops severely, using WebRTC telemetry to trigger mode transitions.

entry.title: Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis for Future Tourism Experiences: A BERT-MoE Framework for Persian User Reviews

author.name: Hamidreza Kazemi Taskooh and Taha Zare Harofte

entry.summary: Proposes a BERT-MoE hybrid model for aspect-based sentiment analysis of Persian tourism reviews, achieving 90.6% weighted F1. Addresses low-resource language challenges with a dataset of 58K reviews from an Iranian platform.

entry.title: A Microservice-Based Platform for Sustainable and Intelligent SLO Fulfilment and Service Management

author.name: Juan Luis Herrera, Daniel Wang, Schahram Dustdar

entry.summary: Proposes a microservice-based platform for sustainable SLO fulfillment using intelligent decision systems across the Computing Continuum, addressing the tension between performance and sustainability objectives.

entry.title: Machine Learning-Based Classification of Jhana Advanced Concentrative Absorption Meditation (ACAM-J) using 7T fMRI

author.name: Puneet Kumar, Winson F. Z. Yang, Alakhsimar Singh, Xiaobai Li, and Matthew D. Sacchet

entry.summary: Uses 7T fMRI and machine learning to classify Jhana advanced meditation states from regional homogeneity features, evaluating generalization from group-level training to intensive single-case data.

entry.title: Towards interpretable models for language proficiency assessment: Predicting the CEFR level of Estonian learner texts

author.name: Kais Allkivi

entry.summary: Classifies Estonian proficiency examination writings by CEFR level using interpretable linguistic features, comparing traditional ML models with LLM-based approaches for language proficiency assessment.

entry.title: String-Level Ground Fault Localization for TN-Earthed Three-Phase Photovoltaic Systems

author.name: Yuanliang Li, Xun Gong, Reza Iravani, Bo Cao, Heng Liu, Ziming Chen

entry.summary: Presents an edge-AI approach for localizing ground faults in three-phase photovoltaic systems at string level, using simulation-generated features and correlation-based analysis.

entry.title: A Gradient Boosted Mixed-Model Machine Learning Framework for Vessel Speed in the U.S. Arctic

author.name: Mauli Pant, Linda Fernandez, Indranil Sahoo

entry.summary: Applies a two-stage gradient boosted machine learning framework with random effects to model vessel speed in U.S. Arctic waters using AIS data, accounting for zero-speed observations.

entry.title: Interference-Robust Non-Coherent Over-the-Air Computation for Decentralized Optimization

author.name: Nicol\`o Michelusi

entry.summary: Proposes an interference-robust non-coherent over-the-air computation method for decentralized optimization in wireless networks, addressing the susceptibility of NCOTA to external interference.

entry.title: Constrained PSO Six-Parameter Fuzzy PID Tuning Method for Balanced Optimization of Depth Tracking Performance in Underwater Vehicles

author.name: Yanxi Ding and Tingyue Jia

entry.summary: Proposes constrained PSO for tuning six-parameter fuzzy PID controllers for underwater vehicle depth control, optimizing tracking performance while satisfying actuator constraints.

entry.title: ART3mis: Ray-Based Textual Annotation on 3D Cultural Objects

author.name: Vasileios Arampatzakis, Vasileios Sevetlidis, Fotis Arnaoutoglou, Athanasios Kalogeras, Christos Koulamas, Aris Lalos, Chairi Kiourt, George Ioannakis, Anestis Koutsoudis, George Pavlidis

entry.summary: Presents ART3mis, a ray-based interactive tool for annotating textual metadata onto specific regions of 3D cultural heritage objects. Designed for cultural heritage professionals without 3D graphics expertise.

entry.title: Towards complete digital twins in cultural heritage with ART3mis 3D artifacts annotator

author.name: Dimitrios Karamatskos, Vasileios Arampatzakis, Vasileios Sevetlidis, Stavros Nousias, Athanasios Kalogeras, Christos Koulamas, Aris Lalos, George Pavlidis

entry.summary: Presents ART3mis, a web-based 3D annotation tool for cultural heritage objects compliant with W3C Web Annotation Data Model. Enables non-technical cultural heritage practitioners to annotate and attach metadata to specific regions of 3D objects.

entry.title: Semantic Communities and Boundary-Spanning Lyrics in K-pop: A Graph-Based Unsupervised Analysis

author.name: Oktay Karaku\c{s}

entry.summary: Presents a graph-based unsupervised framework for discovering semantic communities in K-pop lyrics using line-level semantic representations and community detection, identifying boundary-spanning songs via bridge metrics.

entry.title: Human Emotion-Mediated Soft Robotic Arts: Exploring the Intersection of Human Emotions, Soft Robotics and Arts

author.name: Saitarun Nadipineni, Chenhao Hong, Tanishtha Ramlall, Chapa Sirithunge, Kaspar Althoefer, Fumiya Iida and Thilina Dulantha Lalitharatne

entry.summary: Explores soft robotic art installations that dynamically respond to human brain signals (alpha waves) to create emotion-mediated interactive displays using soft characters and flowers.

entry.title: Selection of CMIP6 Models for Regional Precipitation Projection and Climate Change Assessment in the Jhelum and Chenab River Basins

author.name: Saad Ahmed Jamal, Ammara Nusrat, Muhammad Azmat, Muhammad Osama Nusrat

entry.summary: Selects CMIP6 climate models for precipitation projection in Pakistan river basins using envelope-based method with ML techniques, studying climate change effects under SSP scenarios.

entry.summary: Portuguese-language tutorial/chapter on Multimodal Large Language Models covering fundamentals, practical techniques with LangChain/LangGraph, and prompt engineering. Includes supplementary code.

author.name: Raiz Ud Din (1), Saddam Hussain Khan (2) ((1) Artificial Intelligence Lab, Department of Computer Systems Engineering, University of Engineering and Applied Sciences (UEAS), Swat, Pakistan, (2) Interdisciplinary Research Center for Smart Mobility and Logistics, King Fahad University of Petroleum and Minerals (KFUPM), Dhahran, Saudi Arabia)

entry.summary: Proposes an optimized DenseNet-121 framework with explainability for grape leaf disease classification, using domain-specific preprocessing and Grad-CAM visualizations.

author.name: Maaz Qureshi, Mohammad Omid Bagheri, William Melek, and George Shaker
